AbstractGLTFLayer.addGeometry.zh: 添加 geometry，GeoJSON 会先转换并同步注册为 marker
AbstractGLTFLayer.addGeometry.en: Adds gltf markers or GeoJSON features to the layer, validating their types first.

AbstractGLTFLayer.addMarker.zh: 登记 marker 并分配 pickingId，同时触发 add 与 load 事件
AbstractGLTFLayer.addMarker.en: Registers markers into the layer's picking table, fires add and loads their gltf data.

AbstractGLTFLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 清除样式中的 outline 配置并取消所有 geometry 描边
AbstractGLTFLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancels outlines of all markers and removes outline from the layer style.

AbstractGLTFLayer.clear.zh: 清空 layer 内所有 gltf marker 并重置 marker 映射缓存
AbstractGLTFLayer.clear.en: Clears all gltf markers in the layer and resets the marker id maps.

AbstractGLTFLayer.getGLTFUrls.zh: 获取图层已登记的 gltf 模型 url 列表
AbstractGLTFLayer.getGLTFUrls.en: Returns the urls of all gltf models registered on the layer.

AbstractGLTFLayer.getShaderMap.zh: 获取 shader 名字到 shader 配置的映射表
AbstractGLTFLayer.getShaderMap.en: Returns the map of shader names to their shader configs.

AbstractGLTFLayer.getShaders.zh: 获取所有已注册 shader 的名字与 uniforms 列表
AbstractGLTFLayer.getShaders.en: Returns the names and uniforms of all registered shaders.

AbstractGLTFLayer.getStyle.zh: 获取图层当前设置的原始样式
AbstractGLTFLayer.getStyle.en: Returns the raw style currently set on the layer.

AbstractGLTFLayer.outlineAll.zh: 对 layer 内所有 geometry 开启 outline 描边
AbstractGLTFLayer.outlineAll.en: Enables outline for every geometry in the layer.

AbstractGLTFLayer.outlineBatch.zh: 按样式索引开启该样式的 outline 并给命中的 geometry 描边
AbstractGLTFLayer.outlineBatch.en: Enables outline on the style at filterIndex and outlines the matched geometries.

AbstractGLTFLayer.registerShader.zh: 注册自定义 shader 到 gltf layer 的 shader 表
AbstractGLTFLayer.registerShader.en: Registers a custom shader into the gltf layer shader map.

AbstractGLTFLayer.removeShader.zh: 从 gltf layer 的 shader 表中移除指定名字的 shader
AbstractGLTFLayer.removeShader.en: Removes the shader with the given name from the gltf layer shader map.

AbstractGLTFLayer.setStyle.zh: 设置图层样式并重新匹配 marker，传空则恢复默认样式
AbstractGLTFLayer.setStyle.en: Sets the layer style and re-matches markers, restoring the default style on falsy input.

AbstractGLTFLayer.toJSON.zh: 把图层序列化为 JSON，可选是否导出 style 与 geometries
AbstractGLTFLayer.toJSON.en: Exports the layer as JSON, optionally including its style and geometries.

AbstractGLTFLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 同时更新图层样式与内部副本中第 idx 项 symbol 并重匹配 marker
AbstractGLTFLayer.updateSymbol.en: Updates the symbol at index idx in the layer style and its copy, then re-matches markers.

Ajax.get.en: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response text or an error through the callback.

Ajax.getArrayBuffer.en: Requests a binary resource as an array buffer.

Ajax.getImage.zh: 拉取图片二进制并转成 blob URL 赋给图像对象
Ajax.getImage.en: Fetches the image as a blob and assigns its object URL to img.src, calling img.onerror on failure.

Ajax.getJSON.zh: 请求并解析 JSON，传 jsonp 选项时改用 jsonp 方式
Ajax.getJSON.en: Fetches and parses a JSON resource, using jsonp when the jsonp option is true.

Analysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到图层，图层就绪后创建分析 pass
Analysis.addTo.en: Adds the analysis to a layer, creating its render pass once the layer is on a map.

Analysis.disable.zh: 禁用分析并请求图层重绘
Analysis.disable.en: Disables the analysis and requests a redraw of its layer.

Analysis.enable.zh: 启用分析并请求图层重绘
Analysis.enable.en: Enables the analysis and requests a redraw of its layer.

Analysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 渲染分析结果并读出 RGBA 像素数据，未启用时返回 null
Analysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Renders the analysis pass for the given meshes and reads back its RGBA pixels, null when disabled.

Analysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，如 cut 或 viewshed
Analysis.getAnalysisType.en: Returns the analysis type identifier, such as cut or viewshed.

Analysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与分析的 layer id 数组
Analysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Returns the ids of the layers excluded from the analysis.

Analysis.isEnable.zh: 返回分析当前是否启用
Analysis.isEnable.en: Returns whether the analysis is currently enabled.

Analysis.remove.zh: 从图层移除分析并销毁 pass、mesh 等资源
Analysis.remove.en: Removes the analysis from its layer and disposes its passes, meshes and picking resources.

Analysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与分析的 layer id 数组
Analysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Sets the ids of the layers to be excluded from the analysis.

Analysis.update.zh: 更新指定名称的分析参数并请求重绘
Analysis.update.en: Updates the named analysis option and requests a redraw of its layer.

Animation.speed.zh: 预定义的动画速度档位 slow normal fast，单位为毫秒
Animation.speed.en: Predefined animation speeds in milliseconds: slow 2000, normal 1000, fast 500.

ArcConnectorLine.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 对象反序列化出几何实例，并还原其 properties
ArcConnectorLine.fromJSON.en: Deserializes a geometry instance from its JSON object and restores its properties.

ArcConnectorLine.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
ArcConnectorLine.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom, null when not on a map.

ArcConnectorLine.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
ArcConnectorLine.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry's altitude as a single value or an array of altitudes.

ArcConnectorLine.getCoordinates.zh: 获取几何体的 coordinate，按类型返回坐标或嵌套数组
ArcConnectorLine.getCoordinates.en: Returns the geometry's coordinates, as coordinates or nested arrays by type.

ArcConnectorLine.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现
ArcConnectorLine.getGeometries.en: Returns the child geometries of a collection, implemented only by collection subclasses.

ArcConnectorLine.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
ArcConnectorLine.getHoles.en: Returns the hole coordinate rings of a polygon-like geometry, only some subclasses implement it.

ArcConnectorLine.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
ArcConnectorLine.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

ArcConnectorLine.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
ArcConnectorLine.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

ArcConnectorLine.getOutline.zh: 复用 Polygon 的实现，按 extent 生成描边多边形
ArcConnectorLine.getOutline.en: Reuses the Polygon implementation to build an outline polygon from the extent.

ArcConnectorLine.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
ArcConnectorLine.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the rotate offset angle in degrees, implemented only by Sector now.

ArcConnectorLine.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
ArcConnectorLine.getShell.en: Returns the shell coordinate ring of the geometry, only some subclasses implement it.

ArcConnectorLine.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
ArcConnectorLine.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol.

ArcConnectorLine.hasAltitude.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否具有非零的高度值
ArcConnectorLine.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any non-zero altitude value.

ArcConnectorLine.hasHoles.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否带有洞
ArcConnectorLine.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has any holes inside.

ArcConnectorLine.isRotated.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否已被旋转
ArcConnectorLine.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated.

ArcConnectorLine.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的生命周期回调，注册连接事件并刷新连线坐标
ArcConnectorLine.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is added to a layer; registers connect events and updates coordinates.

ArcConnectorLine.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时的生命周期回调，写入新 properties 并在需要时重绘
ArcConnectorLine.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; applies new properties and repaints when needed.

ArcConnectorLine.onHide.zh: geometry 隐藏时的生命周期回调，关闭其菜单与信息窗口
ArcConnectorLine.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; closes its menu and info window.

ArcConnectorLine.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 positionchange 事件
ArcConnectorLine.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a position change; clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

ArcConnectorLine.onRemove.zh: geometry 被移除时的生命周期回调，解绑连接源与目标上的事件
ArcConnectorLine.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is removed; unbinds events on its connect source and target.

ArcConnectorLine.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 shapechange 事件
ArcConnectorLine.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a shape change; clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

ArcConnectorLine.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时的生命周期回调，刷新 symbol 并派发 symbolchange 事件
ArcConnectorLine.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a symbol change; refreshes the symbol and fires symbolchange.

ArcConnectorLine.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的高度，同步更新 properties 与坐标的 z 值
ArcConnectorLine.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude, updating properties and coordinate z values.

ArcConnectorLine.setCoordinates.en: Sets new coordinates to the connector line.

ArcCurve.fromJSON.zh: 由 feature 坐标与 options 反序列化出 ArcCurve，并还原其 properties
ArcCurve.fromJSON.en: Deserializes an ArcCurve from the feature coordinates and options and restores its properties.

ArcCurve.get2DExtent.zh: 获取 geometry 在当前 zoom 下投影到屏幕像素的范围，无地图时返回 null
ArcCurve.get2DExtent.en: Gets the geometry projected extent in screen pixels at the current zoom, null without a map.

ArcCurve.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的高度，优先取 properties 再取坐标 z 值，没有则为 0
ArcCurve.getAltitude.en: Gets the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z values, 0 when there is none.

ArcCurve.getCoordinates.zh: 获取该曲线几何图形的坐标数组
ArcCurve.getCoordinates.en: Gets the coordinates array of the curve geometry.

ArcCurve.getGeometries.zh: 获取该 geometry 包含的子 geometry 数组
ArcCurve.getGeometries.en: Gets the child geometries contained in this geometry.

ArcCurve.getHoles.zh: 获取该 geometry 内环即洞的坐标数组，没有洞时为空数组
ArcCurve.getHoles.en: Gets the hole rings coordinates of the geometry, an empty array if it has none.

ArcCurve.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取该 geometry 的最大高度值
ArcCurve.getMaxAltitude.en: Gets the maximum altitude of the geometry.

ArcCurve.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取该 geometry 的最小高度值
ArcCurve.getMinAltitude.en: Gets the minimum altitude of the geometry.

ArcCurve.getOutline.zh: 获取该 geometry 外包框的轮廓 Polygon
ArcCurve.getOutline.en: Gets an outline Polygon of the geometry extent.

ArcCurve.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取该 geometry 旋转时使用的偏移角度
ArcCurve.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Gets the offset angle used when rotating the geometry.

ArcCurve.getShell.zh: 获取该 geometry 外环的坐标数组
ArcCurve.getShell.en: Gets the outer ring coordinates of the geometry.

ArcCurve.getTextDesc.zh: 获取 symbol 文本按 properties 解析后的文本描述
ArcCurve.getTextDesc.en: Gets the text descriptions resolved from the symbol text content and properties.

ArcCurve.hasAltitude.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否具有非零的高度值
ArcCurve.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any non-zero altitude value.

ArcCurve.hasHoles.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否带有洞，ArcCurve 等线状几何体返回假值
ArcCurve.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has holes; line-based geometries such as ArcCurve return falsy.

ArcCurve.isRotated.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否已设置旋转角与旋转中心
ArcCurve.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated with an angle and a pivot.

ArcCurve.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的可选生命周期回调，ArcCurve 未实现
ArcCurve.onAdd.en: Optional lifecycle callback when the geometry is added to a layer; not implemented by ArcCurve.

ArcCurve.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时的生命周期回调，写入新 properties 或重绘
ArcCurve.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; applies new properties or repaints.

ArcCurve.onHide.zh: geometry 隐藏时的生命周期回调，关闭其菜单与信息窗口
ArcCurve.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; closes its menu and info window.

ArcCurve.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 positionchange 事件
ArcCurve.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a position change; clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

ArcCurve.onRemove.zh: geometry 从 layer 移除时的可选生命周期回调，ArcCurve 未实现
ArcCurve.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback when the geometry is removed from a layer; not implemented by ArcCurve.

ArcCurve.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 shapechange 事件
ArcCurve.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a shape change; clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

ArcCurve.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时的回调，刷新 symbol 并派发 symbolchange 事件
ArcCurve.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a symbol change; refreshes the symbol and fires symbolchange.

ArcCurve.setAltitude.zh: 设置该 geometry 的 altitude，同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
ArcCurve.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry's altitude and update the z value of its coordinates.

ArcCurve.setCoordinates.zh: 设置曲线的新 coordinates，并触发 shapechange
ArcCurve.setCoordinates.en: Set new coordinates for the curve and fire shapechange.

AreaTool.getEvents.zh: 返回当前绘制模式对应的 map 事件映射，模式无事件时返回 null
AreaTool.getEvents.en: Return the map event map for the current drawing mode, or null when the mode has none.

AreaTool.onAdd.zh: 工具加入 map 时的回调，校验当前绘制模式是否合法
AreaTool.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback when the tool is added to the map; validates the drawing mode.

AreaTool.onDisable.zh: 工具禁用时的回调，恢复 map 配置、结束绘制并移除绘制图层
AreaTool.onDisable.en: Lifecycle callback when the tool is disabled; restores map config, ends drawing and removes the draw layer.

AreaTool.onEnable.zh: 工具启用时的回调，保存 map 配置、创建绘制图层并加载资源
AreaTool.onEnable.en: Lifecycle callback when the tool is enabled; saves map config, creates the draw layer and loads resources.

AreaTool.remove.zh: 将该工具从 map 上移除，先禁用并解绑事件
AreaTool.remove.en: Remove the tool from the map, disabling it and unbinding its events first.

Attribution.buildOn.zh: 创建 attribution 控件的 DOM 容器并填充内容
Attribution.buildOn.en: Create the attribution control's DOM container and fill it with content.

Attribution.getContent.zh: 获取 attribution 控件的显示内容
Attribution.getContent.en: Returns the content shown by the attribution control.

Attribution.onAdd.zh: 控件加入地图时监听 layer 增删以刷新 attribution
Attribution.onAdd.en: Listen to layer add and remove events to refresh attribution when the control is added.

Attribution.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时回调，position 变化时更新控件位置
Attribution.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; updates the control position when position changes.

Attribution.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时解绑地图的图层增删事件监听
Attribution.onRemove.en: Unbind the map's layer add and remove listeners when the control is removed.

Attribution.setContent.zh: 设置 attribution 内容并立即刷新显示
Attribution.setContent.en: Sets the attribution content and refreshes the display immediately.

baidu.measure.zh: 百度测量器的注册名，值为 BAIDU
baidu.measure.en: Identifies the baidu measurer, whose registered name is BAIDU.

baidu.sphere.zh: 百度量测使用的球体，半径为 6370996.81
baidu.sphere.en: Defines the sphere of radius 6370996.81 used by the baidu measurer.

BAIDUProjection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长即球面 extent 宽高，结果会缓存
BAIDUProjection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere circumference, the size of the sphere extent, cached after the first call.

BAIDUProjection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，由投影经纬度极值算出并缓存
BAIDUProjection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent computed from the projected lnglat limits, cached after the first call.

BAIDUProjection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
BAIDUProjection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

BAIDUProjection.project.zh: 将经纬度坐标转换为百度墨卡托坐标
BAIDUProjection.project.en: Projects a lnglat coordinate into the Baidu mercator coordinate.

BAIDUProjection.unproject.zh: 将百度墨卡托坐标转换为经纬度坐标
BAIDUProjection.unproject.en: Converts a Baidu mercator coordinate back into a lnglat coordinate.

CanvasLayer.clearCanvas.en: Clears the layer canvas through its renderer.

CanvasLayer.completeRender.en: Asks the map to redraw the layer canvas and fire the layerload event.

CanvasLayer.doubleBuffer.zh:
double buffer的回调函数
默认情况下just draws and return，如果你需要在绘制之前处理canvas，可以重写改函数
CanvasLayer.doubleBuffer.en: Clears the buffer context and returns this; override it to process the canvas image before drawing.

CanvasLayer.draw.en: Draws things on the layer canvas; implement it in subclasses.

CanvasLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取分组 layer 内的子 layer 数组，仅分组类 layer 实现
CanvasLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers of this layer; implemented only by group layers.

CanvasLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取该 layer 绑定的 renderer 实例
CanvasLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance bound to this layer.

CanvasLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
CanvasLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer name for this layer based on the map's renderer type.

CanvasLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
CanvasLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer at a coordinate; implemented by subclasses.

CanvasLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
CanvasLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries on the layer at a container point; implemented by subclasses.

CanvasLayer.isCanvasRender.zh: 是否为 HTML5 Canvas 渲染的 layer，本类固定返回 true
CanvasLayer.isCanvasRender.en: Whether the layer is rendered by HTML5 Canvas; always true for CanvasLayer.

CanvasLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 或父图层后调用的生命周期回调，默认空实现
CanvasLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer is bound to a map or a parent layer; empty by default.

CanvasLayer.onConfig.zh: layer 配置项变化时的回调，触发重绘并更新 attribution 控件
CanvasLayer.onConfig.en: Callback invoked when layer options change; it redraws the renderer and updates the attribution control.

CanvasLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载末尾调用的回调，在 renderer 初始化完成之后
CanvasLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Callback invoked at the end of layer load, after the renderer has been initialized.

CanvasLayer.onMoveEnd.en: The event callback for the map moveend event.

CanvasLayer.onMoveStart.en: The event callback for the map movestart event.

CanvasLayer.onMoving.en: The event callback for the map moving event.

CanvasLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，在 renderer 释放之前调用
CanvasLayer.onRemove.en: Callback invoked when the layer is removed, before its renderer is released.

CanvasLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: layer 的 renderer 创建完成后的回调，先于 renderercreate 事件
CanvasLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer renderer is created, before the renderercreate event.

CanvasLayer.onResize.en: The event callback for the map resize event.

CanvasLayer.onZoomEnd.en: The event callback for the map zoomend event.

CanvasLayer.onZooming.en: The event callback for the map zooming event.

CanvasLayer.onZoomStart.en: The event callback for the map zoomstart event.

CanvasLayer.prepareToDraw.en: An optional interface function called only once before the first draw, useful for preparing your canvas operations.

CanvasLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 配置并请求重绘
CanvasLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

CanvasLayer.requestMapToRender.zh: 要求map不触发任何事件下重绘canvas
CanvasLayer.requestMapToRender.en: Ask the map to redraw the layer canvas without firing any event.

CanvasLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并重新排序 map 上的图层
CanvasLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index, re-sorts the map layers and fires setzindex.

CanvasLayer.toJSON.zh: 返回 layer 的 JSON 对象，包含 type、id 与 options 字段
CanvasLayer.toJSON.en: Return the layer's JSON object holding its type, id and options.

CanvasRenderer.clear.zh: 清空 canvas 上下文并标记需要重绘，同时清除瓦片缓存
CanvasRenderer.clear.en: Clear the canvas context and mark it to redraw, additionally dropping the tile caches.

CanvasRenderer.clipCanvas.zh: 按 layer 的 mask 与 maskClip 裁剪 canvas，返回是否执行了裁剪
CanvasRenderer.clipCanvas.en: Clip the canvas by the layer mask when maskClip is on, returning whether clipping occurred.

CanvasRenderer.drawTile.zh: 将瓦片图像按位置、透明度与地图旋转绘制到当前 canvas 上下文
CanvasRenderer.drawTile.en: Draw a tile image onto the canvas context with its position, opacity and map rotation.

CanvasRenderer.isDrawable.zh: 判断渲染器能否绘制，map 有 pitch 时返回 false 并告警清空 canvas
CanvasRenderer.isDrawable.en: Whether the renderer can draw; false and a warning when the map is pitched, as canvas cannot render pitch.

CanvasRenderer.loadTile.zh: 创建瓦片 canvas 并调用 layer.drawTile 绘制
CanvasRenderer.loadTile.en: Create the tile canvas and call layer.drawTile to paint it, then run onTileLoad or onTileError.

CanvasRenderer.needToRedraw.zh: 判断是否需要重绘，倾斜、旋转缩放或强制移动渲染时返回 true
CanvasRenderer.needToRedraw.en: Return whether the renderer needs to redraw, true while pitching, rotating, zooming or forcing render on moving.

CanvasRenderer.onRemove.zh: 渲染器移除时的回调，先清空 canvas 再释放瓦片缓存
CanvasRenderer.onRemove.en: Callback on renderer removal; it clears the canvas and releases the tile caches.

CenterMixin.getMap.zh: 获取几何图形所属的 map 实例
CenterMixin.getMap.en: Get the map instance the geometry belongs to.

CenterMixin.onPositionChanged.zh: 几何图形位置变化后清缓存重绘并派发 positionchange
CenterMixin.onPositionChanged.en: Called after the geometry position changes to clear caches, repaint and fire positionchange.

Circle.animateShow.zh: 圆不做动画，直接调用 show 显示图形
Circle.animateShow.en: Circle does not animate, it calls show to display the geometry directly.

Circle.fromJSON.zh: 由 coordinates、radius 与 options 反序列化出 Circle，并还原其 properties
Circle.fromJSON.en: Deserialize a Circle from coordinates, radius and options, restoring its properties.

Circle.get2DExtent.zh: 获取几何图形在视图点坐标系中的 2D extent，无 map 时返回 null
Circle.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry's 2D extent in view point coordinates at GL resolution, null without a map.

Circle.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何图形的高度，取自 altitude 属性或坐标 z 值，缺省为 0
Circle.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry's altitude from its altitude property or coordinate z, defaulting to 0.

Circle.getCoordinates.zh: 获取几何图形的中心点 coordinate
Circle.getCoordinates.en: Get the center coordinate of the geometry.

Circle.getGeometries.zh: 可选接口方法，集合类几何图形用它返回子 geometry 数组
Circle.getGeometries.en: Optional interface method returning the child geometries of a collection geometry.

Circle.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何图形高度的最大值，按高度缓存惰性计算
Circle.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude of the geometry, computed lazily and then cached.

Circle.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何图形高度的最小值，按高度缓存惰性计算
Circle.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude of the geometry, computed lazily and then cached.

Circle.getOutline.zh: 获取几何图形 extent 生成的轮廓 Polygon，无 painter 时返回 null
Circle.getOutline.en: Get an outline Polygon built from the geometry extent, or null when it has no painter.

Circle.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 可选接口方法，返回几何图形坐标旋转时的偏移角度
Circle.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Optional interface method returning the offset angle used when rotating the geometry coordinates.

Circle.getTextDesc.zh: 获取几何图形的文本描述，由 symbol 与 textContent 分行计算并缓存
Circle.getTextDesc.en: Get the geometry's cached text description, computed by splitting textContent into rows.

Circle.hasAltitude.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否具有非零的高度值
Circle.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any non-zero altitude value.

Circle.hasHoles.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否带有洞，圆始终没有洞
Circle.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has any holes inside; a circle never has any.

Circle.isRotated.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否已被旋转
Circle.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated.

Circle.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的可选生命周期回调
Circle.onAdd.en: Optional lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is added to a layer.

Circle.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时的生命周期回调，写入新 properties 并在需要时重绘
Circle.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; applies new properties and repaints when needed.

Circle.onHide.zh: geometry 隐藏时的生命周期回调，关闭其菜单与信息窗口
Circle.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; closes its menu and info window.

Circle.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 positionchange 事件
Circle.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a position change; clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

Circle.onRemove.zh: geometry 从 layer 移除时的可选生命周期回调
Circle.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from a layer.

Circle.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 shapechange 事件
Circle.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a shape change; clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

Circle.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时的回调，刷新 symbol 并派发 symbolchange 事件
Circle.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a symbol change; refreshes the symbol and fires symbolchange.

Circle.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的高度，同步更新 properties 与坐标的 z 值
Circle.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude, updating properties and coordinate z values.

Circle.setCoordinates.zh: 设置圆心的坐标，并触发 positionchange 事件
Circle.setCoordinates.en: Sets the center coordinate of the circle and fires positionchange.

Class.proxyOptions.zh: 用 Proxy 包装 options，使直接赋值也触发 config 更新
Class.proxyOptions.en: Wraps options with a Proxy so direct assignment also triggers a config update.

Class.setOptions.zh: 已废弃的私有方法，直接写入 options 并提示改用 config
Class.setOptions.en: Deprecated private method that writes options directly and warns to use config instead.

CommonProjection.code.zh: 投影的编码，公共投影默认为空字符串
CommonProjection.code.en: The projection code, an empty string for the common projection.

CommonProjection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长即球面 extent 宽高，结果会缓存
CommonProjection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere projection circumference, the width and height of the sphere extent, cached.

CommonProjection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，由投影经纬度极值算出并缓存
CommonProjection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent computed by projecting lon-lat extremes, cached.

CommonProjection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
CommonProjection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

Compass.onAdd.zh: 控件添加时按地图方位角同步指北针的旋转角度
Compass.onAdd.en: Rotates the compass to the map bearing when the control is added.

Compass.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时的生命周期回调，position 变化时更新控件位置
Compass.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; updates the control position when position changes.

Compass.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时解绑地图视图事件并清理指北针缓存
Compass.onRemove.en: Unbinds map view events and clears the compass cache when the control is removed.

ConnectorLine.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 反序列化出 geometry，按 subType 选择对应类
ConnectorLine.fromJSON.en: Deserializes a geometry from JSON, picking the class by subType.

ConnectorLine.get2DExtent.zh: 获取 geometry 在当前 zoom 下投影到屏幕像素的范围，无地图时返回 null
ConnectorLine.get2DExtent.en: Gets the geometry projected extent in screen pixels at the current zoom, null without a map.

ConnectorLine.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的高度，优先取 properties 再取坐标 z 值
ConnectorLine.getAltitude.en: Gets the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z values.

ConnectorLine.getCoordinates.zh: 获取连接线的坐标数组，即源与目标之间的两个连接点
ConnectorLine.getCoordinates.en: Gets the coordinates of the connector line, the two points between source and target.

ConnectorLine.getGeometries.zh: 获取该 geometry 包含的子 geometry 数组
ConnectorLine.getGeometries.en: Gets the child geometries contained in this geometry.

ConnectorLine.getHoles.zh: 获取该 geometry 内环即洞的坐标数组，没有洞时为空数组
ConnectorLine.getHoles.en: Gets the hole rings coordinates of the geometry, an empty array if it has none.

ConnectorLine.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取该 geometry 的最大高度值
ConnectorLine.getMaxAltitude.en: Gets the maximum altitude of the geometry.

ConnectorLine.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取该 geometry 的最小高度值
ConnectorLine.getMinAltitude.en: Gets the minimum altitude of the geometry.

ConnectorLine.getOutline.zh: 获取该 geometry 外包框的轮廓 Polygon
ConnectorLine.getOutline.en: Gets an outline Polygon of the geometry extent.

ConnectorLine.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取该 geometry 旋转时使用的偏移角度
ConnectorLine.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Gets the offset angle used when rotating the geometry.

ConnectorLine.getShell.zh: 获取该 geometry 外环的坐标数组
ConnectorLine.getShell.en: Gets the outer ring coordinates of the geometry.

ConnectorLine.getTextDesc.zh: 获取 symbol 文本按 properties 解析后的文本描述
ConnectorLine.getTextDesc.en: Gets the text descriptions resolved from the symbol text content and properties.

ConnectorLine.hasAltitude.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否具有非零的高度值
ConnectorLine.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any non-zero altitude value.

ConnectorLine.hasHoles.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否带有洞
ConnectorLine.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has any holes inside.

ConnectorLine.isRotated.zh: 判断该 geometry 是否已被旋转
ConnectorLine.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated.

ConnectorLine.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的生命周期回调，注册连接事件并刷新连线坐标
ConnectorLine.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is added to a layer; registers connect events and updates coordinates.

ConnectorLine.onConfig.zh: 配置项变更时的生命周期回调，写入新 properties 并在需要时重绘
ConnectorLine.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on option changes; applies new properties and repaints when needed.

ConnectorLine.onHide.zh: geometry 隐藏时的生命周期回调，关闭其菜单与信息窗口
ConnectorLine.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; closes its menu and info window.

ConnectorLine.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 positionchange 事件
ConnectorLine.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a position change; clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

ConnectorLine.onRemove.zh: geometry 被移除时的生命周期回调，解绑连接源与目标上的事件
ConnectorLine.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is removed; unbinds events on its connect source and target.

ConnectorLine.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的生命周期回调，清缓存重绘并派发 shapechange 事件
ConnectorLine.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a shape change; clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

ConnectorLine.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时的生命周期回调，刷新 symbol 并派发 symbolchange
ConnectorLine.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after a symbol change; refreshes the symbol and fires symbolchange.

ConnectorLine.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的高度，同步更新 properties 与坐标的 z 值
ConnectorLine.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude, updating properties and coordinate z values.

ConnectorLine.setCoordinates.zh: 设置连接线的坐标并派发 shapechange 事件
ConnectorLine.setCoordinates.en: Sets new coordinates to the connector line and fires shapechange.

Control.onAdd.zh: 控件添加到 map 后的可选回调，由子类实现
Control.onAdd.en: Optional callback invoked after the control is added to a map; implemented by subclasses.

Control.onConfig.zh: 配置中含 position 时重新计算并更新控件位置
Control.onConfig.en: Recomputes and updates the control position when the config contains a position option.

Control.onRemove.zh: 控件从 map 移除后的可选回调，由子类实现
Control.onRemove.en: Optional callback invoked after the control is removed from a map; implemented by subclasses.

Coordinate.toNumberArrays.zh: 将 Coordinate 或坐标数组转为 GeoJSON 风格的坐标数组
Coordinate.toNumberArrays.en: Converts one or more Coordinate objects into GeoJSON style coordinate arrays.

CrossCutAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到 layer，在 layer 就绪后初始化分析渲染 pass
CrossCutAnalysis.addTo.en: Adds the analysis to a layer and sets up its pass once the layer is ready.

CrossCutAnalysis.disable.zh: 关闭该分析效果并请求图层重绘
CrossCutAnalysis.disable.en: Disables the analysis effect and requests a redraw of the layer.

CrossCutAnalysis.enable.zh: 开启该分析效果并请求图层重绘
CrossCutAnalysis.enable.en: Enables the analysis effect and requests a redraw of the layer.

CrossCutAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 渲染分析结果并读回像素，返回 RGBA 字节数组，未启用时返回 null
CrossCutAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Renders the analysis and reads back the framebuffer as an RGBA byte array, null when disabled.

CrossCutAnalysis.getAltitudes.zh: 沿剖面线等距取点拾取高程，返回各点 coordinate 与 distance 数组
CrossCutAnalysis.getAltitudes.en: Samples altitudes at evenly spaced points along the cut line and returns coordinate and distance entries.

CrossCutAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，本类为 crosscutAnalysis
CrossCutAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Gets the analysis type identifier, crosscutAnalysis for this class.

CrossCutAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader define，开启 HAS_CROSSCUT 宏
CrossCutAnalysis.getDefines.en: Returns the shader defines that enable the HAS_CROSSCUT macro.

CrossCutAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与该分析的 layer id 列表，未设置时为空数组
CrossCutAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Returns ids of layers excluded from the analysis, an empty array if unset

CrossCutAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 是否启用该分析，默认启用
CrossCutAnalysis.isEnable.en: Whether the analysis is enabled, enabled by default

CrossCutAnalysis.remove.zh: 从 layer 移除该分析并释放其渲染与拾取资源
CrossCutAnalysis.remove.en: Removes the analysis from its layer and disposes its pass and picking resources

CrossCutAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染剖面分析，返回含 cutLineColor 与 crosscutMap 的 uniform
CrossCutAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Renders the cross-cut analysis and returns uniforms with cutLineColor and crosscutMap

CrossCutAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与该分析的 layer id 列表
CrossCutAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Sets the ids of layers excluded from the analysis

CrossCutAnalysis.update.zh: 更新分析参数，cutLine 变化时重建范围并刷新拾取
CrossCutAnalysis.update.en: Updates an analysis option, rebuilding the extent and refreshing picking when cutLine changes

CubicBezierCurve.fromJSON.zh: 由 feature 坐标与 options 反序列化出 CubicBezierCurve，并还原其 properties
CubicBezierCurve.fromJSON.en: Restores a CubicBezierCurve from JSON feature coordinates and options and reapplies its properties

CubicBezierCurve.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下 geometry 的屏幕像素范围，未加到地图时返回 null
CubicBezierCurve.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry's 2D pixel extent at current zoom, null if not on a map

CubicBezierCurve.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的海拔，取 properties 或坐标 z 值，缺省为 0
CubicBezierCurve.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z, 0 when absent

CubicBezierCurve.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 curve 的坐标数组

CubicBezierCurve.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中的子 geometry 数组
CubicBezierCurve.getGeometries.en: Returns child geometries of the geometry collection

CubicBezierCurve.getHoles.zh: 获取多边形的洞 ring 坐标，没有洞则返回空数组
CubicBezierCurve.getHoles.en: Returns hole rings of the polygon, an empty array if it has none

CubicBezierCurve.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 内部计算出的最大海拔
CubicBezierCurve.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude computed for the geometry

CubicBezierCurve.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 内部计算出的最小海拔
CubicBezierCurve.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude computed for the geometry

CubicBezierCurve.getOutline.zh: 获取 geometry 范围对应的 outline polygon，无则返回 null
CubicBezierCurve.getOutline.en: Returns an outline polygon of the geometry's extent, null without a painter

CubicBezierCurve.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取图形旋转时叠加的角度偏移量，供 sector 等特殊图形使用
CubicBezierCurve.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the rotation offset angle in degrees used by special shapes like sector

CubicBezierCurve.getShell.zh: 获取多边形的外壳 ring 坐标，没有则返回空数组
CubicBezierCurve.getShell.en: Returns shell ring coordinates of the polygon, an empty array if none

CubicBezierCurve.getTextDesc.zh: 获取缓存的文本描述，由 symbol 的 textName 与 properties 生成
CubicBezierCurve.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description built from symbol textName and properties

CubicBezierCurve.hasAltitude.zh: geometry 是否含有非零海拔
CubicBezierCurve.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

CubicBezierCurve.hasHoles.en: Whether the polygon has any holes

CubicBezierCurve.isRotated.zh: geometry 是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
CubicBezierCurve.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry is rotated with both an angle and a pivot set

CubicBezierCurve.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 之后的生命周期回调
CubicBezierCurve.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer

CubicBezierCurve.onConfig.zh: 配置更新时的回调，应用 properties 并在箭头或平滑参数变化时重绘
CubicBezierCurve.onConfig.en: Config update callback applying properties and repainting on arrow or smooth changes

CubicBezierCurve.onHide.zh: geometry 被隐藏时的回调，关闭其菜单与 info window
CubicBezierCurve.onHide.en: Callback when the geometry is hidden, closing its menu and info window

CubicBezierCurve.onPositionChanged.zh: geometry 位置变化时的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
CubicBezierCurve.onPositionChanged.en: Callback when position changes, clearing caches, repainting and firing positionchange

CubicBezierCurve.onRemove.zh: 从 layer 移除时的可选回调，CubicBezierCurve 未实现
CubicBezierCurve.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback when removed from a layer; not implemented by CubicBezierCurve

CubicBezierCurve.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化后的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 shapechange
CubicBezierCurve.onShapeChanged.en: Callback after a shape change, clearing caches, repainting and firing shapechange

CubicBezierCurve.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化后的回调，刷新 symbol 并触发 symbolchange
CubicBezierCurve.onSymbolChanged.en: Callback after a symbol change, refreshing the symbol and firing symbolchange

CubicBezierCurve.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的 altitude，同时改写坐标的 z 值
CubicBezierCurve.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and updates the z value of its coordinates

CubicBezierCurve.setCoordinates.zh: 设置曲线的新 coordinates 并触发 shapechange
CubicBezierCurve.setCoordinates.en: Sets new coordinates for the curve and fires shapechange

Curve.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 反序列化出几何图形，子类覆盖以构造自身类型
Curve.fromJSON.en: Deserializes a geometry from JSON; subclasses override it to build their own type

Curve.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下 geometry 的屏幕像素范围，未加地图时返回 null
Curve.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry 2D pixel extent at current zoom, null if not on a map

Curve.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的海拔，取 properties 或坐标 z 值，缺省为 0
Curve.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z, 0 when absent

Curve.getCoordinates.zh: 获取曲线的坐标数组，即构成曲线的 coordinate 列表
Curve.getCoordinates.en: Returns the curve coordinates, the coordinate list forming the curve

Curve.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合内的子 geometry 数组，可选成员，仅集合类实现
Curve.getGeometries.en: Returns child geometries of the collection; optional member implemented only by collections

Curve.getHoles.zh: 获取几何图形的洞 ring 坐标，可选成员，线状图形不实现
Curve.getHoles.en: Returns hole rings of the geometry; optional member not implemented by line shapes

Curve.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最大海拔
Curve.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among the geometry coordinates

Curve.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最小海拔
Curve.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among the geometry coordinates

Curve.getOutline.zh: 获取 geometry 范围对应的 outline polygon，无则为空
Curve.getOutline.en: Returns an outline polygon of the geometry extent, null without a painter

Curve.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取旋转时叠加的角度偏移，可选成员，仅 sector 等特殊图形实现
Curve.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the rotation offset angle; optional member implemented only by shapes like sector

Curve.getShell.zh: 获取几何图形外壳的 ring 坐标，可选成员，线状图形不实现
Curve.getShell.en: Returns shell ring coordinates of the geometry; optional member not implemented by line shapes

Curve.getTextDesc.zh: 获取由 symbol 的 textName 与 properties 生成的文本描述
Curve.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description built from symbol textName and properties

Curve.hasAltitude.zh: geometry 是否含有非零海拔
Curve.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

Curve.hasHoles.zh: 判断几何图形是否带洞，可选成员，线状图形不实现
Curve.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has holes; optional member not implemented by line shapes

Curve.isRotated.zh: 判断 geometry 是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Curve.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated with both an angle and a pivot

Curve.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的可选生命周期回调，Curve 未实现
Curve.onAdd.en: Optional lifecycle callback when added to a layer; not implemented by Curve

Curve.onConfig.zh: 配置更新时的回调，应用 properties 并在箭头等参数变化时重绘
Curve.onConfig.en: Config update callback applying properties and repainting on arrow or smooth changes

Curve.onHide.zh: geometry 被隐藏时的回调，关闭其菜单与 info window
Curve.onHide.en: Callback when the geometry is hidden, closing its menu and info window

Curve.onPositionChanged.zh: geometry 位置变化时的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 positionchange
Curve.onPositionChanged.en: Callback when position changes, clearing caches, repainting and firing positionchange

Curve.onRemove.zh: geometry 从 layer 移除时的可选生命周期回调，Curve 未实现
Curve.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback when removed from a layer; not implemented by Curve

Curve.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状改变后的回调，清理缓存并重绘，再触发 shapechange 事件
Curve.onShapeChanged.en: Callback after shape changes; clears cache, repaints and fires shapechange

Curve.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化后的回调，刷新绘制并触发 symbolchange 事件
Curve.onSymbolChanged.en: Callback after symbol changes; refreshes painter symbol and fires symbolchange

Curve.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 高度，同步更新 coordinates 的 z 值并重绘
Curve.setAltitude.en: Set the altitude of the geometry, syncing coordinates z and properties, then repaint

Curve.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 curve 的新坐标并触发 shapechange 事件
Curve.setCoordinates.en: Set new coordinates to the curve; fires shapechange

CutAnalysis.addTo.zh: 把裁剪分析添加到 layer，layer 未在 map 上时等待其 add 事件
CutAnalysis.addTo.en: Add the analysis to a layer, waiting for its add event when the layer is not yet on a map

CutAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用裁剪分析并请求 layer 重绘
CutAnalysis.disable.en: Disable the analysis and request a redraw of the layer

CutAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用裁剪分析并请求 layer 重绘
CutAnalysis.enable.en: Enable the analysis and request a redraw of the layer

CutAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 把分析结果渲染到帧缓冲并读取为像素数组，未启用时返回 null
CutAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Render the analysis into a framebuffer and read it back as pixels, or null when disabled

CutAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型，裁剪分析返回 cut
CutAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Get the analysis type, which is cut for the cut analysis

CutAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader define，开启 HAS_CUT 宏
CutAnalysis.getDefines.en: Return the shader defines with the HAS_CUT macro enabled

CutAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与裁剪分析的 layer id 列表
CutAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Get the ids of layers excluded from the analysis

CutAnalysis.remove.zh: 从 layer 移除分析并销毁对应的 pass、mesh 与 picking 资源
CutAnalysis.remove.en: Remove the analysis from its layer and dispose its passes, meshes and picking

CutAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染 cut 分析，返回 meshesMap 与 invisibleMap uniform
CutAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Render the cut analysis and return the meshesMap and invisibleMap uniforms

CutAnalysis.reset.zh: 按配置的 position、rotation、scale 重置裁剪框
CutAnalysis.reset.en: Resets the cut box controller to the configured position, rotation and scale.

CutAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与裁剪分析的 layer id 列表
CutAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Set the ids of layers excluded from the analysis

CutAnalysis.update.zh: 更新裁剪分析的参数并同步渲染选项
CutAnalysis.update.en: Update one option of the analysis and sync its render options

DistanceTool.getEvents.zh: 获取当前绘制模式下需注册到 map 的事件映射表
DistanceTool.getEvents.en: Return the event map of handlers to register on the map for the current mode

DistanceTool.onAdd.zh: 工具加入 map 时的回调，检查并准备绘制模式
DistanceTool.onAdd.en: Callback when the tool is added to a map; checks and prepares its mode

DistanceTool.onDisable.zh: 工具禁用时的回调，还原 map 配置并移除临时绘制图层
DistanceTool.onDisable.en: Callback when the tool is disabled; restores map config and removes temp layers

DistanceTool.onEnable.zh: 工具启用时的回调，创建绘制图层并保存 map 原配置
DistanceTool.onEnable.en: Callback when the tool is enabled; creates the draw layer and saves map config

DistanceTool.remove.zh: 从 map 上移除工具，先禁用再注销 map 上的引用
DistanceTool.remove.en: Remove the tool from its map after disabling it and detaching it from the map

dom.doRemove.zh: 移除 dom 元素上指定事件类型的监听回调
dom.doRemove.en: Remove the listener callback of one event type from the dom element

dom.getDomRuler.zh: 创建一个位于屏幕外的隐藏元素作为测量标尺
dom.getDomRuler.en: Create a hidden element positioned off screen to use as a measuring ruler

dom.isHTML.zh: 是否为含标签的 HTML 字符串
dom.isHTML.en: Whether the string is HTML text containing tags

dom.isMousemoveEventBlocked.zh: 是否为需忽略的 mousemove，按节流时间判断并记录时间
dom.isMousemoveEventBlocked.en: Whether the mousemove should be ignored by throttle time, and record its time

dom.isMoveEvent.zh: 是否为移动类事件，即 mousemove 或 touchmove
dom.isMoveEvent.en: Whether the event type is a move event, that is mousemove or touchmove

dom.preventSelection.zh: 禁止 dom 元素的文本选中与拖拽选择
dom.preventSelection.en: Prevent text selection and drag selection on the dom element

dom.removeTransform.zh: 清除 dom 元素上已设置的 css transform
dom.removeTransform.en: Remove the css transform previously set on the dom element

dom.setTransformMatrix.zh: 把矩阵文本写入 dom 的 css transform，相同则跳过
dom.setTransformMatrix.en: Write the matrix text to the dom css transform, skipping when it is identical

DrawTool.getEvents.zh: 获取当前绘制模式下要绑定的事件处理函数
DrawTool.getEvents.en: Get the event handlers to be bound in the current draw mode

DrawTool.onAdd.zh: 加入地图时校验绘制 mode 是否合法
DrawTool.onAdd.en: Validate whether the draw mode is legal when the tool is added to the map

DrawTool.onDisable.zh: 停用绘制工具，结束绘制并移除绘制图层
DrawTool.onDisable.en: Disable the draw tool, end drawing and remove the draw layer

DrawTool.onEnable.zh: 启用绘制工具，创建绘制图层并备份地图配置
DrawTool.onEnable.en: Enable the draw tool, create the draw layer and back up the map config

DrawTool.remove.zh: 停用该 tool，从地图注销并触发 remove 事件
DrawTool.remove.en: Disable the tool, unregister it from the map and fire the remove event

DrawToolLayer.addGeometry.zh: 添加 geometry 并按类型分发到 marker、line 或 polygon 子图层
DrawToolLayer.addGeometry.en: Adds geometries and dispatches them to the marker, line or polygon sub-layer.

DrawToolLayer.bringToFront.zh: 将 polygon、line、marker 三个子图层依次置顶
DrawToolLayer.bringToFront.en: Brings the polygon, line and marker child layers to the front in that order.

DrawToolLayer.clear.zh: 清空本层及内部 marker、line、polygon 子图层
DrawToolLayer.clear.en: Clears this layer and its inner marker, line and polygon child layers.

DrawToolLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高度，OverlayLayer 固定返回 0
DrawToolLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude; the OverlayLayer implementation always returns 0

DrawToolLayer.getGeometryById.zh: 按 id 在 marker、line、polygon 子图层中查找 geometry，未找到返回 null
DrawToolLayer.getGeometryById.en: Returns the geometry of the given id from the marker, line or polygon child layer, null if not found.

DrawToolLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子图层数组，为可选接口方法，由分组型图层实现
DrawToolLayer.getLayers.en: Get child layers; an optional interface method implemented by group layers

DrawToolLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 marker 子图层的 renderer
DrawToolLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer of the marker sub layer

DrawToolLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按地图 renderer 返回图层应使用的 renderer 类型名
DrawToolLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer type name the layer should use, based on the map renderer

DrawToolLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层，并通知所有 geometry 执行 onHide
DrawToolLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify all geometries to run onHide

DrawToolLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 查询命中的 geometry，为接口方法
DrawToolLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries at a coordinate, an interface method for subclasses

DrawToolLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按容器像素点查询命中的 geometry，为接口方法
DrawToolLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at a container point, an interface method for subclasses

DrawToolLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层加入 map 时按 polygon、line、marker 顺序添加子图层并绑定 removegeo 事件
DrawToolLayer.onAdd.en: Add polygon, line and marker sub layers in order and bind removegeo on add

DrawToolLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 向图层添加 geometry 时，若图层设置了 style 则套用该样式
DrawToolLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Apply the layer style to a geometry when it is added to the layer

DrawToolLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: 图层 canvas 创建完成后的回调，基类为空实现
DrawToolLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created; empty in the base class

DrawToolLayer.onConfig.zh: 图层配置变更时的回调，执行 options hook 并让 renderer 重绘
DrawToolLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on layer config change; runs the options hook and redraws the renderer

DrawToolLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 子 geometry 事件回调，按事件类型更新图层缓存
DrawToolLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Callback for child geometry events, updating the layer cache by event type

DrawToolLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 图层加载完成后的回调，基类为空实现
DrawToolLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Callback after the layer finishes loading; empty in the base class

DrawToolLayer.onRemove.zh: 图层移除时清空 geometry 并销毁三个子图层及其事件绑定
DrawToolLayer.onRemove.en: Clear geometries and destroy the three sub layers and their bindings on remove

DrawToolLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，基类为空实现
DrawToolLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created; empty in the base class

DrawToolLayer.removeGeometry.zh: 从图层列表和对应子图层中移除指定 geometry
DrawToolLayer.removeGeometry.en: Removes the given geometries from the layer list and from their matching child layer.

DrawToolLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 并请求重绘
DrawToolLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw of the layer.

DrawToolLayer.setLayerClass.zh: 设置 DrawToolLayer 绘制 marker、line、polygon 所用的子 layer 类
DrawToolLayer.setLayerClass.en: Set the sub layer classes used by DrawToolLayer to draw markers, lines, polygons

DrawToolLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex 并重新排序地图图层
DrawToolLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index, re-sorting the map layers and updating the renderer.

DrawToolLayer.toJSON.zh: 将 layer 导出为 JSON 对象，含 type、id 与 options
DrawToolLayer.toJSON.en: Exports the layer as a JSON object holding its type, id and options.

Easing.outExpo.zh: 指数缓出函数，快起慢收逼近终点
Easing.outExpo.en: Exponential ease-out function, fast at first then slowing toward the end.

Easing.outQuint.zh: 五次幂缓出函数，起始快末段平缓
Easing.outQuint.en: Quintic ease-out function, fast at the start and gentle at the end.

Ellipse.animateShow.zh: 椭圆不做动画，直接调用 show 显示图形
Ellipse.animateShow.en: Shows the ellipse immediately, Ellipse has no show animation.

Ellipse.fromJSON.zh: 由 coordinates、width、height 与 options 反序列化出 Ellipse
Ellipse.fromJSON.en: Deserializes an Ellipse from coordinates, width, height and options.

Ellipse.get2DExtent.zh: 获取 geometry 在当前地图 GL 分辨率下的二维 extent，无地图时为 null
Ellipse.get2DExtent.en: Gets the geometry's 2D extent at the map's GL resolution, null when it has no map.

Ellipse.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的高度，取自 altitude 属性或坐标 z，未设置时为 0
Ellipse.getAltitude.en: Gets the geometry's altitude from its altitude property or coordinate z, or 0 if unset.

Ellipse.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 ellipse 的中心点 coordinate
Ellipse.getCoordinates.en: Gets the center coordinate of the ellipse.

Ellipse.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中包含的 geometry 数组
Ellipse.getGeometries.en: Gets the geometries contained in the geometry collection.

Ellipse.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最大高度值
Ellipse.getMaxAltitude.en: Gets the maximum altitude among the geometry's coordinates.

Ellipse.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最小高度值
Ellipse.getMinAltitude.en: Gets the minimum altitude among the geometry's coordinates.

Ellipse.getOutline.zh: 获取依据 geometry extent 生成的外框 polygon
Ellipse.getOutline.en: Gets an outline polygon built from the geometry's extent.

Ellipse.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取 geometry 旋转时为对齐外壳而补偿的偏移角度
Ellipse.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Gets the offset angle used to compensate the geometry's rotation.

Ellipse.getTextDesc.zh: 获取由 symbol 计算出的文本排版描述，用于文本测量与绘制
Ellipse.getTextDesc.en: Gets the text layout description computed from the geometry's symbol.

Ellipse.hasAltitude.zh: 判断 geometry 是否设置了高度
Ellipse.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any altitude set.

Ellipse.hasHoles.zh: 判断 polygon 是否带有洞
Ellipse.hasHoles.en: Whether the polygon has any holes inside.

Ellipse.isRotated.zh: 判断 geometry 是否已设置旋转角度与旋转中心
Ellipse.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has a rotation angle and a pivot set.

Ellipse.onAdd.zh: 生命周期回调，geometry 添加到 layer 后执行
Ellipse.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer.

Ellipse.onConfig.zh: 生命周期回调，配置变更后重新应用 properties 并按需重绘
Ellipse.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after config changes, reapplying properties and repainting.

Ellipse.onHide.zh: 生命周期回调，geometry 被隐藏时关闭菜单与信息窗口
Ellipse.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden, closing its menu and info window.

Ellipse.onPositionChanged.zh: 生命周期回调，位置变化后清缓存、重绘并派发 positionchange
Ellipse.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after the position changes, clearing caches, repainting and firing positionchange.

Ellipse.onRemove.zh: 生命周期回调，geometry 从 layer 移除时执行
Ellipse.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer.

Ellipse.onShapeChanged.zh: 生命周期回调，形状变化后清缓存、重绘并派发 shapechange
Ellipse.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after the shape changes, clearing caches, repainting and firing shapechange.

Ellipse.onSymbolChanged.zh: 生命周期回调，symbol 变化后刷新绘制并派发 symbolchange
Ellipse.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback after the symbol changes, refreshing the painter and firing symbolchange.

Ellipse.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的高度，同步写入 properties 与坐标 z
Ellipse.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry's altitude on its properties and coordinate z.

Ellipse.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 ellipse 的中心点 coordinate
Ellipse.setCoordinates.en: Sets a new center coordinate to the ellipse.

EPSG3857Projection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
EPSG3857Projection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

EPSG3857Projection.maxLatitude.zh: 墨卡托投影支持的最大纬度，约 85.051
EPSG3857Projection.maxLatitude.en: The maximum latitude supported by the Mercator projection, about 85.051.

EPSG3857Projection.metersPerDegree.zh: 每度经纬度对应的米数，按赤道半径 6378137 计算
EPSG3857Projection.metersPerDegree.en: Meters per degree of longitude and latitude, using the equatorial radius 6378137.

EPSG3857Projection.project.zh: 把经纬度投影为 EPSG:3857 平面坐标，纬度超出会被截断
EPSG3857Projection.project.en: Projects a lnglat coordinate to EPSG:3857 plane coordinates, clamping the latitude.

EPSG3857Projection.rad.zh: 角度转弧度的换算系数，即 PI 除以 180
EPSG3857Projection.rad.en: The conversion factor from degrees to radians, PI divided by 180.

EPSG3857Projection.unproject.zh: 把 EPSG:3857 平面坐标反算回经纬度
EPSG3857Projection.unproject.en: Unprojects EPSG:3857 plane coordinates back to a lnglat coordinate.

EPSG4326Projection.aliases.zh: 投影的别名数组，含 EPSG:4490
EPSG4326Projection.aliases.en: The projection alias list, containing EPSG:4490.

EPSG4326Projection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长即球面 extent 宽高，结果会缓存
EPSG4326Projection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere circumference, the size of the sphere extent, cached after the first call.

EPSG4326Projection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，由投影经纬度极值算出并缓存
EPSG4326Projection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent computed from the projected lnglat limits, cached after the first call.

EPSG4326Projection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
EPSG4326Projection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

EPSG4326Projection.project.zh: 将地理坐标投影为投影坐标，可写入传入的 out 对象
EPSG4326Projection.project.en: Projects a coordinate into projection space, writing the result into out when it is given.

EPSG4326Projection.unproject.zh: 将投影坐标还原为地理坐标，可写入传入的 out 对象
EPSG4326Projection.unproject.en: Unprojects a coordinate back to lnglat space, writing the result into out when it is given.

EPSG9807Projection.aliases.zh: 投影的别名数组，含 Traverse_Mercator
EPSG9807Projection.aliases.en: The projection alias list, containing Traverse_Mercator.

EPSG9807Projection.centralMeridian.zh: 投影的中央经线，默认 0 度
EPSG9807Projection.centralMeridian.en: The central meridian of the projection, 0 degrees by default.

EPSG9807Projection.code.en: The code of the EPSG:9807 projection.

EPSG9807Projection.create.zh: 按假东假北、比例因子与中央经线等参数创建横轴墨卡托投影
EPSG9807Projection.create.en: Creates a Traverse Mercator projection from the false easting, false northing and scale factor params.

EPSG9807Projection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长，EPSG9807 非球面投影故返回 undefined
EPSG9807Projection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere circumference; EPSG:9807 is not spherical, so it returns undefined.

EPSG9807Projection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，EPSG9807 非球面投影故返回 undefined
EPSG9807Projection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent; EPSG:9807 is not spherical, so it returns undefined.

EPSG9807Projection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
EPSG9807Projection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#add.zh: gltf marker 添加到 layer 时触发
Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#add.en: Fired when a gltf marker is added to the layer.

Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#load.zh: marker 的 gltf 模型数据加载完成时触发
Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#load.en: Fired when the marker gltf data is loaded and passed to the marker.

Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#setstyle.zh: layer 的 style 设置后触发
Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#setstyle.en: Fired after the layer style is set.

Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#updatesymbol.zh: 更新 style 中指定位置的 symbol 后触发
Event:AbstractGLTFLayer#updatesymbol.en: Fired after the symbol at the given style index is updated.

Event:CanvasRenderer#canvascreate.zh: layer 的 canvas 与其绘制上下文创建后触发
Event:CanvasRenderer#canvascreate.en: Fired when the layer canvas and its context are created.

Event:CanvasRenderer#renderstart.en: Fired when the layer is ready and starts to render.

Event:Circle#shapechange.en: Fired after the circle radius changes.

Event:Control#add.zh: Control 添加到 map 上时触发
Event:Control#add.en: Fired when the control is added to a map.

Event:Control#positionchange.en: Fired after the control position is updated.

Event:Control#remove.zh: Control 从 map 上移除时触发
Event:Control#remove.en: Fired when the control is removed from the map.

Event:Ellipse#shapechange.zh: Ellipse 宽度或高度改变后触发
Event:Ellipse#shapechange.en: Fired when the ellipse width or height changes.

Event:Geo3DTilesLayer#loadtileset.zh: tileset 加载并解析成瓦片树后触发
Event:Geo3DTilesLayer#loadtileset.en: Fired when a tileset is loaded and parsed, carrying tileset, index and url.

Event:Geo3DTilesLayer#rootready.zh: 各 service 的根瓦片创建完成后触发
Event:Geo3DTilesLayer#rootready.en: Fired after the root tiles of all services are created.

Event:GeoJSONVectorTileLayer#dataerror.zh: geojson 数据加载或解析出错时触发
Event:GeoJSONVectorTileLayer#dataerror.en: Fired when the geojson data fails to load or parse, carrying the error.

Event:GeoJSONVectorTileLayer#dataload.zh: geojson 数据处理完成并返回 extent 时触发
Event:GeoJSONVectorTileLayer#dataload.en: Fired when the geojson data is processed and its extent is returned.

Event:Geometry#shapechange.en: Fired when the shape of a geometry changes.

Event:GeometryCollection#editend.zh: geometry collection 结束编辑时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#editend.en: Fired when the editing of the geometry collection ends.

Event:GeometryCollection#editstart.zh: geometry collection 开始编辑时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#editstart.en: Fired when the editing of the geometry collection starts.

Event:GeometryCollection#hide.en: Fired when the geometry collection is hidden together with its child geometries.

Event:GeometryCollection#redoedit.zh: geometry collection 重做一个子 geometry 的编辑时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#redoedit.en: Fired when one child geometry edit is redone in the collection.

Event:GeometryCollection#remove.zh: GeometryCollection 从 layer 中移除后触发
Event:GeometryCollection#remove.en: Fired after the GeometryCollection is removed from its layer.

Event:GeometryCollection#removeend.zh: GeometryCollection 移除动作结束时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#removeend.en: Fired when the removal of the GeometryCollection ends.

Event:GeometryCollection#removestart.zh: GeometryCollection 开始从 layer 中移除时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#removestart.en: Fired when the GeometryCollection starts to be removed from its layer.

Event:GeometryCollection#shapechange.zh: GeometryCollection 包含的图形改变后触发
Event:GeometryCollection#shapechange.en: Fired after the shape of a geometry in the collection changes.

Event:GeometryCollection#show.en: Fired when the GeometryCollection is shown.

Event:GeometryCollection#undoedit.zh: geometry collection 撤销一个子 geometry 的编辑时触发
Event:GeometryCollection#undoedit.en: Fired when one child geometry edit is undone in the collection.

Event:GeometryEditor#editrecord.zh: 编辑操作被记录进编辑历史时触发
Event:GeometryEditor#editrecord.en: Fired when an edit operation is recorded into the editor history.

Event:GeometryEditor#handleremove.zh: 编辑中删除控制顶点后触发
Event:GeometryEditor#handleremove.en: Fired after a control vertex is removed during geometry editing.

Event:GeometryEditor#remove.zh: 编辑器停止编辑并移除编辑控件时触发
Event:GeometryEditor#remove.en: Fired when the editor stops editing and its controls are removed.

Event:GeometryEditor#resizing.zh: 拖动手柄调整 geometry 尺寸过程中触发
Event:GeometryEditor#resizing.en: Fired on the geometry while its size is adjusted by dragging a resize handle.

Event:GLTFLayer#modelerror.zh: gltf 模型加载或解析失败时触发，携带 url 与错误信息
Event:GLTFLayer#modelerror.en: Fired when a gltf model fails to load or parse, carrying its url and error info.

Event:GLTFLayer#modelload.zh: layer 上所有 marker 的 gltf 模型加载完成后触发
Event:GLTFLayer#modelload.en: Fired when all gltf models of the markers on the layer are loaded.

Event:GLTFMarker#createscene-debug.zh: 用于调试，gltf mesh 生成完成后触发
Event:GLTFMarker#createscene-debug.en: Fired for debugging after the gltf meshes of the marker are created.

Event:GLTFMarker#load.zh: gltf 数据加载并创建 mesh 完成后触发
Event:GLTFMarker#load.en: Fired after the gltf data is loaded and its meshes are created.

Event:GLTFMarker#setUrl-debug.zh: 用于调试，setUrl 后 gltf 场景创建完成时触发
Event:GLTFMarker#setUrl-debug.en: Fired for debugging when setUrl finishes creating the gltf scene.

Event:GLTFMarker#smallonscreen.zh: 模型在屏幕上的像素尺寸小于 20 时触发
Event:GLTFMarker#smallonscreen.en: Fired when the model is smaller than 20 pixels on screen.

Event:GLTFMarker#updatematrix.zh: marker 的 mesh 变换矩阵更新后触发
Event:GLTFMarker#updatematrix.en: Fired after the transform matrices of the marker meshes are updated.

Event:GroupGLLayer#layerload.zh: group layer 派发 layerload 时，渲染完成的子 layer 也各自触发
Event:GroupGLLayer#layerload.en: Fired when the group layer fires layerload; child layers whose renderer is complete fire it too.

Event:GroupGLLayer#terrainlayercreated.zh: group layer 的地形 layer 创建并配置完成后触发
Event:GroupGLLayer#terrainlayercreated.en: Fired when the terrain layer of the group layer is created and configured.

Event:GroupGLLayer#terrainlayerremoved.zh: group layer 的地形 layer 移除后触发
Event:GroupGLLayer#terrainlayerremoved.en: Fired when the terrain layer of the group layer is removed.

Event:Layer#add.zh: layer 添加到 map 上后触发
Event:Layer#add.en: Fired after the layer is added to a map.

Event:Layer#remove.zh: layer 从 map 上移除后触发
Event:Layer#remove.en: Fired after the layer is removed from the map.

Event:LayerSwitcher#layerchange.zh: 在图层切换控件中切换图层显示或底图时触发
Event:LayerSwitcher#layerchange.en: Fired when a layer is toggled or the base layer is switched in the layer switcher.

Event:LayerSwitcher#setbaselayer.zh: 在图层切换控件中选中底图 layer 时触发
Event:LayerSwitcher#setbaselayer.en: Fired when a base layer is selected in the layer switcher control.

Event:LineString#shapechange.en: Fired when the coordinates of the LineString change.

Event:Map#fovchange.zh: map 的 fov 改变后触发
Event:Map#fovchange.en: Fired after the fov of the map changed.

Event:Map#pitchstart.zh: map 开始改变 pitch 时触发
Event:Map#pitchstart.en: Fired when the map starts to change its pitch.

Event:Map#remove.zh: map 移除其上的 layer 时，被移除的 layer 各自触发
Event:Map#remove.en: Fired on each removed layer when the map removes its layers.

Event:Map#removeend.en: Fired after the map is completely removed.

Event:Map#removestart.en: Fired when the map starts to be removed.

Event:Map#rotate.zh: 已废弃的 rotateend 别名，map 旋转角度改变时触发
Event:Map#rotate.en: Deprecated alias of rotateend, fired when the map bearing changes.

Event:Map#rotateend.en: Fired when the map finishes rotating.

Event:Map#rotatestart.en: Fired when the map starts to rotate.

Event:Map#syncworld.zh: map 中心点超出球面范围并被回绕修正时触发
Event:Map#syncworld.en: Fired when the map center is out of the sphere and wrapped back into it.

Event:Menu#closemenu.zh: 菜单项被点击并关闭菜单后触发
Event:Menu#closemenu.en: Fired after a menu item is clicked and the menu is hidden.

Event:OverlayLayer#add.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时触发
Event:OverlayLayer#add.en: Fired when a geometry is added to the layer.

Event:Overview#load.zh: overview 地图与视野框创建完成时触发
Event:Overview#load.en: Fired when the overview map and its perspective polygon are created.

Event:Panel#close.zh: 点击面板上的关闭按钮时触发
Event:Panel#close.en: Fired when the close button on the panel is clicked.

Event:Panel#dragend.en: Fired when the panel drag ends.

Event:Panel#dragging.zh: panel 正在被拖动时触发
Event:Panel#dragging.en: Fired while the panel is being dragged.

Event:Panel#dragstart.zh: 开始拖动 panel 时触发
Event:Panel#dragstart.en: Fired when the panel drag starts.

Event:Polygon#shapechange.en: Fired after the polygon coordinates change.

Event:Rectangle#positionchange.zh: Rectangle 位置坐标改变后触发
Event:Rectangle#positionchange.en: Fired after the rectangle position changes.

Event:Rectangle#shapechange.zh: Rectangle 宽度或高度改变后触发
Event:Rectangle#shapechange.en: Fired after the rectangle width or height changes.

Event:Sector#shapechange.zh: Sector 半径或起止角度改变后触发
Event:Sector#shapechange.en: Fired after the sector radius or start and end angles change.

Event:TextMarker#contentchange.zh: label 的文本内容改变时触发
Event:TextMarker#contentchange.en: Fired when the text content of the label is changed.

Event:TileLayer#forcereloadend.zh: forceReload 清除并重载全部缓存 tile 结束时触发
Event:TileLayer#forcereloadend.en: Fired when forceReload finishes clearing and reloading all cached tiles.

Event:TileLayer#forcereloadstart.zh: forceReload 清除并重载全部缓存 tile 开始时触发
Event:TileLayer#forcereloadstart.en: Fired when forceReload starts clearing and reloading all cached tiles.

Event:UIComponent#add.en: Fired when the UI component is added to a map or a geometry.

Event:UIComponent#hide.en: Fired when the UIComponent is hidden

Event:UIComponent#mouseout.zh: 鼠标移出 UIComponent 时触发
Event:UIComponent#mouseout.en: Fired when the mouse leaves the UIComponent

Event:UIComponent#mouseover.zh: 鼠标移入 UIComponent 时触发
Event:UIComponent#mouseover.en: Fired when the mouse enters the UIComponent

Event:UIComponent#remove.zh: UIComponent 从 map 或图形上移除时触发
Event:UIComponent#remove.en: Fired when the UIComponent is removed from its map or geometry

Event:UIComponent#showend.en: Fired when the UIComponent finishes showing

Event:UIComponent#showstart.en: Fired when the UIComponent starts to show

Event:UIMarker#contentchange.en: Fired when the UIMarker content is set again.

Event:UIMarker#positionchange.en: Fired after the UIMarker coordinates are set again.

Event:UIMarker#showend.en: Fired when the UIMarker finishes showing

Event:UIMarker#showstart.en: Fired when the UIMarker starts to show

Event:VectorLayer#positionchange.zh: layer 的 altitude 配置变化使 geometry 位置重算时触发
Event:VectorLayer#positionchange.en: Fired when altitude related config changes and geometry positions are recomputed.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatedataconfig.zh: layer 级 style 的 dataConfig 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatedataconfig.en: Fired after the dataConfig of a layer style is updated.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturedatac.zh: 要素级 style 的 dataConfig 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturedatac.en: Fired after the dataConfig of a feature style is updated.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturescene.zh: 要素级 style 的 sceneConfig 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturescene.en: Fired after the sceneConfig of a feature style is updated.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturesymbo.zh: 要素级 style 的 symbol 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatefeaturesymbo.en: Fired after the symbol of a feature style is updated.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatesceneconfig.zh: layer 级 style 的 sceneConfig 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatesceneconfig.en: Fired after the sceneConfig of a layer style is updated.

Event:VectorTileLayer#updatesymbol.zh: layer 级 style 的 symbol 更新后触发
Event:VectorTileLayer#updatesymbol.en: Fired after the symbol of a layer style is updated.

ExcavateAnalysis.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层内 geometry 的描边高亮
ExcavateAnalysis.cancelOutline.en: Cancel the outline highlight of geometries in the layer

ExcavateAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用挖掘分析并重绘图层
ExcavateAnalysis.disable.en: Disables the excavate analysis and requests a redraw of the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用挖掘分析并重绘图层
ExcavateAnalysis.enable.en: Enables the excavate analysis and requests a redraw of the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.excavate.zh: 指定被挖方的 layers 并更新高度图重绘
ExcavateAnalysis.excavate.en: Sets the layers to be excavated, updates the height map and redraws the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名字获取已注册的 3D painter 类
ExcavateAnalysis.get3DPainterClass.en: Get the registered 3D painter class by name

ExcavateAnalysis.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高程，OverlayLayer 固定返回 0
ExcavateAnalysis.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude, which is always 0 for overlay layers

ExcavateAnalysis.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层计算后样式并以 style 字段返回
ExcavateAnalysis.getComputedStyle.en: Get the layer computed style and return it in the style field

ExcavateAnalysis.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的事件映射，含空间参考变化事件
ExcavateAnalysis.getEvents.en: Return the event map the layer listens to, including spatial reference change

ExcavateAnalysis.getExcavatedLayers.zh: 获取被挖方的 layer 列表
ExcavateAnalysis.getExcavatedLayers.en: Returns the layers that are being excavated.

ExcavateAnalysis.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
ExcavateAnalysis.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, implemented only by group type layers

ExcavateAnalysis.getPolygonOffset.zh: 获取图层的 polygonOffset 值，拉伸多边形图层固定返回 0
ExcavateAnalysis.getPolygonOffset.en: Get the layer polygonOffset, always 0 for the extrude polygon layer

ExcavateAnalysis.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh: 获取图层需要的 polygonOffset 数量，拉伸多边形图层固定返回 0
ExcavateAnalysis.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Get the polygonOffset count the layer needs, always 0 for this layer

ExcavateAnalysis.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例
ExcavateAnalysis.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer

ExcavateAnalysis.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
ExcavateAnalysis.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses according to the map renderer

ExcavateAnalysis.getTileSize.zh: 返回 painter 内部使用的默认 tile 尺寸 1x1
ExcavateAnalysis.getTileSize.en: Return the default tile size of 1x1 used internally by painters

ExcavateAnalysis.getTotalPolygonOffset.zh: 获取 GroupGLLayer 分配的 polygonOffset 总数
ExcavateAnalysis.getTotalPolygonOffset.en: Get the total polygonOffset assigned by the GroupGLLayer

ExcavateAnalysis.getURLModifier.zh: 获取改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数
ExcavateAnalysis.getURLModifier.en: Get the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls

ExcavateAnalysis.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有几何体隐藏
ExcavateAnalysis.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify every geometry inside it to hide

ExcavateAnalysis.identify.zh: 查询给定 coordinate 处命中的 geometry 数组
ExcavateAnalysis.identify.en: Identify the geometries hit at the given coordinate and return them

ExcavateAnalysis.identifyAtPoint.zh: 查询给定容器坐标点命中的 geometry，可设容差与数量
ExcavateAnalysis.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at the given container point with optional tolerance and count

ExcavateAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 判断挖掘分析是否已启用
ExcavateAnalysis.isEnable.en: Returns whether the excavate analysis is currently enabled.

ExcavateAnalysis.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
ExcavateAnalysis.onAdd.en: Callback after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses may override

ExcavateAnalysis.onAddGeometry.zh: 几何体加入图层时按图层 style 设置其 symbol
ExcavateAnalysis.onAddGeometry.en: Callback when a geometry joins the layer; applies the layer style to its symbol

ExcavateAnalysis.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ExcavateAnalysis.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override

ExcavateAnalysis.onConfig.zh: 图层配置变更时应用新配置并同步给渲染器
ExcavateAnalysis.onConfig.en: Callback when options change; applies the new config and syncs it to the renderer

ExcavateAnalysis.onGeometryEvent.zh: 响应几何体变化事件，同步图层缓存与 renderer
ExcavateAnalysis.onGeometryEvent.en: Respond to geometry change events and sync the layer cache and renderer

ExcavateAnalysis.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
ExcavateAnalysis.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called after the layer finishes loading, empty by default

ExcavateAnalysis.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，释放侧边 painter 资源
ExcavateAnalysis.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from a map; disposes the side painter

ExcavateAnalysis.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ExcavateAnalysis.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the renderer is created, subclasses may override

ExcavateAnalysis.outline.zh: 为指定 id 数组的 geometry 添加描边高亮
ExcavateAnalysis.outline.en: Add outline highlight to the geometries of the given id array

ExcavateAnalysis.outlineAll.zh: 高亮图层内全部 geometry 的描边
ExcavateAnalysis.outlineAll.en: Highlight the outlines of all geometries in the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.registerPainter.zh: 注册指定名称的 3D painter 类，供 get3DPainterClass 取用
ExcavateAnalysis.registerPainter.en: Register a 3D painter class by name for get3DPainterClass.

ExcavateAnalysis.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 并请求重绘
ExcavateAnalysis.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

ExcavateAnalysis.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层在全局 polygonOffset 管理中的偏移值与总数
ExcavateAnalysis.setPolygonOffset.en: Set the layer polygonOffset value and total for global offset management.

ExcavateAnalysis.setURLModifier.zh: 设置改写资源请求 URL 的函数，返回图层本身
ExcavateAnalysis.setURLModifier.en: Set the function that modifies resource URLs and return the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex 并重排地图上的图层顺序
ExcavateAnalysis.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index and reorders the layers on the map.

ExcavateAnalysis.toJSON.zh: 导出图层的 JSON，含 type、id、options 与全部 geometry
ExcavateAnalysis.toJSON.en: Export the layer JSON with type, id, options and all geometries.

ExcavateAnalysis.updateDataConfig.zh: 合入新的 dataConfig 并更新渲染器，返回图层本身
ExcavateAnalysis.updateDataConfig.en: Merge the new dataConfig into options, update the renderer and return the layer.

ExcavateAnalysis.updateMaterial.zh: 合入主材质参数并更新渲染器，传空则清除材质
ExcavateAnalysis.updateMaterial.en: Merge material options and update the renderer; null clears the material.

ExcavateAnalysis.updateSideMaterial.zh: 合入侧面材质参数并更新渲染器，传空则回退到主材质
ExcavateAnalysis.updateSideMaterial.en: Merge side material options and update the renderer; null falls back to the main material.

ExcavateAnalysis.updateSymbol.zh: 合入指定序号样式的 symbol 并重设图层样式
ExcavateAnalysis.updateSymbol.en: Merge the symbol into the style at index idx and reset the layer style.

Extent.add.zh: 与 coordinate、point 或 extent 相加，返回新的 extent
Extent.add.en: Add a coordinate, point or extent, returning a new extent.

Extent.contains.zh: 判断 extent 是否包含传入的 coordinate 或 extent
Extent.contains.en: Whether the extent contains the given coordinate, point or extent.

Extent.convertTo.zh: 按给定函数转换 extent 的角点，返回新 extent，out 可复用
Extent.convertTo.en: Convert the extent corners with a function, returning a new extent; out can be reused.

Extent.getMax.zh: 获取 extent 的最大点，可传入 out 复用对象
Extent.getMax.en: Get the maximum point of the extent; out can be passed to reuse an object.

Extent.getMin.zh: 获取 extent 的最小点，可传入 out 复用对象
Extent.getMin.en: Get the minimum point of the extent; out can be passed to reuse an object.

Extent.sub.zh: 减去 coordinate、point 或 extent，返回新的 extent
Extent.sub.en: Subtract a coordinate, point or extent, returning a new extent.

Extent.substract.zh: 减去 coordinate、point 或 extent，sub 的别名
Extent.substract.en: Subtract a coordinate, point or extent, an alias for sub.

Extent.toBBOX.zh: 以数组返回 extent 的 xmin ymin xmax ymax
Extent.toBBOX.en: Return the extent as an array of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层上全部描边高亮，返回图层本身
ExtrudePolygonLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancel all outline highlights on the layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名称获取已注册的 3D painter 类
ExtrudePolygonLayer.get3DPainterClass.en: Get the registered 3D painter class by the given name.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层的高度值，OverlayLayer 实现固定返回 0
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude, which the OverlayLayer implementation returns as 0.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层样式对象，以 style 字段包装图层样式
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get the layer style object, wrapping the layer style in a style field.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getEvents.zh: 获取图层监听的 map 事件表，含 spatialreferencechange
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getEvents.en: Get the map events the layer listens to, including spatialreferencechange.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子图层数组，仅容器型图层实现该可选成员
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getLayers.en: Get child layers; only container layers implement this optional member.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getPolygonOffset.zh: 获取图层的 polygonOffset 值，拉伸多边形图层固定返回 0
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getPolygonOffset.en: Get the layer polygonOffset value, which is always 0 for this layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getPolygonOffsetCoun.zh: 获取图层需要的 polygonOffset 数量，拉伸多边形图层固定返回 0
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getPolygonOffsetCoun.en: Get the polygonOffset count the layer needs, which is always 0 for this layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的 renderer 实例，未创建时返回 undefined
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer renderer instance, undefined before it is created.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取图层实际使用的 renderer 名称，WebGL 为 gl，WebGPU 为 gpu
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the effective renderer name, gl on a WebGL map and gpu on a WebGPU map.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getTileSize.zh: 获取 painter 使用的默认 tile size，固定为 1 乘 1
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getTileSize.en: Get the default tile size used by painters, a 1 by 1 Size.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getTotalPolygonOffse.zh: 获取全局分配的 polygonOffset 总数
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getTotalPolygonOffse.en: Get the total polygonOffset assigned by global offset management.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取图层当前的 URL 修改函数
ExtrudePolygonLayer.getURLModifier.en: Get the current URL modifier function of the layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层及其全部 geometry，返回图层本身
ExtrudePolygonLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and all its geometries, returning the layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.identify.zh: 拾取指定 coordinate 处的 geometry，返回 geometry 数组
ExtrudePolygonLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries at the given coordinate and return them as an array.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 拾取容器坐标点处的 geometry，可按容差与数量过滤
ExtrudePolygonLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify the geometries at the given container point, with tolerance, count and filter options.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层添加到地图后的生命周期回调
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer is added to a map.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 向图层添加 geometry 时回调，并按图层样式设置其 symbol
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Callback on each geometry added to the layer, it applies the layer style to the geometry.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的生命周期回调
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the renderer canvas is created.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onConfig.zh: 图层配置变更时应用新配置并同步给渲染器
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onConfig.en: Applies the changed options and forwards the config to the layer renderer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 处理 geometry 的 id、zIndex、位置与 symbol 变化事件
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Handles geometry events such as id, zIndex, position, shape and symbol changes.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 图层加载完成后的生命周期回调
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer finishes loading.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onRemove.zh: 图层从地图移除时的生命周期回调
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the layer is removed from the map.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: 图层 renderer 创建完成后的生命周期回调
ExtrudePolygonLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer renderer is created.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.outline.zh: 高亮指定 id 的 geometry 轮廓
ExtrudePolygonLayer.outline.en: Outlines the geometries with the given ids.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.outlineAll.zh: 高亮图层内全部 geometry 的轮廓
ExtrudePolygonLayer.outlineAll.en: Outlines all the geometries in the layer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.registerPainter.zh: 注册名为 name 的 3D painter 类
ExtrudePolygonLayer.registerPainter.en: Static method registering a 3D painter class under the given name.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 并请求重绘
ExtrudePolygonLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层 polygonOffset 及全局累计值
ExtrudePolygonLayer.setPolygonOffset.en: Sets the layer polygon offset and the total offset used by GroupGLLayer.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置用于改写资源 URL 的函数
ExtrudePolygonLayer.setURLModifier.en: Sets the function used to modify resource URLs before loading.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex 并重排地图上的图层顺序
ExtrudePolygonLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index and reorders the layers on the map.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出图层 JSON，包含配置与全部 geometry
