ExtrudePolygonLayer.toJSON.en: Exports the layer JSON with its options and all geometries.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateDataConfig.zh: 合并新的 dataConfig 并通知渲染器更新图层数据配置
ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateDataConfig.en: Merges the new dataConfig into options and updates the renderer data config.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateMaterial.zh: 更新拉伸多边形顶面的 material 并同步渲染器，传空则清除
ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateMaterial.en: Merges the material options and updates the renderer; null clears the material.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateSideMaterial.zh: 更新拉伸多边形侧面的 material 并同步渲染器，传空则清除
ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateSideMaterial.en: Merges the side material options and updates the renderer; null clears the side material.

ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 更新指定样式索引上的 symbol 属性
ExtrudePolygonLayer.updateSymbol.en: Updates the symbol of the style at the given index and resets the style.

FloodAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到指定 layer，必要时等待其 add 事件
FloodAnalysis.addTo.en: Adds the analysis to a layer, waiting for its add event when the layer is not on a map yet.

FloodAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用该分析并触发重绘
FloodAnalysis.disable.en: Disables the analysis and sets the layer renderer to redraw.

FloodAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用该分析并触发重绘
FloodAnalysis.enable.en: Enables the analysis and sets the layer renderer to redraw.

FloodAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 导出分析结果栅格像素数据
FloodAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Renders the analysis pass and returns its pixel data as a Uint8Array, or null when disabled.

FloodAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Returns the analysis type string, floodAnalysis for this class.

FloodAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader define，开启 HAS_FLOODANALYSE 宏
FloodAnalysis.getDefines.en: Returns the shader defines, enabling the HAS_FLOODANALYSE macro.

FloodAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与分析的图层 id 列表
FloodAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Returns the layer ids excluded from the analysis, an empty array by default.

FloodAnalysis.isEnable.en: Whether the analysis is currently enabled.

FloodAnalysis.remove.zh: 从图层移除该分析并释放相关资源
FloodAnalysis.remove.en: Removes the analysis from its layer and disposes its pass resources.

FloodAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染淹没分析，返回水面颜色透明度与淹没图的 uniform
FloodAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Renders the flood analysis and returns the water color, opacity and flood map uniforms.

FloodAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与该分析的图层 id 列表
FloodAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Sets the ids of the layers excluded from this analysis.

FloodAnalysis.update.zh: 更新分析选项，boundary 与水高变化会重算渲染参数
FloodAnalysis.update.en: Updates an analysis option, boundary and water height changes recompute the render parameters.

Frame.playState.zh: 获取动画帧的播放状态 idle running 或 finished
Frame.playState.en: Gets the play state of the animation frame, idle, running or finished.

Frame.symbol.zh: 获取动画帧的 symbol 样式
Frame.symbol.en: Gets the symbol style of the animation frame.

Geo3DTilesLayer.addService.zh: 添加一个 3DTiles 服务并重建根瓦片节点
Geo3DTilesLayer.addService.en: Adds a 3DTiles service and rebuilds the root tile nodes.

Geo3DTilesLayer.boundingVolumeToExtent.zh: 把瓦片节点的 boundingVolume 换算为经纬度 extent
Geo3DTilesLayer.boundingVolumeToExtent.en: Converts the bounding volume of a tile node into a geographic extent.

Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelAllHighlight.zh: 取消全部高亮，恢复原始颜色与透明度
Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelAllHighlight.en: Cancels all the highlights and restores the original color and opacity.

Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelHighlight.zh: 取消指定 service 中若干 id 的 batch 高亮
Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelHighlight.en: Cancels the batch highlights of the given ids in the given service.

Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelShowOnly.zh: 取消 showOnly 限制，恢复显示全部 batch
Geo3DTilesLayer.cancelShowOnly.en: Cancels the showOnly restriction and shows all the batches again.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getCurrentBatchIDs.zh: 获取当前已绘制瓦片的所有 batch id 与其 service 索引
Geo3DTilesLayer.getCurrentBatchIDs.en: Gets all batch ids of the currently drawn tiles together with their service index.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getEnuTransform.zh: 获取由坐标、缩放与旋转算出的 ENU 变换矩阵
Geo3DTilesLayer.getEnuTransform.en: Gets the ENU transform matrix from the coordinate, scale and rotation.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getExtent.zh: 获取第 index 个服务的 extent，不传索引时合并全部服务
Geo3DTilesLayer.getExtent.en: Gets the extent of the service at index, or the combined extent of all services.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取图层的子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
Geo3DTilesLayer.getLayers.en: Gets the child layer list, only group layers implement it.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的 renderer 实例
Geo3DTilesLayer.getRenderer.en: Gets the renderer instance of the layer.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回图层使用的 renderer 名
Geo3DTilesLayer.getRendererOption.en: Returns the renderer name used by the layer, gl or gpu for a WebGL or WebGPU map, dom otherwise.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getRootTiles.zh: 获取各服务根瓦片节点组成的数组
Geo3DTilesLayer.getRootTiles.en: Gets the array of root tile nodes of the layer services.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getTiles.zh: 获取当前视图按 LOD 查询出的候选瓦片列表
Geo3DTilesLayer.getTiles.en: Gets the candidate tiles queried by LOD for the current view.

Geo3DTilesLayer.getTileUrl.zh: 按 subdomain 列表替换瓦片 URL 中的域名占位符
Geo3DTilesLayer.getTileUrl.en: Gets the tile url with its domain placeholder replaced by a configured subdomain.

Geo3DTilesLayer.hideService.zh: 隐藏指定索引的 3DTiles 服务
Geo3DTilesLayer.hideService.en: Hides the 3DTiles service at the given index.

Geo3DTilesLayer.highlight.zh: 高亮指定 id 的 batch，可设置颜色、透明度与 bloom
Geo3DTilesLayer.highlight.en: Highlights the batches of the given ids, with optional color, opacity and bloom.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层添加到地图后的回调，同时更新 mask 范围
Geo3DTilesLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer is added to a map, it also updates the mask extent.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调
Geo3DTilesLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the renderer canvas is created.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onConfig.zh: 图层 options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
Geo3DTilesLayer.onConfig.en: Callback invoked after options change, marking the layer to redraw and updating attribution.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 图层加载完成后的回调
Geo3DTilesLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer finishes loading.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onRemove.zh: 图层从地图移除时的回调
Geo3DTilesLayer.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the layer is removed from the map.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: 图层 renderer 创建完成后的回调
Geo3DTilesLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer renderer is created.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onTileLoad.zh: 瓦片加载完成时挂载其子节点并记录 baseUrl
Geo3DTilesLayer.onTileLoad.en: Attaches the child nodes of a loaded tile and records its baseUrl.

Geo3DTilesLayer.onTilesetLoad.zh: tileset 加载完成时合并根节点并处理坐标变换
Geo3DTilesLayer.onTilesetLoad.en: Merges the root node and handles coordinate transforms when a tileset finishes loading.

Geo3DTilesLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask，不传参数时清除全部 mask
Geo3DTilesLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the given mask from the layer, or all masks when no mask is passed.

Geo3DTilesLayer.removeService.zh: 移除指定索引的 3DTiles 服务
Geo3DTilesLayer.removeService.en: Removes the 3DTiles service at the given index and requests a redraw.

Geo3DTilesLayer.setServiceDebug.zh: 开启或关闭指定服务的 debug 渲染，显示瓦片包围盒
Geo3DTilesLayer.setServiceDebug.en: Turns debug rendering of the given service on or off to show tile bounding boxes.

Geo3DTilesLayer.setServiceOpacity.zh: 设置指定索引服务的模型透明度并触发重绘
Geo3DTilesLayer.setServiceOpacity.en: Sets the model opacity of the service at the given index and triggers a redraw.

Geo3DTilesLayer.setToRedraw.zh: 把图层标记为需重绘以触发下一次渲染
Geo3DTilesLayer.setToRedraw.en: Marks the layer to redraw so that it is rendered in the next frame.

Geo3DTilesLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex 并重新排序地图上的图层
Geo3DTilesLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer zIndex and re-sorts the layers on the map.

Geo3DTilesLayer.showOnly.zh: 只显示指定 id 与 service 的 batch，其余隐藏
Geo3DTilesLayer.showOnly.en: Shows only the batches of the given ids and services, hiding the others.

Geo3DTilesLayer.showService.zh: 显示指定索引的 3DTiles 服务
Geo3DTilesLayer.showService.en: Shows the 3DTiles service at the given index.

Geo3DTilesLayer.toJSON.en: Exports a snapshot of the layer configuration that fromJSON can rebuild.

Geo3DTilesLayer.updateService.zh: 按索引更新服务的可见性与偏移、缩放等配置
Geo3DTilesLayer.updateService.en: Updates the visibility, offset and scale options of the service at the given index.

GeoJSON.isGeoJSON.zh: 判断给定对象是否为合法的 GeoJSON 数据
GeoJSON.isGeoJSON.en: Checks whether the given object is valid GeoJSON data.

GeoJSON.toGeometry.en: Converts a GeoJSON object or string into maptalks geometries.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.cancelAllHighligh.zh: 取消本图层全部 features 的高亮
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.cancelAllHighligh.en: Cancels the highlight of all the features in the layer.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.cancelHighlight.zh: 取消指定 id 的 features 高亮
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.cancelHighlight.en: Cancels the highlight of the features with the given ids.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.clearData.zh: 清空 renderer 与图层缓存的瓦片数据
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.clearData.en: Clears the tile data cached in the renderer and the layer.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.compressStyleJSON.zh: 压缩样式数组，把 renderPlugin 提取为 plugins 列表
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.compressStyleJSON.en: Compresses a style array, extracting renderPlugin definitions into a plugins list.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.createTileNode.zh: 创建一个瓦片节点，含瓦片范围、url 与父子关系
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.createTileNode.en: Creates a tile node containing the tile extent, url and parent-child relations.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.forceReload.zh: 强制重新加载图层，并清空 worker 中缓存的瓦片
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.forceReload.en: Force reload the layer and clear the tiles cached in the worker.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.fromJSON.zh: 由 layer JSON 反序列化出 GeoJSONVectorTileLayer，type 不符返回 null
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.fromJSON.en: Create a GeoJSONVectorTileLayer from layer JSON; return null when type mismatches.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层计算后的 style 副本，含 background、style 与 featureStyle
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get a copy of the computed style, including background, style and featureStyle.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getData.zh: 获取数据，未就绪时按 url 拉取后回调
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getData.en: Returns the geojson data, or fetches it by url and passes it to the callback when not ready.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getEvents.zh: 获取图层的事件映射，spatial reference 变化时重建瓦片配置
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getEvents.en: Get the layer event map, which resets tile config when spatial reference changes.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getExtent.zh: 获取数据中解析出的 extent
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getExtent.en: Returns the extent parsed from the loaded data.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getFeature.zh: 按 id 获取对应的 feature
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getFeature.en: Returns the feature with the given id, or null when the id map is not ready.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getGeometryById.zh: 按 id 获取对应的 feature
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getGeometryById.en: Returns the feature with the given id, an alias of getFeature.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子图层集合，基类仅作可选声明，由子类实现
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getLayers.en: Get child layers; declared optional on the base class and implemented by subclasses.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getMaxZoom.zh: 获取图层最大 zoom，取 option 与 spatial reference 上限的较小值
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getMaxZoom.en: Get the layer max zoom, the smaller of its option and the spatial reference limit.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getMinZoom.zh: 获取图层最小 zoom，取 option 与 spatial reference 下限的较大值
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getMinZoom.en: Get the layer min zoom, the larger of its option and the spatial reference limit.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getPlugins.zh: 获取已注册到该图层的全部渲染插件
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getPlugins.en: Get all render plugins registered on the layer.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRenderedFeatur.zh: 异步分批获取已渲染的 features，避免长任务阻塞界面
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRenderedFeatur.en: Get rendered features asynchronously in batches to avoid blocking the UI.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的渲染器实例，尚未创建时返回空
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer renderer instance, or nothing when it is not created yet.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取图层实际使用的渲染器类型，WebGL 地图为 gl，WebGPU 为 gpu
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer type in use: gl on a WebGL map, gpu on a WebGPU map.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTileId.zh: 按图层 id 与瓦片 x y zoom 生成瓦片唯一标识
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTileId.en: Build the unique tile id from the layer id and the tile x, y and zoom.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTiles.zh: 获取指定 zoom 下需要渲染的瓦片网格与父瓦片集合
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTiles.en: Get the tile grids and parent tiles to render at the given zoom.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTileUrl.zh: 按瓦片编号拼接出该瓦片的 url 标识
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getTileUrl.en: Build the tile url identifier from the layer id and the tile x, y, z.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getWorkerOptions.zh: 获取传给 worker 的选项，含数据、extent、投影与简化容差
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.getWorkerOptions.en: Get the options passed to the worker: data, extent, projection and simplify tolerance.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.highlight.zh: 高亮指定的 feature，可按 id 或 filter 指定目标
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.highlight.en: Highlight the given features, selected by id or by filter.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.identify.zh: 识别给定坐标处的数据
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.identify.en: Identify features at the given coordinate.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 识别给定屏幕点处的数据，支持容差与结果数量限制
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify features at the given container point with tolerance and count options.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.isDefaultRender.zh: 是否使用默认渲染，即未配置 style 且开启 defaultRendering
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.isDefaultRender.en: Whether the layer uses default rendering: no style set and defaultRendering on.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.isParentTile.zh: 判断瓦片是否落在父子瓦片堆叠保留的 zoom 区间内
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.isParentTile.en: Whether the tile falls in the zoom range kept for parent tile stacking.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.loadFrom.zh: 从 url 获取图层 JSON 并创建图层实例，返回 Promise
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.loadFrom.en: Fetch layer JSON from a url and create the layer instance, returning a Promise.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层加入地图时的生命周期回调，准备投影与瓦片参数
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback when the layer is added, preparing projection and tile options.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: 图层 canvas 创建完成时的生命周期回调，供子类重写
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Lifecycle callback after the layer canvas is created, meant for subclasses.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onConfig.zh: 图层配置更新时的生命周期回调，并把新配置转发给渲染器
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback on config update, forwarding the new config to the renderer.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 图层加载结束时的生命周期回调，供子类重写
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Lifecycle callback when layer loading ends, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the layer is removed from the map, called internally.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: layer 的 renderer 创建完成后的回调，由框架内部调用
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer's renderer is created, called internally.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onWorkerReady.zh: worker 数据处理完成或出错时的回调
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.onWorkerReady.en: Callback invoked when the worker finishes processing data or reports an error.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.queryTerrainTiles.zh: 获取与指定 tile 相交的地形 tile，无地形支持时返回 null
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.queryTerrainTiles.en: Returns the terrain tiles intersecting the given tile info, or null when terrain is unavailable.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.queryTilePointTer.zh: 查询 tile 内某点处的地形高度值，无地形时返回空值数组
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.queryTilePointTer.en: Queries the terrain height at a point inside the tile, returning an empty pair without terrain.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.registerPlugin.zh: 注册一个 VectorTileLayer 插件，按插件的 type 存入插件表
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.registerPlugin.en: Registers a VectorTileLayer plugin into the plugin map keyed by its type.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 并请求重绘
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.setData.zh: 设置数据，可为 GeoJSON 对象或数据 url
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.setData.en: Sets the layer data to a GeoJSON object or a data url and refreshes the worker.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex 并重新排序地图上的图层
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer zIndex and re-sorts the layers on the map.

GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出 layer 的 profile JSON，可用于 fromJSON 重建实例
GeoJSONVectorTileLayer.toJSON.en: Exports the layer's profile JSON, which can rebuild the instance through fromJSON.

Geometry.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做任何反序列化处理
Geometry.fromJSON.en: Returns the passed geometry JSON as is, without any deserialization.

Geometry.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
Geometry.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom, null when not on a map.

Geometry.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
Geometry.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry altitude as a number or an array of altitudes.

Geometry.getCoordinates.zh: 获取几何体的 coordinate，按类型返回坐标或嵌套数组
Geometry.getCoordinates.en: Returns the geometry coordinates, a coordinate or nested arrays depending on its type.

Geometry.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现
Geometry.getGeometries.en: Returns the child geometries of a collection, implemented only by collection subclasses.

Geometry.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
Geometry.getHoles.en: Returns the hole coordinate rings of the geometry, implemented by some subclasses only.

Geometry.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Geometry.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

Geometry.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
Geometry.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

Geometry.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
Geometry.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the angle offset used when rotating around the center, currently implemented only by Sector.

Geometry.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
Geometry.getShell.en: Returns the coordinate ring of the geometry's outer shell, implemented by some subclasses only.

Geometry.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Geometry.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description computed from the text content and sizeSymbol.

Geometry.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
Geometry.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude.

Geometry.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Geometry.isRotated.en: Whether both a rotation angle and a rotation center are set on the geometry.

Geometry.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
Geometry.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer, called internally.

Geometry.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
Geometry.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after config updates options; it syncs properties and redraws when needed.

Geometry.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
Geometry.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; it closes any open menu and infoWindow.

Geometry.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
Geometry.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on position change; it clears caches, redraws and fires positionchange.

Geometry.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Geometry.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer, called internally.

Geometry.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Geometry.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on shape change; it clears caches, redraws and fires shapechange.

Geometry.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
Geometry.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on symbol change; it refreshes symbols, rebuilds sizeSymbol and fires events.

Geometry.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
Geometry.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and updates the z value of its coordinates.

Geometry.setCoordinates.zh: 设置几何体的 coordinate 并更新其几何状态
Geometry.setCoordinates.en: Sets the geometry coordinates and updates its geometry state.

GeometryCollection.endEdit.zh: 结束编辑，恢复编辑前的 symbol 与可见性并触发 editend
GeometryCollection.endEdit.en: Ends editing, restoring the symbol and visibility and firing editend.

GeometryCollection.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做反序列化处理
GeometryCollection.fromJSON.en: Returns the passed geometry JSON as is, without deserializing it.

GeometryCollection.get2DExtent.zh: 获取几何体在当前 zoom 下的二维 extent，无 map 时返回 null
GeometryCollection.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry's 2D extent at the current zoom, or null when there is no map.

GeometryCollection.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的海拔，取 properties 或坐标 z 值，缺省为 0
GeometryCollection.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z, 0 when absent

GeometryCollection.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取集合内所有 geometry 的 container extent 并集
GeometryCollection.getContainerExtent.en: Returns the union of the container extents of all geometries in the collection.

GeometryCollection.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 geometry 的 coordinate 数组，可选成员，仅点线面子类实现
GeometryCollection.getCoordinates.en: Returns the geometry coordinates; optional member implemented by point, line and polygon subclasses only.

GeometryCollection.getHoles.zh: 获取几何图形的洞 ring 坐标，可选成员，仅面状子类实现
GeometryCollection.getHoles.en: Returns hole ring coordinates of the geometry; optional member implemented by polygon-like subclasses only.

GeometryCollection.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最大海拔
GeometryCollection.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among the geometry coordinates

GeometryCollection.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标中的最小海拔
GeometryCollection.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among the geometry coordinates

GeometryCollection.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取旋转时叠加的角度偏移，可选成员，仅 sector 等特殊图形实现
GeometryCollection.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the rotation offset angle; optional member implemented only by shapes like sector

GeometryCollection.getShell.zh: 获取几何图形外壳的 ring 坐标，可选成员，仅面状子类实现
GeometryCollection.getShell.en: Returns the shell ring coordinates of the geometry; optional member implemented by polygon-like subclasses only.

GeometryCollection.getSymbol.zh: 获取 symbol，无自身 symbol 时返回子 geometry 的 children 数组
GeometryCollection.getSymbol.en: Returns the symbol, or a children array of child geometry symbols when none is set.

GeometryCollection.getTextDesc.zh: 获取由 symbol 的 textName 与 properties 生成的文本描述
GeometryCollection.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description built from symbol textName and properties

GeometryCollection.hasAltitude.zh: geometry 是否含有非零海拔
GeometryCollection.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

GeometryCollection.isEditing.zh: 集合是否处于编辑状态
GeometryCollection.isEditing.en: Whether the collection is in editing state

GeometryCollection.isRotated.zh: 判断 geometry 是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
GeometryCollection.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has been rotated with both an angle and a pivot

GeometryCollection.onAdd.zh: geometry 添加到 layer 时的可选生命周期回调，集合类未实现
GeometryCollection.onAdd.en: Optional lifecycle callback when the geometry is added to a layer; not implemented by collections.

GeometryCollection.onConfig.zh: 把配置变更应用到集合内的每个 geometry
GeometryCollection.onConfig.en: Applies the config change to every geometry in the collection.

GeometryCollection.onHide.zh: geometry 被隐藏时的回调，关闭其菜单与 info window
GeometryCollection.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; it closes any open menu and info window.

GeometryCollection.onPositionChanged.zh: geometry 位置变化时的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 positionchange
GeometryCollection.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on position change; it clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

GeometryCollection.onRemove.zh: geometry 从 layer 移除时的可选生命周期回调，集合类未实现
GeometryCollection.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback when the geometry is removed from a layer; not implemented by collections.

GeometryCollection.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 shapechange
GeometryCollection.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on shape change; it clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

GeometryCollection.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
GeometryCollection.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on symbol change; it refreshes symbols, rebuilds sizeSymbol and fires events.

GeometryCollection.redoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起重做一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 redoedit
GeometryCollection.redoEdit.en: Redo one child geometry edit from the last position and fire redoedit

GeometryCollection.redoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部重做
GeometryCollection.redoEditcheck.en: Whether the edits of all child geometries have been fully redone.

GeometryCollection.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的 altitude，同时改写坐标的 z 值
GeometryCollection.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and updates the z value of its coordinates

GeometryCollection.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 geometry 的 coordinates 并触发 shapechange
GeometryCollection.setCoordinates.en: Sets geometry coordinates and fires shapechange; point, line and polygon subclasses implement it.

GeometryCollection.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，传含 children 的对象时按序分给各子 geometry，否则统一设置
GeometryCollection.setSymbol.en: Set symbol, a children object is assigned to each child in order, else to all

GeometryCollection.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑集合内全部 geometry，可用 symbol 指定编辑时的样式
GeometryCollection.startEdit.en: Start editing all geometries in the collection, symbol sets the editing style

GeometryCollection.undoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起撤销一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 undoedit
GeometryCollection.undoEdit.en: Undo one child geometry edit from the last position and fire undoedit

GeometryCollection.undoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部撤回
GeometryCollection.undoEditcheck.en: Whether the edits of all child geometries have been fully undone.

GeometryEditor.cancel.zh: 取消本次编辑，回退到编辑历史的第一条记录
GeometryEditor.cancel.en: Cancel the current edit and roll back to the first record in the edit history

GeometryEditor.createHandle.zh: 在给定容器坐标处创建编辑 handle 并绑定拖拽事件
GeometryEditor.createHandle.en: Create an edit handle at the given container point and bind its drag events

GLTFLayer.addGeometry.zh: 添加 gltf marker 或 GeoJSON，校验类型后注册到 layer
GLTFLayer.addGeometry.en: Adds gltf markers or GeoJSON features to the layer, validating their types first.

GLTFLayer.addMarker.zh: 把 marker 注册进 layer 的 picking 表并触发 add 事件
GLTFLayer.addMarker.en: Registers markers into the layer's picking table, fires add and loads their gltf data.

GLTFLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消所有 marker 的 outline 并清除 layer 样式中的 outline
GLTFLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancels outlines of all markers and removes outline from the layer style.

GLTFLayer.clear.zh: 清空 layer 内所有 gltf marker 并重置 marker 映射缓存
GLTFLayer.clear.en: Clear all gltf markers in the layer and reset the marker id maps

GLTFLayer.fromJSON.zh: 由 layer JSON 反序列化出 GLTFLayer，并还原其 options、geometries 与 style
GLTFLayer.fromJSON.en: Restore a GLTFLayer from its JSON with options, geometries and style, null when the type differs.

GLTFLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取 layer 的海拔高度，GLTFLayer 未启用高度时固定返回 0
GLTFLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude, GLTFLayer returns 0

GLTFLayer.getGLTFUrls.zh: 获取图层已登记的 gltf 模型 url 列表
GLTFLayer.getGLTFUrls.en: Get the urls of all gltf models registered on the layer

GLTFLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，只有组类型 layer 会返回其内部 layer
GLTFLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, only group layers return their inner layers

GLTFLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例，尚未创建时返回 undefined
GLTFLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer renderer instance, undefined before it is created

GLTFLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取实际使用的 renderer 名称，随地图 renderer 在 gl 与 gpu 间取值
GLTFLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer name in use, resolved from the map renderer

GLTFLayer.getShaderMap.zh: 获取 shader 名字到 shader 配置的映射表
GLTFLayer.getShaderMap.en: Get the map of shader names to their shader configs

GLTFLayer.getShaders.zh: 获取所有已注册 shader 的名字与 uniforms 列表
GLTFLayer.getShaders.en: Get the names and uniforms of all registered shaders

GLTFLayer.getStyle.zh: 获取图层当前设置的原始样式
GLTFLayer.getStyle.en: Get the raw style currently set on the layer

GLTFLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取加载模型时改写资源 URL 的回调函数
GLTFLayer.getURLModifier.en: Get the callback that rewrites the URLs of model resources while loading

GLTFLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏 layer，先遍历触发其 geometry 的 onHide，再触发 hide 事件
GLTFLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer, calling onHide on each geometry and firing hide

GLTFLayer.identify.zh: 按地理 coordinate 拾取 marker，返回拾取结果数组
GLTFLayer.identify.en: Pick markers by geographic coordinate and return the pick results

GLTFLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按容器坐标拾取 marker，可用 excludeMasks 与 filter 过滤
GLTFLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Pick markers at a container point, filterable by excludeMasks and filter

GLTFLayer.initDefaultShader.zh: 注册 GLTFLayer 内置的 phong、pbr、depth、wireframe 等默认 shader
GLTFLayer.initDefaultShader.en: Register the built-in phong, pbr, depth, pointline and wireframe shaders

GLTFLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 加入地图时把当前 zoom 记为 marker 的初始 zoom
GLTFLayer.onAdd.en: Record the map zoom as each marker initial zoom when the layer is added

GLTFLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 新增 geometry 时按 layer 样式对其进行匹配与设置
GLTFLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Apply the layer style to a newly added geometry

GLTFLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建后的生命周期回调，Layer 中留空供子类重写
GLTFLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Lifecycle hook after the canvas is created, empty in Layer for subclasses

GLTFLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变化时的生命周期回调，可触发 renderer 重绘
GLTFLayer.onConfig.en: Lifecycle hook on options change, triggering a renderer redraw

GLTFLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: geometry 事件的分发回调，子类可重写以按事件类型追加处理
GLTFLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Dispatch hook for geometry events, overridable to handle each event type

GLTFLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的生命周期回调，Layer 中留空供子类重写
GLTFLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Lifecycle hook after the layer finishes loading, empty in Layer

GLTFLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从地图移除时清空所有 marker
GLTFLayer.onRemove.en: Clear all markers when the layer is removed from the map

GLTFLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的生命周期回调，Layer 中留空供子类重写
GLTFLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Lifecycle hook after the renderer is created, empty in Layer

GLTFLayer.outlineAll.zh: 对 layer 内所有 geometry 开启 outline 描边
GLTFLayer.outlineAll.en: Enable outline for every geometry in the layer

GLTFLayer.outlineBatch.zh: 按样式索引开启该样式的 outline 并给命中的 geometry 描边
GLTFLayer.outlineBatch.en: Enable outline on the style at filterIndex and outline matched geometries

GLTFLayer.registerShader.zh: 注册自定义 shader 到 gltf layer 的 shader 表
GLTFLayer.registerShader.en: Register a custom shader into the gltf layer shader map

GLTFLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask，同时清掉 mask 配置并重绘图层
GLTFLayer.removeMask.en: Remove the layer mask, clear the mask option and redraw the layer

GLTFLayer.removeShader.zh: 从 gltf layer 的 shader 表中移除指定名字的 shader
GLTFLayer.removeShader.en: Remove the shader with the given name from the gltf layer shader map

GLTFLayer.setStyle.zh: 设置图层样式并重新匹配 marker，传空则恢复默认样式
GLTFLayer.setStyle.en: Set the layer style and re-match markers; pass a falsy value to restore the default style.

GLTFLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置模型资源 URL 的改写函数，用于替换模型的加载地址
GLTFLayer.setURLModifier.en: Set the callback that rewrites model resource URLs, returns the layer

GLTFLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为图层设置 zIndex，重新排序 map 上的图层并更新渲染器
GLTFLayer.setZIndex.en: Set the layer zIndex, re-sort the layers on the map and update its renderer

GLTFLayer.toJSON.zh: 把图层序列化为 JSON，可选是否导出 style 与 geometries
GLTFLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer as JSON, optionally including its style and geometries.

GLTFLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 同时更新图层样式与内部副本中第 idx 项 symbol 并重匹配 marker
GLTFLayer.updateSymbol.en: Update the symbol at index idx in the layer style and its copy, then re-match markers.

GLTFMarker.addTo.zh: 把 marker 添加到指定 layer，已在图层上会抛错
GLTFMarker.addTo.en: Add the marker to the given layer; throws if the marker already belongs to a layer.

GLTFMarker.cancelHighlight.zh: 取消高亮并还原原色，可只传部分 node
GLTFMarker.cancelHighlight.en: Cancel the highlight and restore the original colors, optionally limited to the given nodes

GLTFMarker.cancelMarkerPixelHeight.zh: 取消 markerPixelHeight 指定的模型像素高度
GLTFMarker.cancelMarkerPixelHeight.en: Cancel the model pixel height set by markerPixelHeight

GLTFMarker.cancelOutline.zh: 取消描边，传入 nodes 时只取消这些节点
GLTFMarker.cancelOutline.en: Cancel the outline of the marker, only the given nodes when nodes is passed

GLTFMarker.combineGLTFBoundingBox.zh: 合并多个 GLTFMarker 的 boundingBox 并返回 min 与 max，无 marker 时返回 null
GLTFMarker.combineGLTFBoundingBox.en: Merge several markers' bounding boxes into one min and max, or null when none is given.

GLTFMarker.copy.zh: 复制出一个相同的 GLTFMarker，沿用已记录的 zoom
GLTFMarker.copy.en: Create an identical GLTFMarker from its JSON, keeping the recorded zoom

GLTFMarker.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 创建 GLTFMarker 实例
GLTFMarker.fromJSON.en: Create a GLTFMarker instance from its JSON data.

GLTFMarker.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent，无 map 时返回 null
GLTFMarker.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry 2D pixel extent at the current zoom, or null when it has no map.

GLTFMarker.getAllMeshes.zh: 获取 marker 创建的全部 mesh，不做视锥剔除
GLTFMarker.getAllMeshes.en: Get all meshes created for the marker, without frustum culling.

GLTFMarker.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的 altitude 值，取自 properties 或 coordinate 的 z 值，都没有时返回 0
GLTFMarker.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude from its properties or coordinate z, returning 0 when unset.

GLTFMarker.getAnchorZ.zh: 获取模型 Z 轴锚点，未设置时返回 bottom
GLTFMarker.getAnchorZ.en: Get the model Z axis anchor, defaulting to bottom when it is not set.

GLTFMarker.getAnimations.zh: 获取模型全部动画名列表，无动画时返回 null
GLTFMarker.getAnimations.en: Get the names of all model animations, or null when the model has none.

GLTFMarker.getAnimationSpeed.zh: 获取动画播放速度，未设置时为 1
GLTFMarker.getAnimationSpeed.en: Get the animation playback speed, defaulting to 1 when it is not set.

GLTFMarker.getAxisXWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 X 轴方向的宽度
GLTFMarker.getAxisXWidth.en: Get the width of the model bounding box along the X axis.

GLTFMarker.getAxisYWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 Y 轴方向的宽度，内部取 Z 轴值
GLTFMarker.getAxisYWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width along the Y axis, read from the Z value internally.

GLTFMarker.getAxisZWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 Z 轴方向的宽度，内部取 Y 轴值
GLTFMarker.getAxisZWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width along the Z axis, read from the Y value internally.

GLTFMarker.getBoundingBox.zh: 获取合并所有 mesh 后的模型包围盒，未创建时返回空
GLTFMarker.getBoundingBox.en: Get the model bounding box merged from all meshes, or null when there is no mesh.

GLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxCenter.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 中心的 coordinate，未加载时返回 null
GLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxCenter.en: Get the coordinate at the center of the model bounding box, or null before it is loaded.

GLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxWidth.zh: 按 axis 取模型 boundingBox 宽度并乘缩放，y 与 z 会互换
GLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width for the given axis times scale; y and z are swapped.

GLTFMarker.getCenter.zh: 获取模型中心的地理 coordinate，含平移量与高度换算
GLTFMarker.getCenter.en: Get the geographic coordinate of the model center including translation and altitude.

GLTFMarker.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取模型在容器坐标系下的 extent
GLTFMarker.getContainerExtent.en: Get the model extent in container coordinates, or null without a layer or map.

GLTFMarker.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 marker 的中心点 coordinate
GLTFMarker.getCoordinates.en: Get the center coordinate of the marker.

GLTFMarker.getCount.zh: 获取要素数量，GLTFMarker 固定返回 1
GLTFMarker.getCount.en: Get the feature count, which is always 1 for a GLTFMarker.

GLTFMarker.getCurrentAnimation.zh: 获取当前设置的 animationName，未设置返回 undefined
GLTFMarker.getCurrentAnimation.en: Get the current animationName from symbol, or undefined when it is not set.

GLTFMarker.getCurrentPixelHeight.zh: 获取模型当前在屏幕上占的像素高度
GLTFMarker.getCurrentPixelHeight.en: Get the pixel height the model currently occupies on the screen.

GLTFMarker.getFitTranslate.zh: 获取将模型包围盒中心移到原点的平移量
GLTFMarker.getFitTranslate.en: Get the translation that moves the model bounding box center to the origin.

GLTFMarker.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅几何体集合类实现
GLTFMarker.getGeometries.en: Get the child geometries of a collection, implemented only by collection geometries.

GLTFMarker.getGLTFAnchorsAlongLineString.zh: 沿线计算 gltf 模型的锚点位置与朝向，支持间距、数量与端点对齐
GLTFMarker.getGLTFAnchorsAlongLineString.en: Compute gltf model anchor positions and headings along a line, with gap, count and end snapping options.

GLTFMarker.getGLTFAsset.zh: 获取 GLTF 数据的 asset 元信息，如版本与生成器
GLTFMarker.getGLTFAsset.en: Get the asset metadata of the loaded GLTF data, such as version and generator.

GLTFMarker.getGLTFBBox.zh: 获取 GLTF 模型自身的原始包围盒
GLTFMarker.getGLTFBBox.en: Get the original bounding box of the glTF model itself.

GLTFMarker.getGLTFJSON.zh: 获取已加载 glTF 模型的 json 数据
GLTFMarker.getGLTFJSON.en: Get the raw json data of the loaded glTF model.

GLTFMarker.getGLTFMarkerType.zh: 获取 marker 类型标识，如 gltfmarker
GLTFMarker.getGLTFMarkerType.en: Get the marker type identifier, which is gltfmarker.

GLTFMarker.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅面状几何体实现
GLTFMarker.getHoles.en: Get the hole coordinate arrays of a polygon geometry, implemented only by polygon geometries.

GLTFMarker.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
GLTFMarker.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all of the geometry coordinates.

GLTFMarker.getMeshes.zh: 获取本帧要渲染的 mesh，按视锥剔除并更新矩阵与 uniform
GLTFMarker.getMeshes.en: Get the meshes to render this frame, culled by frustum with matrix and uniforms updated.

GLTFMarker.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 坐标与属性中的最小高度值
GLTFMarker.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude of the geometry's coordinates and properties.

GLTFMarker.getModelHeight.zh: 获取当前设置的模型高度
GLTFMarker.getModelHeight.en: Get the currently set model height.

GLTFMarker.getModelMatrix.zh: 获取 marker 当前的模型变换矩阵
GLTFMarker.getModelMatrix.en: Get the marker's current model transform matrix.

GLTFMarker.getOutline.zh: 获取按当前容器范围生成的方形轮廓 marker，用于编辑
GLTFMarker.getOutline.en: Get a square outline marker built from the marker's container extent, used for editing.

GLTFMarker.getPointZ.zh: 把坐标 z 高度换算成 GL 世界的 point 高度
GLTFMarker.getPointZ.en: Convert the coordinate z altitude into the point height of the GL world.

GLTFMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取旋转坐标时的角度偏移，仅 sector 等特殊 geometry 实现
GLTFMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset used when rotating coordinates, implemented only by special geometries such as sector.

GLTFMarker.getRotation.zh: 获取 marker 三个轴向的旋转角度，未设置为 0
GLTFMarker.getRotation.en: Get the marker's rotation angles on the three axes, 0 for axes not set.

GLTFMarker.getScale.zh: 获取模型三个轴向的缩放比例，未设置为 1
GLTFMarker.getScale.en: Get the model's scale factors on the three axes, 1 for axes not set.

GLTFMarker.getShader.zh: 获取 marker 当前 shader 名称，未设置返回 pbr
GLTFMarker.getShader.en: Get the marker's current shader name, returning pbr when not set.

GLTFMarker.getShell.zh: 获取面状 geometry 外环的 coordinate 数组
GLTFMarker.getShell.en: Get the shell coordinates of a polygon geometry.

GLTFMarker.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本 symbol 的排版描述，含尺寸与行信息
GLTFMarker.getTextDesc.en: Get the text symbol's layout description, including size and row information.

GLTFMarker.getTransformOrigin.zh: 获取模型变换原点，未设置时取标记中心
GLTFMarker.getTransformOrigin.en: Get the model transform origin, defaulting to the marker center when not set.

GLTFMarker.getTranslation.zh: 获取 marker 当前的平移量三维向量
GLTFMarker.getTranslation.en: Get the marker's current translation as a 3D vector, 0 for axes not set.

GLTFMarker.getUniform.zh: 获取指定 key 的 uniform 值
GLTFMarker.getUniform.en: Get the uniform value of the given key from the marker symbol.

GLTFMarker.getUniforms.zh: 获取 marker 当前的 uniform 键值对
GLTFMarker.getUniforms.en: Get the current uniform key value pairs of the marker.

GLTFMarker.getUrl.zh: 获取模型资源 url，未设置时默认返回 pyramid
GLTFMarker.getUrl.en: Get the model resource url, returning pyramid when not set.

GLTFMarker.getZoomOnAdded.zh: 获取 marker 加入地图时记录的 zoom 值
GLTFMarker.getZoomOnAdded.en: Get the zoom level recorded when the marker was added to the map.

GLTFMarker.hasAltitude.zh: 判断 geometry 的坐标或属性中是否存在高度
GLTFMarker.hasAltitude.en: Check whether the geometry has any altitude in its coordinates or properties.

GLTFMarker.hasFunctionDefinition.zh: 判断 symbol 与 uniforms 中是否含 function-type 定义
GLTFMarker.hasFunctionDefinition.en: Check whether the symbol or its uniforms contain function-type definitions.

GLTFMarker.hide.zh: 将 symbol 的 visible 设为 false 以隐藏 marker
GLTFMarker.hide.en: Hide the marker by setting the symbol's visible property to false.

GLTFMarker.hideBoundingBox.zh: 隐藏模型的调试包围盒
GLTFMarker.hideBoundingBox.en: Hide the debug bounding box of the model.

GLTFMarker.highlight.zh: 高亮整个模型，可设颜色、不透明度与 bloom
GLTFMarker.highlight.en: Highlight the whole model, with optional color, opacity and bloom.

GLTFMarker.highlightNodes.zh: 按 nodeIndex 高亮模型的部分 node
GLTFMarker.highlightNodes.en: Highlight the model nodes whose nodeIndex is in the given list.

GLTFMarker.isAnimated.zh: 是否播放动画，需模型含 animations 且 symbol 开启
GLTFMarker.isAnimated.en: Check whether animation plays, requiring model animations and an enabling symbol.

GLTFMarker.isAnimationLooped.en: Check whether the animation plays in a loop.

GLTFMarker.isBloom.zh: 是否为 marker 启用了泛光 bloom 效果
GLTFMarker.isBloom.en: Check whether the bloom effect is enabled for the marker.

GLTFMarker.isCastShadow.zh: 是否投射阴影，未显式设置时默认开启
GLTFMarker.isCastShadow.en: Check whether the marker casts shadow, enabled by default when not set explicitly.

GLTFMarker.isDashAnimated.zh: 是否为虚线动画，需 dashEnabled 与 dashAnimate 同时开启
GLTFMarker.isDashAnimated.en: Check whether dash animation is on, requiring both dashEnabled and dashAnimate.

GLTFMarker.isDirty.zh: 是否为待更新状态，mesh 更新后复位
GLTFMarker.isDirty.en: Check whether the marker needs updating, reset once the meshes are updated.

GLTFMarker.isLoaded.zh: 是否已完成 GLTF 模型加载并创建 mesh
GLTFMarker.isLoaded.en: Check whether the glTF model is loaded and its meshes are created.

GLTFMarker.isOutline.en: Returns whether the marker is in outlined state.

GLTFMarker.isRotated.zh: 是否已设置旋转角度与旋转中心
GLTFMarker.isRotated.en: Returns whether a rotation angle and a pivot are set on the geometry.

GLTFMarker.isVisible.zh: marker 是否可见，未设置时默认可见
GLTFMarker.isVisible.en: Returns whether the marker is visible, defaulting to visible when unset.

GLTFMarker.onAdd.zh: 记录 marker 加入图层时的 zoom，用于自适应大小
GLTFMarker.onAdd.en: Records the map zoom when the marker is added, used for auto sizing.

GLTFMarker.onConfig.zh: 配置项变化时的回调，写入 properties 并视需要重绘
GLTFMarker.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback when options change, applying properties and repainting when needed.

GLTFMarker.onHide.zh: 隐藏时的回调，关闭弹出的菜单与 infoWindow
GLTFMarker.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when hidden, closing the menu and the info window.

GLTFMarker.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的回调，清空缓存重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
GLTFMarker.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when the position changes, clearing cache, repainting and firing positionchange.

GLTFMarker.onRemove.zh: 移除时清理包围盒与 zoom 等自适应辅助字段
GLTFMarker.onRemove.en: Clears bounding box and zoom helper fields when the marker is removed.

GLTFMarker.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时的回调，清空缓存重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
GLTFMarker.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when the shape changes, clearing cache, repainting and firing shapechange.

GLTFMarker.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时的回调，刷新符号并触发 symbolchange 事件
GLTFMarker.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when the symbol changes, refreshing it and firing symbolchange.

GLTFMarker.openInfoWindow.zh: 打开 infoWindow，模型未加载时等 load 后打开
GLTFMarker.openInfoWindow.en: Opens the info window, waiting for the load event when the model is not loaded yet.

GLTFMarker.outline.zh: 给模型全部 mesh 加描边
GLTFMarker.outline.en: Adds outline to every mesh of the model and turns on the symbol outline.

GLTFMarker.outlineNodes.zh: 给指定 node 索引的节点加描边
GLTFMarker.outlineNodes.en: Add outline to the meshes whose nodeIndex is in the given list.

GLTFMarker.parseJSONData.zh: 由 JSON 反序列化 GLTFMarker 并恢复 zoomOnAdded 配置
GLTFMarker.parseJSONData.en: Restores a GLTFMarker from JSON data and reapplies the zoomOnAdded option.

GLTFMarker.remove.zh: 释放 GLTF 资源并销毁 mesh 与纹理，再移除 marker
GLTFMarker.remove.en: Releases glTF resources and disposes meshes and textures, then removes the marker.

GLTFMarker.rotateAround.zh: 让 marker 绕指定 coordinate 旋转并同步朝向
GLTFMarker.rotateAround.en: Rotate the marker around the given coordinate and update its heading.

GLTFMarker.rotation.zh: 获取模型默认旋转量，symbol 未设置时为 0, 0, 0
GLTFMarker.rotation.en: Gets the default model rotation, which is 0, 0, 0 when the symbol does not set it.

GLTFMarker.scale.zh: 获取模型默认缩放量，symbol 未设置时为 1, 1, 1
GLTFMarker.scale.en: Gets the default model scale, which is 1, 1, 1 when the symbol does not set it.

GLTFMarker.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的高度值 altitude
GLTFMarker.setAltitude.en: Sets the altitude value of the geometry.

GLTFMarker.setAnchorZ.zh: 设置模型 Z 轴锚点，可取 bottom top center
GLTFMarker.setAnchorZ.en: Sets the Z axis anchor of the model, accepting bottom, top or center.

GLTFMarker.setAnimation.zh: 设置是否播放模型自带的动画
GLTFMarker.setAnimation.en: Sets whether the animations bundled with the model are played.

GLTFMarker.setAnimationLoop.zh: 设置动画是否循环播放并重置起始时间
GLTFMarker.setAnimationLoop.en: Sets whether the animation loops, resetting the animation start time.

GLTFMarker.setAnimationSpeed.zh: 设置动画播放速度倍数
GLTFMarker.setAnimationSpeed.en: Sets the playback speed multiplier of the animation.

GLTFMarker.setAnimationTimeframe.zh: 按给定时间戳更新模型动画进度
GLTFMarker.setAnimationTimeframe.en: Updates the model animation progress to the given timestamp.

GLTFMarker.setBloom.zh: 设置 marker 是否启用泛光 bloom 效果
GLTFMarker.setBloom.en: Sets whether the bloom effect is enabled on the marker.

GLTFMarker.setCastShadow.zh: 设置 marker 是否投射阴影
GLTFMarker.setCastShadow.en: Sets whether the marker casts shadow.

GLTFMarker.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 marker 坐标，支持数组与 Coordinate 形式
GLTFMarker.setCoordinates.en: Sets the marker coordinate, accepting an array or a Coordinate.

GLTFMarker.setCurrentAnimation.zh: 设置当前播放的动画名，可传名称数组
GLTFMarker.setCurrentAnimation.en: Sets the name of the current animation, an array of names is also accepted.

GLTFMarker.setModelHeight.zh: 设置模型高度，按该高度自动缩放模型
GLTFMarker.setModelHeight.en: Set the model height and scale the model to match it.

GLTFMarker.setModelMatrix.zh: 设置模型矩阵，并从中分解出 trs 应用
GLTFMarker.setModelMatrix.en: Set the model matrix by decomposing it into translation, rotation and scale.

GLTFMarker.setRotation.zh: 按指定轴设置 marker 的旋转角度
GLTFMarker.setRotation.en: Set the marker's rotation angles around the x, y and z axes.

GLTFMarker.setScale.zh: 按指定轴设置模型缩放比例
GLTFMarker.setScale.en: Set the model scale factors on the x, y and z axes.

GLTFMarker.setShader.zh: 设置 marker 使用的 shader 名称，默认 pbr
GLTFMarker.setShader.en: Set the shader name used by the marker, pbr by default.

GLTFMarker.setSymbol.zh: 设置 marker 的 symbol，url 或 shader 变化时重建 mesh
GLTFMarker.setSymbol.en: Set the marker symbol and rebuild the mesh when url or shader changes.

GLTFMarker.setTransformOrigin.zh: 设置模型变换的原点 coordinate
GLTFMarker.setTransformOrigin.en: Set the coordinate that serves as the origin of the model transformation.

GLTFMarker.setTranslation.zh: 按指定轴设置 marker 的平移量
GLTFMarker.setTranslation.en: Set the marker's translation offsets on the x, y and z axes.

GLTFMarker.setTRS.zh: 按数组一次设置平移、旋转与缩放
GLTFMarker.setTRS.en: Set translation, rotation and scale together with arrays.

GLTFMarker.setUniform.zh: 设置单个 uniform 值，nodeIndex 指定作用节点
GLTFMarker.setUniform.en: Set one uniform value, optional nodeIndex limits it to that node.

GLTFMarker.setUniforms.zh: 整体设置 shader 的 uniform 键值对
GLTFMarker.setUniforms.en: Set the whole key value map of the shader's uniforms.

GLTFMarker.setUrl.zh: 设置模型资源 url，触发 symbol 更新
GLTFMarker.setUrl.en: Set the model resource url, which triggers a symbol update.

GLTFMarker.setZoomOnAdded.zh: 设置 marker 加入地图时记录的 zoom 值
GLTFMarker.setZoomOnAdded.en: Set the zoom value recorded when the marker is added to the map.

GLTFMarker.show.zh: 将 symbol 的 visible 设为 true 以显示 marker
GLTFMarker.show.en: Show the marker by setting the symbol's visible to true.

GLTFMarker.showBoundingBox.zh: 显示模型包围盒，可指定线颜色与线透明度
GLTFMarker.showBoundingBox.en: Show the model bounding box, options set line color and opacity.

GLTFMarker.toJSON.zh: 将 marker 序列化为 JSON，含坐标与 symbol
GLTFMarker.toJSON.en: Serialize the marker to JSON, including its coordinates and symbol.

GLTFMarker.translation.zh: 获取模型默认平移量，symbol 未设置时为 0, 0, 0
GLTFMarker.translation.en: Get the model's default translation, 0, 0, 0 when the symbol is not set.

GLTFMarker.updateSymbol.zh: 更新 marker 的 symbol，并处理 bloom 与特效属性
GLTFMarker.updateSymbol.en: Update the marker's symbol and handle bloom and effect attributes.

GroupGLLayer.addAnalysis.zh: 向图层添加 analysis 分析对象并触发重绘
GroupGLLayer.addAnalysis.en: Add an analysis object to the layer and redraw it.

GroupGLLayer.clearAnalysis.zh: 移除图层上全部 analysis 对象并清空列表
GroupGLLayer.clearAnalysis.en: Remove all analysis objects from the layer and clear the list.

GroupGLLayer.clearLayers.en: Remove all child layers from the group.

GroupGLLayer.fire.zh: 派发事件，layerload 时先让渲染完成的子图层也派发
GroupGLLayer.fire.en: Fire events, and on layerload first let render-complete child layers fire layerload.

GroupGLLayer.getChildLayer.zh: 按 id 获取组内的子图层，不存在时返回 null
GroupGLLayer.getChildLayer.en: Get the child layer in the group by its id, or null when not found.

GroupGLLayer.getGroundConfig.zh: 获取场景配置中的地面 ground 配置
GroupGLLayer.getGroundConfig.en: Get the ground config in the scene config.

GroupGLLayer.getLayer.zh: 按 id 获取子图层，与 getChildLayer 等价
GroupGLLayer.getLayer.en: Get a child layer by id, the same as getChildLayer.

GroupGLLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh: 获取子图层累计占用的 polygon offset 数量
GroupGLLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Get the total polygon offset count accumulated by the child layers.

GroupGLLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例，创建前为 undefined
GroupGLLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer's renderer instance, undefined before it is created.

GroupGLLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 名称，按地图渲染器类型返回 gl 或 gpu
GroupGLLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the layer's renderer name, gl or gpu according to the map renderer.

GroupGLLayer.getScanEffectConfig.zh: 获取后期处理中的扫描特效 scanEffect 配置
GroupGLLayer.getScanEffectConfig.en: Get the scanEffect config in postProcess of the scene config.

GroupGLLayer.getSceneConfig.zh: 获取场景配置的深拷贝副本
GroupGLLayer.getSceneConfig.en: Get a deep copy of the scene config.

GroupGLLayer.getTerrain.zh: 获取当前地形配置，未设置时为 undefined
GroupGLLayer.getTerrain.en: Get the current terrain config, undefined when not set.

GroupGLLayer.getTerrainLayer.zh: 获取内部创建的地形图层，未启用时为 undefined
GroupGLLayer.getTerrainLayer.en: Get the internal terrain layer, undefined when terrain is not enabled.

GroupGLLayer.getWeatherConfig.zh: 获取场景配置中的天气 weather 配置
GroupGLLayer.getWeatherConfig.en: Get the weather config in the scene config.

GroupGLLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 加入地图或组时的生命周期回调，供子类重写
GroupGLLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the layer is added to a map or group.

GroupGLLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: layer 的 canvas 创建完成时的生命周期回调，供子类重写
GroupGLLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer's canvas is created.

GroupGLLayer.onConfig.zh: layer 配置变更时的回调，触发重绘并调用 options hook
GroupGLLayer.onConfig.en: Callback invoked when the layer's options change, which triggers a redraw.

GroupGLLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 加载完成回调，准备各子图层并初始化地形图层
GroupGLLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Load end callback that prepares child layers and inits the terrain layer.

GroupGLLayer.onRemove.zh: 图层移除时卸载子图层、分析对象并清理地形
GroupGLLayer.onRemove.en: Unloads the child layers and analysis objects and cleans up the terrain layer when removed from the map.

GroupGLLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，默认空实现供子类重写
GroupGLLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer renderer is created; empty by default for subclasses.

GroupGLLayer.query3DTilesAtPoint.zh: 查询容器坐标下首个 3D Tiles 命中的坐标
GroupGLLayer.query3DTilesAtPoint.en: Query the coordinate of the first 3D Tiles hit at the given container point, null if none.

GroupGLLayer.queryTerrain.zh: 查询坐标处地形高度，返回高度与是否命中同级瓦片
GroupGLLayer.queryTerrain.en: Query the terrain altitude at a coordinate, returning the altitude and whether a same level tile was hit.

GroupGLLayer.queryTerrainAtPoint.zh: 以容器坐标射线拾取地形网格，返回命中坐标
GroupGLLayer.queryTerrainAtPoint.en: Ray casts terrain meshes at the given container point and returns the hit coordinate.

GroupGLLayer.queryTerrainByProjCoord.zh: 按投影坐标查询地形高度，返回高度与是否命中同级瓦片
GroupGLLayer.queryTerrainByProjCoord.en: Query the terrain altitude by projected coordinate, returning the altitude and whether a same level tile was hit.

GroupGLLayer.removeAnalysis.zh: 从图层移除指定 analysis 对象并停止其分析
GroupGLLayer.removeAnalysis.en: Removes the given analysis object from the layer and stops its analysis.

GroupGLLayer.removeLayer.zh: 从组内移除指定子图层并解绑其事件监听
GroupGLLayer.removeLayer.en: Removes a child layer from the group and unbinds its event listeners.

GroupGLLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除 layer 的 mask，使其恢复整层渲染
GroupGLLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask so the whole layer is rendered again.

GroupGLLayer.removeTerrain.zh: 移除地形，等同于 setTerrain 传入 null
GroupGLLayer.removeTerrain.en: Removes the terrain, equivalent to calling setTerrain with null.

GroupGLLayer.setSceneConfig.zh: 设置场景配置并通知渲染器立即更新场景
GroupGLLayer.setSceneConfig.en: Sets the scene config and tells the renderer to update the scene immediately.

GroupGLLayer.setTerrain.zh: 设置地形配置并重建地形图层、更新中心海拔
GroupGLLayer.setTerrain.en: Sets the terrain options, recreating the terrain layer and updating the center altitude.

GroupGLLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为 layer 设置 zIndex 并据此重排地图图层
GroupGLLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer zIndex, re-sorting the map's layers and updating its renderer.

GroupGLLayer.sortLayersByZIndex.zh: 按 zIndex 升序重新排列组内的子图层
GroupGLLayer.sortLayersByZIndex.en: Reorder the group's child layers by ascending zIndex.

GroupGLLayer.updateTerrainMaterial.zh: 合并更新地形材质参数并刷新地形图层
GroupGLLayer.updateTerrainMaterial.en: Merge the given terrain material options and refresh the terrain layer.

GroupTileLayer.createTileNode.zh: 创建 tile 节点，含 id url 投影 extent 分辨率与父节点
GroupTileLayer.createTileNode.en: Create a tile node holding id, url, projected extent, resolution and parent info.

GroupTileLayer.getChildLayer.zh: 递归查找指定 id 的子图层，找不到返回 null
GroupTileLayer.getChildLayer.en: Gets the child layer with the given id, searching nested group layers, null when not found.

GroupTileLayer.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的 map 事件映射，此处为空间参考变化
GroupTileLayer.getEvents.en: Returns the map events this layer listens to, here the spatial reference change.

GroupTileLayer.getLayer.zh: 按 id 获取组内的子图层，等价于 getChildLayer
GroupTileLayer.getLayer.en: Gets a child layer in the group by its id, equivalent to getChildLayer.

GroupTileLayer.getMaxZoom.zh: 获取 layer 的 maxZoom，与 map 和自定义 spatialReference 的上限取较小值
GroupTileLayer.getMaxZoom.en: Get the layer max zoom, capped by the map max zoom and its own spatial reference.

GroupTileLayer.getMinZoom.zh: 获取 layer 的 minZoom，有自定义 spatialReference 时取较高者
GroupTileLayer.getMinZoom.en: Get the layer min zoom, raised by its own spatial reference when it differs from the map.

GroupTileLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例，尚未创建时返回 undefined
GroupTileLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer's renderer instance, undefined before it is created.

GroupTileLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取实际使用的 renderer 类型，WebGL map 为 gl，WebGPU 为 gpu
GroupTileLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer type in use: gl on WebGL maps, gpu on WebGPU maps, dom when set.

GroupTileLayer.getTileId.zh: 按 x y zoom 与图层 id 拼接生成 tile 的唯一 id
GroupTileLayer.getTileId.en: Get a tile's unique id built from x, y, zoom and the layer id.

GroupTileLayer.getTileSize.zh: 获取指定子 layer 的 tile 尺寸，找不到返回默认值
GroupTileLayer.getTileSize.en: Get the tile size of the child layer with the given id, or the default size if missing.

GroupTileLayer.identify.zh: 拾取指定坐标处的 geometry，是供子类实现的接口方法
GroupTileLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries at a coordinate; an interface method implemented by subclasses.

GroupTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 拾取容器坐标处的 geometry，是供子类实现的接口方法
GroupTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at a container point; an interface method implemented by subclasses.

GroupTileLayer.isParentTile.zh: 判断该 tile 是否处于瓦片堆叠层级范围内并低于 maxZoom
GroupTileLayer.isParentTile.en: Whether the tile zoom lies inside the tile stacking range and below the max zoom.

GroupTileLayer.isVisible.zh: 自身可见且至少有一个子图层可见时返回 true
GroupTileLayer.isVisible.en: Returns true when the layer itself is visible and at least one child layer is visible.

GroupTileLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 加入 map 时排序并刷新子 layer
GroupTileLayer.onAdd.en: Sorts and refreshes the child layers when the layer is added to the map.

GroupTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: 图层 canvas 创建完成后的回调，可重写以执行自定义逻辑
GroupTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer canvas is created; override it for custom logic.

GroupTileLayer.onConfig.zh: 配置变更后的回调，触发选项钩子并让 renderer 重绘
GroupTileLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on option changes: runs the options hook, redraws the renderer and updates attribution.

GroupTileLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: 图层加载完成后的回调，默认空实现供子类重写
GroupTileLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Callback invoked when the layer finishes loading; empty by default for subclasses.

GroupTileLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 移除时清理全部子 layer 与映射
GroupTileLayer.onRemove.en: Removes every child layer and clears the layer map when the layer is removed from the map.

GroupTileLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，默认空实现供子类重写
GroupTileLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer renderer is created; empty by default for subclasses.

GroupTileLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除 layer 的 mask，使其恢复整层渲染
GroupTileLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask so the whole layer is rendered again.

GroupTileLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为 layer 设置 zIndex 并据此重排地图图层
GroupTileLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer zIndex, re-sorting the map's layers and updating its renderer.

HeightLimitAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到图层，图层就绪后创建分析 pass
HeightLimitAnalysis.addTo.en: Add the analysis to a layer and create the analysis pass once the layer is ready

HeightLimitAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用分析并请求图层重绘
HeightLimitAnalysis.disable.en: Disable the analysis and request the layer to redraw

HeightLimitAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用分析并请求图层重绘
HeightLimitAnalysis.enable.en: Enable the analysis and request the layer to redraw

HeightLimitAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 渲染分析结果并读出 RGBA 像素数据，未启用时返回 null
HeightLimitAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Render the analysis and read back RGBA pixel data, returns null when disabled

HeightLimitAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，如 cut 或 viewshed
HeightLimitAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Get the analysis type identifier such as heightLimitAnalysis

HeightLimitAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader define，开启 HAS_HEIGHTLIMIT 宏
HeightLimitAnalysis.getDefines.en: Return the shader define that turns on the HAS_HEIGHTLIMIT macro

HeightLimitAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与分析的 layer id 数组
HeightLimitAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Get the id array of layers excluded from the analysis

HeightLimitAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 返回分析当前是否启用
HeightLimitAnalysis.isEnable.en: Return whether the analysis is currently enabled

HeightLimitAnalysis.remove.zh: 从图层移除分析并销毁 pass、mesh 等资源
HeightLimitAnalysis.remove.en: Remove the analysis from its layer and dispose its pass, meshes and picking resources

HeightLimitAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染限高分析，返回含限高图与限高颜色的 uniform
HeightLimitAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Render the height limit analysis, returning uniforms with the height limit map and limit color

HeightLimitAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与分析的 layer id 数组
HeightLimitAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Set the id array of layers excluded from the analysis

HeightLimitAnalysis.update.zh: 按名称更新分析选项，limitHeight 变化时重算高度
HeightLimitAnalysis.update.en: Update an analysis option by name, recomputing height when limitHeight changes

IdentityProjection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长，Identity 非球面投影故返回 undefined
IdentityProjection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere circumference; IDENTITY is not spherical, so it returns undefined.

IdentityProjection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，Identity 非球面投影故返回 undefined
IdentityProjection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent; IDENTITY is not spherical, so it returns undefined.

IdentityProjection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
IdentityProjection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

IdentityProjection.project.zh: 将坐标原样投影不做变换，可写入传入的 out 对象
IdentityProjection.project.en: Projects the coordinate unchanged, writing into the passed out coordinate when given.

IdentityProjection.unproject.zh: 将坐标原样反投影不做变换，可写入传入的 out 对象
IdentityProjection.unproject.en: Unprojects the coordinate unchanged, writing into the passed out coordinate when given.

ImageLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
ImageLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layer array, implemented only by group layer types

ImageLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的渲染器实例
ImageLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer

ImageLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
ImageLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses based on the map renderer type

ImageLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
ImageLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer by coordinate, implemented by subclasses

ImageLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 geometry，由子类实现
ImageLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries by container point, implemented by subclasses

ImageLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层加入 map 时准备图像数据并触发渲染
ImageLayer.onAdd.en: Prepare image data and trigger rendering when the layer is added to a map

ImageLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ImageLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback fired after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override it

ImageLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
ImageLayer.onConfig.en: Callback after options change, triggering redraw and attribution update

ImageLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
ImageLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called when the layer finishes loading, empty by default and overridable

ImageLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
ImageLayer.onRemove.en: Callback fired when the layer is removed from its map, subclasses may override

ImageLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ImageLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback fired after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override

ImageLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除 layer 的 mask，使其恢复整层渲染
ImageLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask so the whole layer is rendered again.

ImageLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为 layer 设置 zIndex 并据此重排地图图层
ImageLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer zIndex, re-sorting the map's layers and updating its renderer.

ImageLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出 layer 的 JSON 描述，含 type id 与 options
ImageLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer as JSON containing its type, id and options

InfoWindow.buildOn.zh: 创建信息窗口 DOM，含标题、关闭按钮与内容容器
InfoWindow.buildOn.en: Build the InfoWindow DOM with its title, close button and content container

InfoWindow.getEvents.zh: 返回 autoCloseOn 对应的 map 事件映射，用于自动关闭
InfoWindow.getEvents.en: Returns the map events that auto close the window, keyed by autoCloseOn

InfoWindow.getOffset.zh: 按对齐方式与 marker 尺寸计算信息窗口的像素偏移
InfoWindow.getOffset.en: Gets the info window pixel offset from its alignment options and marker size.

InfoWindow.getOwner.zh: 获取信息窗口挂载的 owner，即 map 或 geometry
InfoWindow.getOwner.en: Returns the owner the infowindow is added to, a map or a geometry

InfoWindow.getOwnerEvents.zh: 返回 autoOpenOn 对应的 owner 事件映射，用于自动打开
InfoWindow.getOwnerEvents.en: Returns the owner events that auto open the window, keyed by autoOpenOn

InfoWindow.getPosition.zh: 获取信息窗口相对地图容器的像素位置，含偏移，无 map 时为 null
InfoWindow.getPosition.en: Returns the window pixel position in the map container with offset, null without map

InfoWindow.isSupportZoomFilter.zh: 是否支持按 zoom 过滤 DOM 显示，信息窗口返回 false
InfoWindow.isSupportZoomFilter.en: Whether the DOM display is filtered by zoom, the infowindow returns false

InfoWindow.onAdd.zh: 信息窗口被添加到 owner 时的回调钩子，基类为空实现
InfoWindow.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the infowindow is added to its owner

InfoWindow.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，刷新位置并在碰撞状态变化时重排
InfoWindow.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after options change, refreshes position and collisions

InfoWindow.onDomRemove.zh: 解绑关闭按钮上的 click 与 touchend 事件监听
InfoWindow.onDomRemove.en: Unbinds the click and touchend listeners on the close button

InfoWindow.onDomSizeChange.zh: DOM 尺寸变化时的回调，重设位置并重算碰撞
InfoWindow.onDomSizeChange.en: Lifecycle callback when the DOM size changes, resets position and collision

InfoWindow.onEvent.zh: 地图缩放旋转倾斜过程中的回调，更新信息窗口位置
InfoWindow.onEvent.en: Lifecycle callback during map zooming rotating and pitching, updates position

InfoWindow.onGeometryPositionChange.zh: owner geometry 位置变化时的回调，按新中心点刷新窗口
InfoWindow.onGeometryPositionChange.en: Lifecycle callback when the owner geometry moves, refreshes window position

InfoWindow.onMoving.zh: 地图 moving 与 moveend 时的回调，更新信息窗口位置
InfoWindow.onMoving.en: Lifecycle callback on map moving and moveend, updates the window position

InfoWindow.onRemove.zh: 信息窗口移除时处理鼠标移出并解绑 DOM 事件
InfoWindow.onRemove.en: Handles mouse out and unbinds DOM events when the infowindow is removed

InfoWindow.onResize.zh: 地图容器尺寸变化时的回调，重设信息窗口的 DOM 位置
InfoWindow.onResize.en: Lifecycle callback when the map container resizes, resets the DOM position

InfoWindow.onZoomEnd.zh: 地图 zoom 结束时的回调，立即重设信息窗口的 DOM 位置
InfoWindow.onZoomEnd.en: Lifecycle callback on map zoomend, immediately resets the DOM position

InfoWindow.show.zh: 在指定 coordinate 显示信息窗口，无 map 或禁用时不显示
InfoWindow.show.en: Shows the info window at the given coordinate, skipped without a map or when info windows are disabled.

InSightAnalysis.addLine.zh: 添加一条带 from 与 to 的 inSight 射线
InSightAnalysis.addLine.en: Adds an inSight line with from and to coordinates and requests a redraw.

InSightAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到图层，图层就绪后创建分析 pass
InSightAnalysis.addTo.en: Adds the analysis to a layer and creates the analysis pass once ready

InSightAnalysis.clearLines.zh: 清空所有 inSight 射线
InSightAnalysis.clearLines.en: Clears all inSight lines and requests a redraw.

InSightAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用分析并请求图层重绘
InSightAnalysis.disable.en: Disables the analysis and requests a layer redraw

InSightAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用分析并请求图层重绘
InSightAnalysis.enable.en: Enables the analysis and requests a layer redraw

InSightAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 渲染分析结果并读出 RGBA 像素数据，未启用时返回 null
InSightAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Renders the analysis and reads back RGBA pixel data, null when disabled

InSightAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，本类为 insight
InSightAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Returns the analysis type id, which is insight for this analysis

InSightAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回分析所用的 shader 宏定义
InSightAnalysis.getDefines.en: Returns the shader macro defines used by the analysis

InSightAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与分析的 layer id 数组
InSightAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Returns the id array of layers excluded from the analysis

InSightAnalysis.getLines.zh: 获取当前所有 inSight 射线
InSightAnalysis.getLines.en: Gets the array of current inSight lines.

InSightAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 返回分析当前是否启用
InSightAnalysis.isEnable.en: Returns whether the analysis is currently enabled

InSightAnalysis.remove.zh: 从图层移除分析并销毁 pass、mesh 等资源
InSightAnalysis.remove.en: Removes the analysis from its layer and disposes pass and mesh resources

InSightAnalysis.removeLine.zh: 从分析中移除指定的 inSight 射线
InSightAnalysis.removeLine.en: Removes the given inSight line from the analysis and requests a redraw.

InSightAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 用 meshes 做可见性分析，返回 shader 的 uniform 集合
InSightAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Runs the visibility analysis with the meshes and returns shader uniforms

InSightAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与 inSight 分析的图层 id 列表
InSightAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Set the ids of layers excluded from the insight analysis

InSightAnalysis.setLines.zh: 替换全部 inSight 射线并触发重绘
InSightAnalysis.setLines.en: Replaces all inSight lines and requests a redraw.

InSightAnalysis.update.zh: 按属性名更新，lines 走 setLines，其余存为渲染选项
InSightAnalysis.update.en: Update an option by name; lines goes to setLines, others are stored as render options

Label.fromJSON.zh: 由 content、坐标与 options 反序列化出 Label，并还原 id、properties 与 symbol
Label.fromJSON.en: Deserialize a Label from content, coordinates and options, restoring id, properties and symbol

Label.get2DExtent.zh: 获取 geometry 在当前 zoom 下的像素 extent，无 map 时返回 null
Label.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom, or null when it has no map

Label.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的 altitude，取自 properties 的 altitude 或坐标 z，无则返回 0
Label.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude from its altitude property or coordinates z, 0 when none

Label.getCoordinates.zh: 获取该 geometry 的坐标
Label.getCoordinates.en: Get the coordinate of the geometry

Label.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中的 geometry 数组
Label.getGeometries.en: Get the geometries contained in the geometry collection

Label.getHoles.zh: 获取多边形洞的坐标，无洞时返回空数组
Label.getHoles.en: Get the polygon's hole rings, an empty array when it has none

Label.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 上所有顶点 altitude 的最大值
Label.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude of the geometry's coordinates

Label.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 上所有顶点 altitude 的最小值
Label.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude of the geometry's coordinates

Label.getOutline.zh: 生成与该 marker 包围盒同尺寸的方形边框 marker
Label.getOutline.en: Create a square outline marker sized to this marker's container extent

Label.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取图形旋转时的角度偏移量，扇形等特殊图形会覆写
Label.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset applied when rotating, overridden by shapes like sector

Label.getShell.zh: 获取多边形的外壳坐标，无坐标时返回空数组
Label.getShell.en: Get the polygon's shell coordinates, an empty array when there are none

Label.getTextDesc.zh: 获取按 symbol 解析出的文本描述，结果会缓存
Label.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description parsed from the text symbol, cached until it changes

Label.getTextStyle.zh: 获取文本框的文本样式副本，未设置时返回 null
Label.getTextStyle.en: Get a copy of the text box's text style, null when it is not set

Label.hasAltitude.zh: 判断 geometry 是否带非零 altitude
Label.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any non-zero altitude

Label.isRotated.zh: 判断 geometry 是否已设置旋转角度与中心
Label.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotation angle and a pivot set

Label.onAdd.zh: geometry 加入图层时回调，重新刷新文本布局
Label.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback fired when added to a layer, refreshes the text layout

Label.onConfig.zh: 配置变更回调，应用 properties 并在箭头或平滑选项变化时重绘
Label.onConfig.en: Config callback, applies properties and repaints when arrow or smooth options change

Label.onHide.zh: geometry 隐藏时回调，关闭其菜单与 info window
Label.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback fired when hidden, closes its menu and info window

Label.onPositionChanged.zh: 坐标变化回调，清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange
Label.onPositionChanged.en: Position callback, clears cache, repaints and fires positionchange

Label.onRemove.zh: geometry 从图层移除时回调
Label.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback fired when the geometry is removed from its layer

Label.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化回调，清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange
Label.onShapeChanged.en: Shape callback, clears cache, repaints and fires shapechange

Label.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化回调，刷新 symbol 并触发 symbolchange
Label.onSymbolChanged.en: Symbol callback, refreshes the symbol and fires symbolchange

Label.setAltitude.zh: 设置 geometry 的 altitude，同步 properties 与坐标 z 后重绘
Label.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry altitude, updating its property and coordinates z, then repaint

Label.setBoxSymbol.zh: TextMarker 声明的可选方法，设置 label 盒子 symbol，由 TextBox 实现
Label.setBoxSymbol.en: Optional method declared on TextMarker that sets the label box symbol, implemented by TextBox

Label.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 label 的 coordinate 并更新投影坐标，触发位置变化事件
Label.setCoordinates.en: Set the label coordinate, update the projected position and fire positionchange

Label.setSymbol.zh: 按 symbol 键名的 text 前缀拆成文本与盒子两部分分别设置
Label.setSymbol.en: Split the symbol into text and box parts by the text prefix and set each part

Label.setTextStyle.zh: TextMarker 声明的可选方法，设置 label 文本样式，由 TextBox 实现
Label.setTextStyle.en: Optional method declared on TextMarker that sets the label text style, implemented by TextBox

Label.toJSON.zh: 导出 JSON，含 feature 与 content，结果中不含 symbol 字段
Label.toJSON.en: Export the label JSON with feature and content, without the symbol field

Layer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
Layer.getLayers.en: Get the child layer list, implemented only by group layers

Layer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例
Layer.getRenderer.en: Gets the renderer instance bound to this layer.

Layer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
Layer.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses according to the map renderer type

Layer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
Layer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer at a coordinate; implemented by subclasses.

Layer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 geometry，由子类实现
Layer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries on the layer at a container point; implemented by subclasses.

Layer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
Layer.onAdd.en: Callback called after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses may override it

Layer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
Layer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback called after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override it

Layer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
Layer.onConfig.en: Callback on option change that triggers a redraw and an attribution update

Layer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
Layer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called when the layer finishes loading, overridden by subclasses, empty by default

Layer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
Layer.onRemove.en: Callback called when the layer is removed from the map, subclasses may override it

Layer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
Layer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback called after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override it

Layer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask from its options and requests a redraw.

Layer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index and re-sorts the layers on the map.

Layer.toJSON.zh: 导出 layer 的 JSON 描述，含 type id 与 options
Layer.toJSON.en: Returns the layer JSON object with its type, id and options.

LayerSwitcher.onAdd.zh: 添加时绑定按钮悬停显示与面板移出隐藏事件
LayerSwitcher.onAdd.en: Bind button mouseover to show and panel mouseleave to hide when added

LayerSwitcher.onConfig.zh: 沿用 Control 的实现，配置含 position 时重新计算控件位置
LayerSwitcher.onConfig.en: Inherited from Control, it updates the control position when position changes

LayerSwitcher.onRemove.zh: 移除时解绑事件，删除面板与按钮 DOM 及引用
LayerSwitcher.onRemove.en: Unbind the events and remove the panel and button DOM nodes with their references

LineString.fromJSON.zh: 沿用父类实现，原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做反序列化
LineString.fromJSON.en: Inherited from Geometry, it returns the given geometry JSON as is without deserializing

LineString.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
LineString.get2DExtent.en: Get the 2D pixel extent of the geometry at the current zoom

LineString.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
LineString.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude, returned as a number or an array of altitudes

LineString.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现
LineString.getGeometries.en: Get child geometries of a geometry collection, implemented only by collection classes

LineString.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
LineString.getHoles.en: Get the hole rings of a polygon-like geometry, implemented by some subclasses only

LineString.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
LineString.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

LineString.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
LineString.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

LineString.getOutline.zh: 复用 Polygon 的实现，按 extent 生成描边多边形
LineString.getOutline.en: Returns a polygon outline built from the geometry extent, reusing Polygon's implementation.

LineString.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
LineString.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset used when rotating around the center, only Sector implements it

LineString.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
LineString.getShell.en: Get the outer ring coordinates of a geometry, implemented by some subclasses only

LineString.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
LineString.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description computed from the text content and sizeSymbol.

LineString.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
LineString.hasAltitude.en: Returns whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude.

LineString.hasHoles.zh: 是否为带孔洞的图形，由 Polygon 等子类实现
LineString.hasHoles.en: Whether the shape has holes; implemented by subclasses such as Polygon.

LineString.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
LineString.isRotated.en: Whether both a rotation angle and a rotation center are set on the geometry.

LineString.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
LineString.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer, called internally.

LineString.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
LineString.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after config updates options; it syncs properties and redraws when needed.

LineString.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
LineString.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; it closes any open menu and infoWindow.

LineString.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
LineString.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on position change; it clears caches, redraws and fires positionchange.

LineString.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
LineString.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer, called internally.

LineString.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
LineString.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on shape change; it clears caches, redraws and fires shapechange.

LineString.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
LineString.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on symbol change; it refreshes symbols, rebuilds sizeSymbol and fires events.

LineString.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
LineString.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and writes it into the z values of its coordinates.

LineStringLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层内 geometry 的描边高亮
LineStringLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancels the outline highlighting of the geometries in the layer.

LineStringLayer.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名字获取已注册的 3D painter 类
LineStringLayer.get3DPainterClass.en: Returns the registered 3D painter class with the given name.

LineStringLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高程，OverlayLayer 固定返回 0
LineStringLayer.getAltitude.en: Returns the layer altitude; OverlayLayer always returns 0.

LineStringLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层计算后样式并以 style 字段返回
LineStringLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Returns the layer's computed style wrapped in a style field.

LineStringLayer.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的事件映射，含空间参考变化事件
LineStringLayer.getEvents.en: Returns the event map the layer listens to, including spatial reference changes.

LineStringLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
LineStringLayer.getLayers.en: Returns child layers; implemented only by group layer types.

LineStringLayer.getPolygonOffset.zh: 获取图层的 polygonOffset 值，设置了 altitude 时返回 0
LineStringLayer.getPolygonOffset.en: Returns the layer polygonOffset, 0 when the layer has an altitude option.

LineStringLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh: 获取图层需要的 polygonOffset 数量，空图层或设了 altitude 时为 0
