LineStringLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Returns the polygonOffset count the layer needs: 0 when empty or with altitude, else 1.

LineStringLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例
LineStringLayer.getRenderer.en: Returns the renderer instance of the layer.

LineStringLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
LineStringLayer.getRendererOption.en: Returns the renderer name the layer uses for the map's renderer type.

LineStringLayer.getTileSize.zh: 返回 painter 内部使用的默认 tile 尺寸 1x1
LineStringLayer.getTileSize.en: Returns the default tile size used by the painters, 1 by 1.

LineStringLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.zh: 获取 GroupGLLayer 分配的 polygonOffset 总数
LineStringLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.en: Returns the total polygonOffset assigned by the GroupGLLayer.

LineStringLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数
LineStringLayer.getURLModifier.en: Returns the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls.

LineStringLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有几何体隐藏
LineStringLayer.hide.en: Hides the layer and notifies all geometries inside it to hide.

LineStringLayer.identify.zh: 查询给定 coordinate 处命中的 geometry 数组
LineStringLayer.identify.en: Returns the geometries hit at the given coordinate, empty when there is no renderer.

LineStringLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 查询给定容器坐标点命中的 geometry，可设容差与数量
LineStringLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at the given container point, with tolerance and count

LineStringLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
LineStringLayer.onAdd.en: Callback after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses may override it

LineStringLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 几何体加入图层时按图层 style 设置其 symbol
LineStringLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Set a geometry symbol from the layer style when the geometry is added

LineStringLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
LineStringLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override it

LineStringLayer.onConfig.zh: 配置项更新时的回调，把 bloom 开关同步给 renderer
LineStringLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on options update, syncs the bloom switches to the renderer

LineStringLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 响应几何体变化事件，同步图层缓存与 renderer
LineStringLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Handle geometry events and sync the layer cache and renderer

LineStringLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
LineStringLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called after the layer finishes loading, empty by default

LineStringLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
LineStringLayer.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from a map, subclasses may override it

LineStringLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
LineStringLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override it

LineStringLayer.outline.zh: 为指定 id 数组的 geometry 添加描边高亮
LineStringLayer.outline.en: Add outline highlight to the geometries with the given id array

LineStringLayer.outlineAll.zh: 为图层内全部 geometry 添加描边高亮
LineStringLayer.outlineAll.en: Add outline highlight to all geometries in the layer

LineStringLayer.registerPainter.zh: 按名字注册 3D painter 类，供图层渲染时查找
LineStringLayer.registerPainter.en: Register a 3D painter class by name for the layer to look up

LineStringLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask from its options and requests a redraw.

LineStringLayer.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层 polygonOffset 及全局总数供 GroupGLLayer 统一管理
LineStringLayer.setPolygonOffset.en: Set the layer polygon offset and total count for GroupGLLayer

LineStringLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数并返回图层
LineStringLayer.setURLModifier.en: Set the modifier function rewriting resource urls and return the layer

LineStringLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index and re-sorts the layers on the map.

LineStringLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出图层的 JSON，含 type id options 与全部 geometry
LineStringLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer JSON with type, id, options and all geometries

LineStringLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 把 symbol 属性合并进样式数组第 idx 项并刷新图层样式
LineStringLayer.updateSymbol.en: Merge symbol properties into the style at index idx and refresh it

Map.getRenderer.zh: 获取地图当前的渲染器实例
Map.getRenderer.en: Returns the renderer instance of the map.

Map.getZoomFromRes.zh: 按分辨率反算 zoom，超出 minZoom 与 maxZoom 时截断
Map.getZoomFromRes.en: Get the zoom for a resolution, clamped to minZoom and maxZoom

Map.isDragRotating.zh: 是否正在拖拽旋转地图
Map.isDragRotating.en: Whether the map is currently being drag rotated

Map.onDragRotateEnd.zh: 结束拖拽旋转时清除状态并触发 dragrotateend 事件
Map.onDragRotateEnd.en: Clear the drag rotating flag and fire the dragrotateend event

Map.onDragRotateStart.zh: 开始拖拽旋转地图时置位状态并触发 dragrotatestart 事件
Map.onDragRotateStart.en: Set the drag rotating flag and fire the dragrotatestart event

Map.onDragRotating.zh: 拖拽旋转地图过程中触发 dragrotating 事件
Map.onDragRotating.en: Fire the dragrotating event while the map is drag rotated

Map.onMoveEnd.zh: 地图移动结束的回调，触发 moveend 事件并复位光标与中心
Map.onMoveEnd.en: Move end callback firing moveend and resetting cursor and center

Map.onMoving.zh: 地图移动中的回调，触发 moving 事件并限制最大 extent
Map.onMoving.en: Moving callback firing the moving event and limiting max extent

Map.setContainerDomRect.zh: 设置容器 DOM 的内容矩形，用于计算地图尺寸
Map.setContainerDomRect.en: Set the container DOM content rect used to compute the map size

Map.stringifyView.zh: 将当前视图序列化为 JSON 字符串
Map.stringifyView.en: Serialize the current map view into a JSON string

MapTool.getEvents.zh: 必须实现，返回注册到地图上的事件监听映射
MapTool.getEvents.en: Required method returning the event map to register on the map.

MapTool.onAdd.zh: 可选回调，map tool 添加到地图、启用前调用
MapTool.onAdd.en: Optional callback called after the map tool is added to a map and before it is enabled.

MapTool.onDisable.zh: 可选回调，map tool 禁用时调用，用于清理资源
MapTool.onDisable.en: Optional callback called when the map tool is disabled, used to clean up resources.

MapTool.onEnable.zh: 可选回调，map tool 启用时调用，用于准备上下文
MapTool.onEnable.en: Optional callback called when the map tool is enabled, used to set up its context.

MapTool.remove.zh: 从地图上移除该 map tool 并触发 remove 事件
MapTool.remove.en: Disables the tool, detaches it from its map and fires the remove event.

Marker.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做反序列化处理
Marker.fromJSON.en: Returns the passed geometry JSON as is, without deserializing it.

Marker.get2DExtent.zh: 获取几何体在当前 zoom 下的二维 extent，无 map 时返回 null
Marker.get2DExtent.en: Returns the geometry's 2D extent at the current zoom, or null when there is no map.

Marker.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的 altitude，取自 properties 或坐标 z 值，都没有时为 0
Marker.getAltitude.en: Returns the geometry altitude from properties or coordinate z, or 0 when unset.

Marker.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 marker 的中心点 coordinate
Marker.getCoordinates.en: Returns the center coordinate of the marker.

Marker.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类实现
Marker.getGeometries.en: Returns the child geometries of a collection, implemented by collection classes only.

Marker.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅面状几何体实现
Marker.getHoles.en: Returns the hole coordinate arrays of a polygon, implemented by polygon geometries only.

Marker.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Marker.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

Marker.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
Marker.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

Marker.getOutline.zh: 获取标记的方框轮廓 marker，尺寸取自 containerExtent
Marker.getOutline.en: Returns a square outline marker whose size comes from the container extent.

Marker.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
Marker.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the angle offset used when rotating around the center, implemented only by Sector.

Marker.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
Marker.getShell.en: Returns the coordinate ring of the geometry's outer shell, implemented by some subclasses only.

Marker.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Marker.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description computed from the text content and sizeSymbol.

Marker.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体的坐标或属性中是否存在高度
Marker.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has any altitude in its coordinates or properties.

Marker.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Marker.isRotated.en: Whether both a rotation angle and a rotation center are set on the geometry.

Marker.onAdd.zh: geometry 加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
Marker.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer, called internally.

Marker.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
Marker.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after config updates options; it syncs properties and repaints when needed.

Marker.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
Marker.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when the geometry is hidden; it closes any open menu and infoWindow.

Marker.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
Marker.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on position change; it clears caches, repaints and fires positionchange.

Marker.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Marker.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer, called internally.

Marker.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Marker.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on shape change; it clears caches, repaints and fires shapechange.

Marker.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
Marker.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback on symbol change; it refreshes symbols, rebuilds sizeSymbol and fires events.

Marker.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，同时改写坐标的 z 值
Marker.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and updates the z value of its coordinates.

Marker.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 marker 的中心 coordinate，支持 Coordinate 与数组
Marker.setCoordinates.en: Set the marker center coordinate from a Coordinate or an array

Marker.setSymbol.zh: 设置 marker 的 symbol 并清除缓存的固定 extent
Marker.setSymbol.en: Sets the marker symbol and clears its cached fixed extent.

Menu.addTo.zh: 把菜单添加到 geometry 或 map 并替换其原有菜单
Menu.addTo.en: Adds the menu to a geometry or map, replacing its previous menu.

Menu.buildOn.zh: 创建菜单的 DOM 节点，custom 时直接用 items 作为 HTML
Menu.buildOn.en: Create the menu DOM, using items as HTML directly when custom is true

Menu.getEvents.zh: 返回菜单监听的地图事件，移动缩放或点击时移除菜单 DOM
Menu.getEvents.en: Return map events that remove the menu DOM on move, zoom or click

Menu.getOwner.zh: 获取菜单挂载的 owner，即 map 或 geometry
Menu.getOwner.en: Get the owner the menu is added to, either a map or a geometry

Menu.getOwnerEvents.zh: 返回需绑定到 owner 上的事件映射表，子类可重写
Menu.getOwnerEvents.en: Return the event map to bind on the owner, subclasses may override

Menu.getPosition.zh: 获取菜单相对地图容器的像素位置，含偏移量
Menu.getPosition.en: Get the menu pixel position relative to the map container, offset included

Menu.getTransformOrigin.zh: 获取菜单 CSS 变换原点的像素坐标字符串
Menu.getTransformOrigin.en: Returns the negated menu offset as a CSS transform origin string in pixels.

Menu.isSupportZoomFilter.zh: 是否支持按 zoom 过滤 DOM 显示，菜单返回 false
Menu.isSupportZoomFilter.en: Whether DOM display is filtered by zoom, the menu returns false

Menu.onAdd.zh: 菜单被添加到 owner 时的回调钩子，由子类实现
Menu.onAdd.en: Callback hook invoked when the menu is added to its owner

Menu.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，刷新位置并重算碰撞
Menu.onConfig.en: Callback after options change, refreshing position and collision

Menu.onDomRemove.zh: 菜单的 DOM 节点被移除时的回调钩子
Menu.onDomRemove.en: Callback hook invoked when the menu DOM node is removed

Menu.onDomSizeChange.zh: 菜单 DOM 尺寸变化时的回调，重设位置并重算碰撞
Menu.onDomSizeChange.en: Callback when the menu DOM resizes, resetting position and collision

Menu.onEvent.zh: 地图缩放旋转倾斜过程中的回调，更新菜单位置
Menu.onEvent.en: Callback during map zoom, rotate or pitch, updating the menu position

Menu.onGeometryPositionChange.zh: owner geometry 位置变化时的回调，按新中心点刷新菜单
Menu.onGeometryPositionChange.en: Callback when the owner geometry moves, refreshing the menu at its center

Menu.onMoving.zh: 地图 moving 与 moveend 时的回调，更新菜单位置
Menu.onMoving.en: Callback on map moving and moveend, updating the menu position

Menu.onRemove.zh: 菜单被移除时的回调钩子，由子类实现
Menu.onRemove.en: Callback hook invoked when the menu is removed

Menu.onResize.zh: 地图容器尺寸变化时的回调，重设菜单 DOM 位置
Menu.onResize.en: Callback on map container resize, resetting the menu DOM position

Menu.onZoomEnd.zh: 地图 zoom 结束时的回调，立即重设菜单 DOM 位置
Menu.onZoomEnd.en: Callback on map zoom end, immediately resetting the menu DOM position

MultiGeometry.endEdit.zh: 结束编辑，恢复编辑前的 symbol 与可见性并触发 editend
MultiGeometry.endEdit.en: End editing, restore the pre-edit symbol and visibility, and fire editend

MultiGeometry.fromJSON.zh: 静态方法，由 geometry JSON 反序列化出对应的几何体实例
MultiGeometry.fromJSON.en: Static method returning geometry instances deserialized from the given JSON

MultiGeometry.get2DExtent.zh: 获取集合在当前 zoom 下的 2D 像素 extent
MultiGeometry.get2DExtent.en: Get the 2D pixel extent of the collection at the current zoom

MultiGeometry.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
MultiGeometry.getAltitude.en: Get the altitude of the geometry as a number or an altitude array

MultiGeometry.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取集合内所有 geometry 的 container extent 并集
MultiGeometry.getContainerExtent.en: Get the union container extent of all geometries in the collection

MultiGeometry.getGeometries.zh: 获取集合中的全部 geometry 数组
MultiGeometry.getGeometries.en: Get all geometries of the collection as an array

MultiGeometry.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅 Polygon 等子类实现
MultiGeometry.getHoles.en: Get hole coordinate rings of a polygon-like geometry, implemented by subclasses

MultiGeometry.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
MultiGeometry.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

MultiGeometry.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
MultiGeometry.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among all the geometry coordinates

MultiGeometry.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
MultiGeometry.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset when rotating around the center, only Sector implements it

MultiGeometry.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiGeometry.getShell.en: Get the shell coordinates of the geometry, implemented by some subclasses only

MultiGeometry.getSymbol.zh: 获取 symbol，无自身 symbol 时返回子 geometry 的 children 数组
MultiGeometry.getSymbol.en: Get the symbol, or a children array of child geometries when it has none

MultiGeometry.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
MultiGeometry.getTextDesc.en: Get the cached text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol

MultiGeometry.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
MultiGeometry.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude set

MultiGeometry.isEditing.zh: 集合是否处于编辑状态
MultiGeometry.isEditing.en: Whether the collection is in editing state

MultiGeometry.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
MultiGeometry.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has a rotation angle and a pivot set

MultiGeometry.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiGeometry.onAdd.en: Callback after the geometry is added to a layer, called by the framework

MultiGeometry.onConfig.zh: 把配置变更应用到集合内的每个 geometry
MultiGeometry.onConfig.en: Apply config changes to every geometry in the collection

MultiGeometry.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
MultiGeometry.onHide.en: Close the opened menu and infoWindow when the geometry is hidden

MultiGeometry.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
MultiGeometry.onPositionChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire positionchange when the position changes

MultiGeometry.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiGeometry.onRemove.en: Callback when the geometry is removed from its layer, called by the framework

MultiGeometry.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
MultiGeometry.onShapeChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire shapechange when the shape changes

MultiGeometry.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
MultiGeometry.onSymbolChanged.en: Refresh symbol, rebuild sizeSymbol and fire symbolchange when symbol changes

MultiGeometry.redoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起重做一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 redoedit
MultiGeometry.redoEdit.en: Redo one child geometry edit from the last position and fire redoedit

MultiGeometry.redoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部重做
MultiGeometry.redoEditcheck.en: Whether all child geometries edits have already been redone

MultiGeometry.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
MultiGeometry.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry altitude and rewrite the z value of its coordinates

MultiGeometry.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，传含 children 的对象时按序分给各子 geometry，否则统一设置
MultiGeometry.setSymbol.en: Set symbol, a children object is assigned to each child in order, else to all

MultiGeometry.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑集合内全部 geometry，可用 symbol 指定编辑时的样式
MultiGeometry.startEdit.en: Start editing all geometries in the collection, symbol sets the editing style

MultiGeometry.undoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起撤销一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 undoedit
MultiGeometry.undoEdit.en: Undo one child geometry edit from the last position and fire undoedit

MultiGeometry.undoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部撤回
MultiGeometry.undoEditcheck.en: Whether all child geometries edits have already been undone

MultiGLTFMarker.addData.zh: 新增一个子 marker 的数据项并刷新图层的 marker 映射
MultiGLTFMarker.addData.en: Adds a data item for a child marker and refreshes the layer marker map.

MultiGLTFMarker.addTo.zh: 把 marker 添加到指定 layer，已在图层上会抛错
MultiGLTFMarker.addTo.en: Add the marker to the given layer, throws if it is already added to one

MultiGLTFMarker.cancelHighlight.zh: 取消指定数据项的高亮，可限定 node
MultiGLTFMarker.cancelHighlight.en: Cancel the highlight of a data item, optionally limited to the given node

MultiGLTFMarker.cancelMarkerPixelHeight.zh: 取消 markerPixelHeight 指定的模型像素高度
MultiGLTFMarker.cancelMarkerPixelHeight.en: Cancel the model pixel height set by markerPixelHeight

MultiGLTFMarker.cancelOutline.zh: 取消指定索引数据项的描边
MultiGLTFMarker.cancelOutline.en: Turn off the outline of the data item at the given index.

MultiGLTFMarker.combineGLTFBoundingBox.zh: 合并多个 marker 的 boundingBox 返回 min 与 max，无 marker 时返回 null
MultiGLTFMarker.combineGLTFBoundingBox.en: Merge the bounding boxes of several markers into one min and max, or null when the list is empty.

MultiGLTFMarker.copy.zh: 按当前 marker 的 JSON 复制出一个新的 marker 实例
MultiGLTFMarker.copy.en: Create a new marker instance copied from the JSON of the current marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.fromJSON.zh: 由 json 的 data 与 options 反序列化出 MultiGLTFMarker
MultiGLTFMarker.fromJSON.en: Create a MultiGLTFMarker from the data and options in the given JSON.

MultiGLTFMarker.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent，无 map 时返回 null
MultiGLTFMarker.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry 2D pixel extent at the current zoom, or null when it has no map.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAllData.zh: 获取全部子 marker 的数据项数组
MultiGLTFMarker.getAllData.en: Returns the data item array of all child markers.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAllMeshes.zh: 获取 marker 创建的全部 mesh，不做视锥剔除
MultiGLTFMarker.getAllMeshes.en: Get all meshes created for the marker, without frustum culling.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的 altitude 值，取自 properties 或 coordinate 的 z 值，都没有时返回 0
MultiGLTFMarker.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude from its properties or coordinate z, returning 0 when unset.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAnchorZ.zh: 获取模型 Z 轴锚点，未设置时返回 bottom
MultiGLTFMarker.getAnchorZ.en: Get the model Z axis anchor, defaulting to bottom when it is not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAnimations.zh: 获取模型全部动画名列表，无动画时返回 null
MultiGLTFMarker.getAnimations.en: Get the names of all model animations, or null when the model has none.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAnimationSpeed.zh: 获取动画播放速度，未设置时为 1
MultiGLTFMarker.getAnimationSpeed.en: Get the animation playback speed, defaulting to 1 when it is not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisXWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 X 轴方向的宽度
MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisXWidth.en: Get the width of the model bounding box along the X axis.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisYWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 Y 轴方向的宽度，内部取 Z 轴值
MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisYWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width along the Y axis, read from the Z value internally.

MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisZWidth.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 沿 Z 轴方向的宽度，内部取 Y 轴值
MultiGLTFMarker.getAxisZWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width along the Z axis, read from the Y value internally.

MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBox.zh: 获取合并所有 mesh 后的模型包围盒，未创建 mesh 时返回 null
MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBox.en: Get the model bounding box merged from all meshes, or null when there is no mesh.

MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxCenter.zh: 获取模型 boundingBox 中心的 coordinate，未加载时返回 null
MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxCenter.en: Get the coordinate at the center of the model bounding box, or null before it is loaded.

MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxWidth.zh: 按 axis 取模型 boundingBox 宽度并乘缩放，y 与 z 会互换
MultiGLTFMarker.getBoundingBoxWidth.en: Get the model bounding box width for the given axis times scale; y and z are swapped.

MultiGLTFMarker.getCenter.zh: 计算全部子 marker coordinates 的平均值作为中心点
MultiGLTFMarker.getCenter.en: Compute the center by averaging the coordinates of all child markers.

MultiGLTFMarker.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取模型在容器坐标系下的 extent
MultiGLTFMarker.getContainerExtent.en: Get the model extent in container coordinates, or null without a layer or map.

MultiGLTFMarker.getCoordinates.zh: 按传入事件的 index 获取对应子 marker 的 coordinates
MultiGLTFMarker.getCoordinates.en: Get the coordinates of the child marker at the event index, or null without a valid event.

MultiGLTFMarker.getCount.zh: 获取标记中数据项的数量
MultiGLTFMarker.getCount.en: Get the number of data items held by the marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.getCurrentAnimation.zh: 获取当前设置的 animationName，未设置返回 undefined
MultiGLTFMarker.getCurrentAnimation.en: Get the current animationName from symbol, or undefined when it is not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getCurrentPixelHeight.zh: 获取模型当前在屏幕上占的像素高度
MultiGLTFMarker.getCurrentPixelHeight.en: Get the pixel height the model currently occupies on the screen.

MultiGLTFMarker.getData.zh: 获取指定索引的子 marker 数据项
MultiGLTFMarker.getData.en: Returns the data item of the child marker at the given index.

MultiGLTFMarker.getFitTranslate.zh: 获取将模型包围盒中心移到原点的平移量
MultiGLTFMarker.getFitTranslate.en: Get the translation that moves the model bounding box center to the origin.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅几何体集合类实现
MultiGLTFMarker.getGeometries.en: Get the child geometries of a collection, implemented only by collection geometries.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFAnchorsAlongLineS.zh: 沿线计算 gltf 模型的锚点位置与朝向，支持间距、数量与端点对齐
MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFAnchorsAlongLineS.en: Compute gltf model anchor positions and headings along a line, with gap, count and end snapping options.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFAsset.zh: 获取 GLTF 数据的 asset 元信息，如版本与生成器
MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFAsset.en: Returns the glTF asset metadata of the loaded model, such as version and generator.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFBBox.zh: 获取 GLTF 模型自身的原始包围盒
MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFBBox.en: Returns the original bounding box of the glTF model itself.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFJSON.zh: 获取已加载 glTF 模型的 json 数据
MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFJSON.en: Returns the raw json data of the loaded glTF model.

MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFMarkerType.zh: 获取 marker 类型标识，本类返回 multigltfmarker
MultiGLTFMarker.getGLTFMarkerType.en: Returns the marker type identifier, which is multigltfmarker for this class.

MultiGLTFMarker.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiGLTFMarker.getHoles.en: Returns the hole ring coordinates of a polygon geometry; only some subclasses implement it.

MultiGLTFMarker.getIndexByPickingId.zh: 根据 pickingId 反查数据项的索引
MultiGLTFMarker.getIndexByPickingId.en: Returns the data item index by subtracting the base picking id from the picking id.

MultiGLTFMarker.getLayer.en: Returns the layer the marker belongs to.

MultiGLTFMarker.getMap.zh: 获取标记所在的 map，取不到时回退取所属 layer 的 map
MultiGLTFMarker.getMap.en: Get the map the marker belongs to, falling back to the map of its layer.

MultiGLTFMarker.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
MultiGLTFMarker.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

MultiGLTFMarker.getMeshes.zh: 获取本帧要渲染的 mesh，按视锥剔除并更新矩阵与 uniform
MultiGLTFMarker.getMeshes.en: Returns the meshes to render this frame, frustum culled after matrix and uniform updates.

MultiGLTFMarker.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
MultiGLTFMarker.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

MultiGLTFMarker.getModelHeight.zh: 获取当前设置的模型高度
MultiGLTFMarker.getModelHeight.en: Returns the currently set model height.

MultiGLTFMarker.getModelMatrix.zh: 获取 marker 当前的模型变换矩阵
MultiGLTFMarker.getModelMatrix.en: Returns the current model transform matrix of the marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.getOutline.zh: 获取标记的方框轮廓 marker，尺寸取自 containerExtent
MultiGLTFMarker.getOutline.en: Returns a square outline marker whose size comes from the container extent.

MultiGLTFMarker.getPointZ.zh: 把坐标 z 高度换算成 GL 世界的 point 高度
MultiGLTFMarker.getPointZ.en: Converts the coordinate z altitude into a GL world point height.

MultiGLTFMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
MultiGLTFMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the angle offset used when rotating about the center; only Sector implements it.

MultiGLTFMarker.getRotation.zh: 获取 marker 三个轴向的旋转角度，未设置为 0
MultiGLTFMarker.getRotation.en: Returns the marker rotation on the three axes, 0 when not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getScale.zh: 获取模型三个轴向的缩放比例，未设置为 1
MultiGLTFMarker.getScale.en: Returns the model scale on the three axes, 1 when not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getShader.zh: 获取 marker 当前 shader 名称，未设置返回 pbr
MultiGLTFMarker.getShader.en: Returns the current shader name of the marker, pbr when not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiGLTFMarker.getShell.en: Returns the outer ring coordinates of the geometry; only some subclasses implement it.

MultiGLTFMarker.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
MultiGLTFMarker.getTextDesc.en: Returns the text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol, then cached.

MultiGLTFMarker.getTransformOrigin.zh: 获取模型变换原点，未设置时取标记中心
MultiGLTFMarker.getTransformOrigin.en: Returns the model transform origin, defaulting to the marker center.

MultiGLTFMarker.getTranslation.zh: 获取 marker 当前的平移量三维向量
MultiGLTFMarker.getTranslation.en: Returns the current three dimensional translation vector of the marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.getUniform.zh: 获取指定 key 的 uniform 值
MultiGLTFMarker.getUniform.en: Returns the uniform value for the given key.

MultiGLTFMarker.getUniforms.zh: 获取 marker 当前的 uniform 键值对
MultiGLTFMarker.getUniforms.en: Returns the current uniform key value pairs of the marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.getUrl.zh: 获取模型资源 url，未设置时默认返回 pyramid
MultiGLTFMarker.getUrl.en: Returns the model resource url, defaulting to pyramid when not set.

MultiGLTFMarker.getZoomOnAdded.zh: 获取 marker 加入地图时记录的 zoom 值
MultiGLTFMarker.getZoomOnAdded.en: Returns the zoom recorded when the marker was added to the map.

MultiGLTFMarker.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
MultiGLTFMarker.hasAltitude.en: Check whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

MultiGLTFMarker.hasFunctionDefinition.zh: 判断 symbol 与 uniforms 中是否含 function-type 定义
MultiGLTFMarker.hasFunctionDefinition.en: Check whether the symbol or its uniforms contain a function-type definition

MultiGLTFMarker.hide.zh: 将 symbol 的 visible 设为 false 以隐藏 marker
MultiGLTFMarker.hide.en: Hide the marker by setting the symbol visible to false

MultiGLTFMarker.hideBoundingBox.zh: 隐藏模型的调试包围盒
MultiGLTFMarker.hideBoundingBox.en: Hide the debug bounding box of the model

MultiGLTFMarker.highlight.zh: 高亮指定数据项，可指定 color 与 opacity
MultiGLTFMarker.highlight.en: Highlight the data item at the given index with color and opacity

MultiGLTFMarker.highlightNodes.zh: 按 nodeIndex 高亮数据项中指定的 node
MultiGLTFMarker.highlightNodes.en: Highlight the given nodes of a data item by nodeIndex

MultiGLTFMarker.isAnimated.zh: 是否播放动画，需模型含 animations 且 symbol 开启
MultiGLTFMarker.isAnimated.en: Check whether the model animation plays, needs animations and symbol on

MultiGLTFMarker.isAnimationLooped.en: Check whether the animation is played in a loop

MultiGLTFMarker.isBloom.zh: 是否为 marker 启用了泛光 bloom 效果
MultiGLTFMarker.isBloom.en: Check whether the bloom effect is enabled for the marker

MultiGLTFMarker.isCastShadow.zh: 是否投射阴影，未显式设置时默认开启
MultiGLTFMarker.isCastShadow.en: Check whether the marker casts shadow, enabled by default

MultiGLTFMarker.isDashAnimated.zh: 是否为虚线动画，需 dashEnabled 与 dashAnimate 同时开启
MultiGLTFMarker.isDashAnimated.en: Check whether dash animation is on, needs dashEnabled and dashAnimate

MultiGLTFMarker.isDirty.zh: 是否为待更新状态，mesh 更新后复位
MultiGLTFMarker.isDirty.en: Check whether the marker is dirty and waits for a mesh update

MultiGLTFMarker.isLoaded.zh: 是否已完成 GLTF 模型加载并创建 mesh
MultiGLTFMarker.isLoaded.en: Check whether the gltf model is loaded and its meshes are created

MultiGLTFMarker.isOutline.zh: 判断是否有数据项已开启描边
MultiGLTFMarker.isOutline.en: Check whether any data item has outline enabled

MultiGLTFMarker.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
MultiGLTFMarker.isRotated.en: Check whether the geometry has rotation angle and rotation center

MultiGLTFMarker.isVisible.zh: marker 是否可见，未设置时默认可见
MultiGLTFMarker.isVisible.en: Check whether the marker is visible, visible by default

MultiGLTFMarker.onAdd.zh: 记录 marker 加入图层时的 zoom，用于自适应大小
MultiGLTFMarker.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback when added, records the map zoom for fixed size

MultiGLTFMarker.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
MultiGLTFMarker.onConfig.en: Lifecycle callback after options update, syncs properties and redraws

MultiGLTFMarker.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
MultiGLTFMarker.onHide.en: Lifecycle callback when hidden, closes the opened menu and infoWindow

MultiGLTFMarker.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
MultiGLTFMarker.onPositionChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when position changes, clears cache and redraws

MultiGLTFMarker.onRemove.zh: 移除时清理包围盒与 zoom 等自适应辅助字段
MultiGLTFMarker.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback when removed, clears bounding box and zoom fields

MultiGLTFMarker.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
MultiGLTFMarker.onShapeChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when shape changes, clears cache and redraws

MultiGLTFMarker.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
MultiGLTFMarker.onSymbolChanged.en: Lifecycle callback when symbol changes, refreshes symbol and rebuilds

MultiGLTFMarker.openInfoWindow.zh: 在指定索引子 marker 的坐标处打开 infoWindow，无效时用中心点
MultiGLTFMarker.openInfoWindow.en: Open the infoWindow at the coordinate of the given data item, else center

MultiGLTFMarker.outline.zh: 开启指定索引数据项的描边
MultiGLTFMarker.outline.en: Enable outline for the data item at the given index

MultiGLTFMarker.outlineNodes.zh: 给指定 node 索引的节点加描边
MultiGLTFMarker.outlineNodes.en: Adds outline to the meshes whose node index is in the given list.

MultiGLTFMarker.parseJSONData.zh: 由 JSON 反序列化 marker 并恢复 zoomOnAdded 配置
MultiGLTFMarker.parseJSONData.en: Parses a JSON object into a marker and restores its zoomOnAdded option.

MultiGLTFMarker.remove.zh: 释放 GLTF 资源并销毁 mesh 与纹理，再移除 marker
MultiGLTFMarker.remove.en: Releases glTF resources and disposes meshes and textures, then removes the marker.

MultiGLTFMarker.removeAllData.zh: 清空全部子 marker 的数据项
MultiGLTFMarker.removeAllData.en: Remove all data items of the child markers and mark the marker dirty.

MultiGLTFMarker.removeData.zh: 删除指定索引的子 marker 数据项并刷新图层
MultiGLTFMarker.removeData.en: Remove the data item at the given index and refresh the layer marker map.

MultiGLTFMarker.rotateAround.zh: 让 marker 绕指定 coordinate 旋转并同步朝向
MultiGLTFMarker.rotateAround.en: Rotates the marker around the given coordinate and updates its heading.

MultiGLTFMarker.rotation.zh: 获取模型默认旋转量，symbol 未设置时为 0 0 0
MultiGLTFMarker.rotation.en: Returns the default model rotation, 0 0 0 when the symbol sets none.

MultiGLTFMarker.scale.zh: 获取模型默认缩放量，symbol 未设置时为 1 1 1
MultiGLTFMarker.scale.en: Returns the default model scale, 1 1 1 when the symbol sets none.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
MultiGLTFMarker.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and rewrites the z value of its coordinates.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAnchorZ.zh: 设置模型 Z 轴锚点，可取 bottom top center
MultiGLTFMarker.setAnchorZ.en: Sets the model anchor on the Z axis, one of bottom, top or center.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimation.zh: 设置是否播放模型自带的动画
MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimation.en: Sets whether the animation embedded in the glTF model is played.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationLoop.zh: 设置动画是否循环播放并重置起始时间
MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationLoop.en: Sets whether the animation loops and resets its start time.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationSpeed.zh: 设置动画播放速度倍数
MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationSpeed.en: Sets the playback speed multiplier of the animation.

MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationTimeframe.zh: 按给定时间戳更新模型动画进度
MultiGLTFMarker.setAnimationTimeframe.en: Updates the model animation progress to the given timestamp.

MultiGLTFMarker.setBloom.zh: 设置 marker 是否启用泛光 bloom 效果
MultiGLTFMarker.setBloom.en: Sets whether the marker uses the bloom effect.

MultiGLTFMarker.setCastShadow.zh: 设置 marker 是否投射阴影
MultiGLTFMarker.setCastShadow.en: Sets whether the marker casts shadow.

MultiGLTFMarker.setCoordinates.zh: 设置全部子 marker 的 coordinates，传单个 Coordinate 时整体平移
MultiGLTFMarker.setCoordinates.en: Sets coordinates of all child markers; a single Coordinate shifts them together.

MultiGLTFMarker.setCurrentAnimation.zh: 设置当前播放的动画名，可传名称数组
MultiGLTFMarker.setCurrentAnimation.en: Sets the current animation name, an array of names plays them together.

MultiGLTFMarker.setModelHeight.zh: 设置模型高度，按该高度自动缩放模型
MultiGLTFMarker.setModelHeight.en: Sets the model height and scales the model to match it.

MultiGLTFMarker.setModelMatrix.zh: 设置模型矩阵，并从中分解出 trs 应用
MultiGLTFMarker.setModelMatrix.en: Sets the model matrix and applies the translation rotation scale it holds.

MultiGLTFMarker.setRotation.zh: 按指定轴设置 marker 的旋转角度
MultiGLTFMarker.setRotation.en: Sets the marker rotation angles around the three axes.

MultiGLTFMarker.setScale.zh: 按指定轴设置模型缩放比例
MultiGLTFMarker.setScale.en: Sets the model scale factors along the three axes.

MultiGLTFMarker.setShader.zh: 设置 marker 使用的 shader 名称，默认 pbr
MultiGLTFMarker.setShader.en: Sets the shader name used by the marker, pbr by default.

MultiGLTFMarker.setSymbol.zh: 设置 marker 的 symbol，url 或 shader 变化时重建 mesh
MultiGLTFMarker.setSymbol.en: Sets the marker symbol and rebuilds meshes when url or shader changes.

MultiGLTFMarker.setTransformOrigin.zh: 设置模型变换的原点 coordinate
MultiGLTFMarker.setTransformOrigin.en: Sets the coordinate used as the origin of the model transform.

MultiGLTFMarker.setTranslation.zh: 按指定轴设置 marker 的平移量
MultiGLTFMarker.setTranslation.en: Sets the marker translation offsets along the three axes.

MultiGLTFMarker.setTRS.zh: 按数组一次设置平移、旋转与缩放
MultiGLTFMarker.setTRS.en: Sets translation, rotation and scale together from three arrays.

MultiGLTFMarker.setUniform.zh: 设置单个 uniform 值，nodeIndex 指定作用节点
MultiGLTFMarker.setUniform.en: Set one uniform value, optional nodeIndex limits it to that node

MultiGLTFMarker.setUniforms.zh: 整体设置 shader 的 uniform 键值对
MultiGLTFMarker.setUniforms.en: Set the whole shader uniforms key-value map at once

MultiGLTFMarker.setUrl.zh: 设置模型资源 url，触发 symbol 更新
MultiGLTFMarker.setUrl.en: Set the gltf model url and update the symbol

MultiGLTFMarker.setZoomOnAdded.zh: 设置 marker 加入地图时记录的 zoom 值
MultiGLTFMarker.setZoomOnAdded.en: Set the zoom recorded when the marker is added to the map

MultiGLTFMarker.show.zh: 将 symbol 的 visible 设为 true 以显示 marker
MultiGLTFMarker.show.en: Set symbol visible to true to show the marker

MultiGLTFMarker.showBoundingBox.zh: 显示模型包围盒，可指定线颜色与线透明度
MultiGLTFMarker.showBoundingBox.en: Show the model bounding box, options set line color and opacity

MultiGLTFMarker.toJSON.zh: 导出为 JSON，包含 data、options 与 properties
MultiGLTFMarker.toJSON.en: Export to JSON with data, options and properties

MultiGLTFMarker.translation.zh: 获取模型默认平移量，symbol 未设置时为 0, 0, 0
MultiGLTFMarker.translation.en: Get the model translation offset, zeros when not set in symbol

MultiGLTFMarker.updateAllData.zh: 用数组逐项批量设置全部子 marker 的同一属性值
MultiGLTFMarker.updateAllData.en: Set one property for all child markers, taking each value from the given array.

MultiGLTFMarker.updateData.zh: 修改指定索引子 marker 数据项上某个属性的值
MultiGLTFMarker.updateData.en: Set the named property of the data item at the given index and mark it dirty.

MultiGLTFMarker.updateSymbol.zh: 更新 marker 的 symbol，并处理 bloom 与特效属性
MultiGLTFMarker.updateSymbol.en: Update the marker symbol and handle bloom and effect properties

MultiLineString.endEdit.zh: 结束编辑，恢复编辑前的 symbol 与可见性并触发 editend
MultiLineString.endEdit.en: End editing, restore symbol and visibility and fire editend

MultiLineString.fromJSON.zh: 由 GeoJSON 或 geometry JSON 反序列化出 MultiLineString 实例
MultiLineString.fromJSON.en: Create a MultiLineString from GeoJSON or serialized geometry JSON

MultiLineString.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
MultiLineString.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry 2D pixel extent at current zoom

MultiLineString.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
MultiLineString.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude, a number or an array of altitudes

MultiLineString.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取集合内所有 geometry 的 container extent 并集
MultiLineString.getContainerExtent.en: Get the union of all child geometry container extents

MultiLineString.getCoordinates.zh: 获取集合内各子几何体的 coordinates 数组
MultiLineString.getCoordinates.en: Get coordinates of all child geometries in the collection

MultiLineString.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中的子几何体数组
MultiLineString.getGeometries.en: Get the child geometries of the collection

MultiLineString.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标，线串不实现该方法
MultiLineString.getHoles.en: Get hole rings of a polygon-like geometry, line strings do not implement it

MultiLineString.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
MultiLineString.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among the geometry coordinates

MultiLineString.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
MultiLineString.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among the geometry coordinates

MultiLineString.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
MultiLineString.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angular offset when rotating about center, only Sector implements it

MultiLineString.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，线串不实现该方法
MultiLineString.getShell.en: Get the geometry shell coordinates, line strings do not implement it

MultiLineString.getSymbol.zh: 获取 symbol，无自身 symbol 时返回子 geometry 的 children 数组
MultiLineString.getSymbol.en: Get symbol, or a children array of child symbols when none is set

MultiLineString.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
MultiLineString.getTextDesc.en: Get the cached text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol

MultiLineString.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
MultiLineString.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

MultiLineString.isEditing.zh: 集合是否处于编辑状态
MultiLineString.isEditing.en: Whether the collection is in editing state

MultiLineString.isRotated.zh: 判断几何图形是否已设置旋转角与旋转中心
MultiLineString.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotate angle and a rotate pivot set.

MultiLineString.onAdd.zh: 几何图形被添加到 layer 之后的回调
MultiLineString.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer.

MultiLineString.onConfig.zh: 配置变更回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
MultiLineString.onConfig.en: Callback on config change, syncing properties and repainting when needed.

MultiLineString.onHide.zh: 几何图形隐藏时的回调，关闭菜单与 infoWindow
MultiLineString.onHide.en: Callback when the geometry is hidden, closing its menu and info window.

MultiLineString.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化回调，清理缓存并重绘，触发 positionchange
MultiLineString.onPositionChanged.en: Callback on position change, clearing cache, repainting, firing positionchange.

MultiLineString.onRemove.zh: 几何图形从 layer 移除时的回调
MultiLineString.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer.

MultiLineString.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化回调，清理缓存并重绘，触发 shapechange
MultiLineString.onShapeChanged.en: Callback on shape change, clearing cache, repainting, firing shapechange.

MultiLineString.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化回调，刷新 painter 并触发 symbolchange
MultiLineString.onSymbolChanged.en: Callback on symbol change, refreshing the painter and firing symbolchange.

MultiLineString.redoEdit.zh: 对集合中下一个可重做的 geometry 执行一次重做
MultiLineString.redoEdit.en: Redo one step on the next redoable geometry of the collection.

MultiLineString.redoEditcheck.zh: 集合中所有 geometry 是否已无可重做的编辑步骤
MultiLineString.redoEditcheck.en: Whether every geometry in the collection has no more steps to redo.

MultiLineString.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何图形的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
MultiLineString.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry altitude and also rewrite the z value of its coordinates.

MultiLineString.setCoordinates.zh: 用新 coordinates 重建集合内的子 geometry
MultiLineString.setCoordinates.en: Set new coordinates to the collection, rebuilding its child geometries.

MultiLineString.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，children 数组按序分发给各子 geometry
MultiLineString.setSymbol.en: Set the symbol, applying a children array to child geometries in order.

MultiLineString.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑集合中的全部 geometry
MultiLineString.startEdit.en: Start editing every geometry in the collection.

MultiLineString.undoEdit.zh: 对集合中下一个可撤销的 geometry 执行一次撤销
MultiLineString.undoEdit.en: Undo one step on the next undoable geometry of the collection.

MultiLineString.undoEditcheck.zh: 集合中所有 geometry 是否已无可撤销的编辑步骤
MultiLineString.undoEditcheck.en: Whether every geometry in the collection has no more steps to undo.

MultiPoint.endEdit.zh: 结束对集合的编辑，并恢复编辑前的 symbol 与 draggable
MultiPoint.endEdit.en: End editing of the collection and restore the symbol and draggable option.

MultiPoint.fromJSON.zh: 由 geometry JSON 对象或数组反序列化出 geometry 实例
MultiPoint.fromJSON.en: Deserialize a geometry or an array of geometries from its JSON.

MultiPoint.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何图形的 2D 像素 extent
MultiPoint.get2DExtent.en: Get the 2D pixel extent of the geometry at the current zoom.

MultiPoint.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何图形的 altitude，未设置时取 coordinate 的 z 或 0
MultiPoint.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude, falling back to coordinate z values or 0.

MultiPoint.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取集合内所有 geometry 的 container extent 并集
MultiPoint.getContainerExtent.en: Get the union container extent of all geometries in the collection.

MultiPoint.getCoordinates.zh: 获取集合中各子 geometry 的 coordinates
MultiPoint.getCoordinates.en: Get the coordinates of the child geometries in the collection.

MultiPoint.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中的几何图形们
MultiPoint.getGeometries.en: Get all the geometries contained in the geometry collection.

MultiPoint.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何图形的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiPoint.getHoles.en: Get the hole coordinate array of a polygon geometry, implemented by few subclasses.

MultiPoint.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何图形所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
MultiPoint.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry.

MultiPoint.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
MultiPoint.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

MultiPoint.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
MultiPoint.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the rotation angle offset when rotating around the center, only Sector implements it

MultiPoint.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiPoint.getShell.en: Get the coordinate ring of the geometry shell, only some subclasses implement it

MultiPoint.getSymbol.zh: 获取 symbol，自身未设置时返回子 geometry 的 children 数组
MultiPoint.getSymbol.en: Get the symbol, or a children array of child geometry symbols when none is set

MultiPoint.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
MultiPoint.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol, cached

MultiPoint.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
MultiPoint.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non zero altitude set

MultiPoint.isEditing.zh: 是否正在编辑该几何体
MultiPoint.isEditing.en: Whether the geometry is being edited

MultiPoint.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否同时设置了旋转角与旋转中心
MultiPoint.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotate angle and a pivot set

MultiPoint.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiPoint.onAdd.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer, called by the framework

MultiPoint.onConfig.zh: 把配置变更应用到集合内的每个 geometry
MultiPoint.onConfig.en: Apply the config changes to every geometry inside the collection

MultiPoint.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
MultiPoint.onHide.en: Close the opened menu and infoWindow when the geometry is hidden

MultiPoint.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
MultiPoint.onPositionChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire positionchange when the position changes

MultiPoint.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiPoint.onRemove.en: Callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer

MultiPoint.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
MultiPoint.onShapeChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire shapechange when the shape changes

MultiPoint.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
MultiPoint.onSymbolChanged.en: Refresh symbol, rebuild sizeSymbol and fire the event when symbol changes

MultiPoint.redoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起重做一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 redoedit
MultiPoint.redoEdit.en: Redo one edit step of the child geometries and fire redoedit

MultiPoint.redoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部重做
MultiPoint.redoEditcheck.en: Whether all redoable edits of the child geometries have been redone

MultiPoint.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
MultiPoint.setAltitude.en: Set the altitude of the geometry and update the z values of its coordinates

MultiPoint.setCoordinates.zh: 按新的 coordinate 重建集合内的全部子 geometry
MultiPoint.setCoordinates.en: Set new coordinates by rebuilding every child geometry of the collection

MultiPoint.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，传含 children 的对象时按序分给各子 geometry，否则统一设置
MultiPoint.setSymbol.en: Set the symbol, a children object is assigned in order to child geometries, otherwise shared

MultiPoint.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑集合内全部 geometry，可用 symbol 指定编辑时的样式
MultiPoint.startEdit.en: Start editing all geometries in the collection, with an optional editing symbol

MultiPoint.undoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起撤销一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 undoedit
MultiPoint.undoEdit.en: Undo one edit step of the child geometries and fire undoedit

MultiPoint.undoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部撤回
MultiPoint.undoEditcheck.en: Whether all undoable edits of the child geometries have been undone

MultiPolygon.endEdit.zh: 结束编辑，恢复编辑前的 symbol 与可见性并触发 editend
MultiPolygon.endEdit.en: End editing, restore the symbol and visibility from before editing and fire editend

MultiPolygon.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 还原 geometry，按 subType 取类并恢复 symbol 与 infoWindow
MultiPolygon.fromJSON.en: Restore a geometry from JSON, resolving the class by subType and applying symbol and infoWindow

MultiPolygon.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
MultiPolygon.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom

MultiPolygon.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
MultiPolygon.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry's altitude, a number or an array of altitudes

MultiPolygon.getContainerExtent.zh: 获取集合内所有 geometry 的 container extent 并集
MultiPolygon.getContainerExtent.en: Get the union of the container extents of all geometries in the collection

MultiPolygon.getCoordinates.zh: 获取集合内各 geometry 的 coordinate 数组

MultiPolygon.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何集合中的子 geometry 数组
MultiPolygon.getGeometries.en: Get geometries of the geometry collection

MultiPolygon.getHoles.zh: 获取几何体孔洞的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiPolygon.getHoles.en: Get the holes' coordinates of the geometry, implemented by some subclasses

MultiPolygon.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
MultiPolygon.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

MultiPolygon.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
MultiPolygon.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

MultiPolygon.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体绕中心旋转时的角度偏移
MultiPolygon.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset used when rotating the geometry around its center

MultiPolygon.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅部分子类实现
MultiPolygon.getShell.en: Get the outer ring coordinates of the geometry, implemented by some subclasses

MultiPolygon.getSymbol.zh: 获取 symbol，无自身 symbol 时返回子 geometry 的 children 数组
MultiPolygon.getSymbol.en: Get the symbol, or a children array of child geometries' symbols when none is set

MultiPolygon.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
MultiPolygon.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed and cached from text content and sizeSymbol

MultiPolygon.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
MultiPolygon.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

MultiPolygon.isEditing.zh: 集合是否处于编辑状态
MultiPolygon.isEditing.en: Whether the collection is being edited

MultiPolygon.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
MultiPolygon.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotation angle and a rotation pivot

MultiPolygon.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiPolygon.onAdd.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer

MultiPolygon.onConfig.zh: 把配置变更应用到集合内的每个 geometry
MultiPolygon.onConfig.en: Apply the config changes to every geometry in the collection

MultiPolygon.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
MultiPolygon.onHide.en: Close the opened menu and infoWindow when the geometry is hidden

MultiPolygon.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
MultiPolygon.onPositionChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire the positionchange event on position change

MultiPolygon.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
MultiPolygon.onRemove.en: Callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer

MultiPolygon.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
MultiPolygon.onShapeChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire the shapechange event on shape change

MultiPolygon.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
MultiPolygon.onSymbolChanged.en: Refresh symbol, rebuild sizeSymbol and fire the symbolchange event

MultiPolygon.redoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起重做一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 redoedit
MultiPolygon.redoEdit.en: Redo one child geometry's edit from the last index and fire redoedit

MultiPolygon.redoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已全部重做
MultiPolygon.redoEditcheck.en: Whether all child geometries' edits have been fully redone

MultiPolygon.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
MultiPolygon.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry's altitude and update the z value of its coordinates

MultiPolygon.setCoordinates.zh: 按坐标数组重建集合内的 polygon，原有子 geometry 被替换
MultiPolygon.setCoordinates.en: Rebuild the collection's polygons from a coordinate array, replacing the existing children.

MultiPolygon.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，传含 children 的对象时按序分给各子 geometry，否则统一设置
MultiPolygon.setSymbol.en: Set the symbol; a children object distributes them to child geometries in order, otherwise applies to all.

MultiPolygon.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑集合内全部 geometry，可用 symbol 指定编辑时的样式
MultiPolygon.startEdit.en: Start editing all geometries in the collection, with an optional symbol used while editing.

MultiPolygon.undoEdit.zh: 从上次位置起撤销一个子 geometry 的编辑并触发 undoedit
MultiPolygon.undoEdit.en: Undo one child geometry edit from the last recorded index and fire undoedit.

MultiPolygon.undoEditcheck.zh: 是否所有子 geometry 的编辑都已撤回
MultiPolygon.undoEditcheck.en: Whether the edits of all child geometries have been fully undone.

Nav.buildOn.zh: 空实现，返回 null，控件不创建任何 DOM
Nav.buildOn.en: Returns null so the nav control creates no DOM element itself.

Nav.onAdd.zh: 控件加入 map 后的可选回调，Nav 未重写，默认不做任何事
Nav.onAdd.en: Optional callback after the control is added to a map, not overridden by Nav.

Nav.onConfig.zh: 配置中含 position 时重新计算并更新控件位置
Nav.onConfig.en: Recompute and update the control position when the config contains position.

Nav.onRemove.zh: 控件从 map 移除后的可选回调，Nav 未重写，默认不做任何事
Nav.onRemove.en: Optional callback after the control is removed from the map, not overridden by Nav.

OverlayLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高程，OverlayLayer 固定返回 0
OverlayLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude; OverlayLayer always returns 0.

OverlayLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
OverlayLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layer list, implemented only by group layers.

OverlayLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例，创建前为 undefined
OverlayLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer's renderer instance, undefined before it is created.

OverlayLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
OverlayLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses according to the map renderer type.

OverlayLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有几何体隐藏
OverlayLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify every geometry in it to hide.

OverlayLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
OverlayLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer by coordinate, implemented by subclasses.

OverlayLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 geometry，由子类实现
OverlayLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries by container point, implemented by subclasses.

OverlayLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
OverlayLayer.onAdd.en: Callback called after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses may override it.

OverlayLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 几何体加入图层时按图层 style 设置其 symbol
OverlayLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Apply the layer style to a geometry's symbol when it is added to the layer.

OverlayLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
OverlayLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback called after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override it.

OverlayLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
OverlayLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on option change that triggers a redraw and an attribution update.

OverlayLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 响应几何体变化事件，同步图层缓存与 renderer
OverlayLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Respond to geometry change events and sync the layer cache and renderer.

OverlayLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
OverlayLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called when the layer finishes loading, overridden by subclasses, empty by default.

OverlayLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
OverlayLayer.onRemove.en: Callback called when the layer is removed from the map, subclasses may override it.

OverlayLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
OverlayLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback called after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override it.

OverlayLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 配置并请求重绘
OverlayLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

OverlayLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并重新排序 map 上的图层
OverlayLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer z-index, re-sorts the map layers and fires setzindex.

OverlayLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出 layer 的 JSON 描述，含 type id 与 options
OverlayLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer JSON description with its type, id and options.

Overview.onAdd.zh: 控件加入地图时创建概览地图并监听地图事件
Overview.onAdd.en: Create the overview map and listen to map events when the control is added to a map.

Overview.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，position 变化时刷新控件位置
Overview.onConfig.en: Config change callback that refreshes the control position when position changes.

Overview.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时解绑地图事件并销毁概览地图
Overview.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback that unbinds map events and destroys the overview map when the control is removed.

Panel.onAdd.zh: 控件添加到 map 后的回调，子类可重写，默认空实现
Panel.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the control is added to the map, empty by default and overridable.

Panel.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，position 变化时刷新控件位置
Panel.onConfig.en: Config change callback that refreshes the control position when position changes.

Panel.onRemove.zh: 控件从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写，默认空实现
Panel.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the control is removed from the map, empty by default.

ParticleLayer.clearCanvas.en: Clears the layer canvas through its renderer.

ParticleLayer.completeRender.en: Asks the map to redraw the layer canvas and fire the layerload event.

ParticleLayer.doubleBuffer.zh: double buffer 回调，默认清空缓冲画布后返回自身
ParticleLayer.doubleBuffer.en: Clears the buffer context and returns this; override it to process the canvas before drawing.

ParticleLayer.draw.zh: 绘制此刻的粒子，按 extent 裁剪后画成圆点或方块并叠加拖尾
ParticleLayer.draw.en: Draw the particles at the current time, clipped by the extent, as dots or squares with trails.

ParticleLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
ParticleLayer.getLayers.en: Get the sub layer list, implemented only by group type layers.

ParticleLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例
ParticleLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer.

ParticleLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 获取 layer 实际使用的 renderer 名称，按 map 渲染器取 gl 或 gpu
ParticleLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer name in use, resolved to gl or gpu by the map renderer.

ParticleLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
ParticleLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer by coordinate, implemented by subclasses.

ParticleLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
ParticleLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries on the layer by container point, implemented by subclasses.

ParticleLayer.isCanvasRender.zh: 是否为 HTML5 Canvas 渲染的 layer，本类固定返回 true
ParticleLayer.isCanvasRender.en: Whether the layer is rendered by HTML5 Canvas, always true for this class.

ParticleLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
ParticleLayer.onAdd.en: Lifecycle callback invoked after the layer is bound to a map, overridable by subclasses.

ParticleLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ParticleLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer canvas is created, override it to do custom work.

ParticleLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
ParticleLayer.onConfig.en: Config change callback that redraws the layer and refreshes attribution.

ParticleLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
ParticleLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook invoked when the layer finishes loading, empty by default and overridable.

ParticleLayer.onMoveEnd.en: The event callback for the map moveend event.

ParticleLayer.onMoveStart.en: The event callback for the map movestart event.

ParticleLayer.onMoving.en: The event callback for the map moving event.

ParticleLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
ParticleLayer.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback invoked when the layer is removed from the map, overridable.

ParticleLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
ParticleLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback invoked after the layer renderer is created, overridable by subclasses.

ParticleLayer.onResize.en: The event callback for the map resize event.

ParticleLayer.onZoomEnd.en: The event callback for the map zoomend event.

ParticleLayer.onZooming.en: The event callback for the map zooming event.

ParticleLayer.onZoomStart.en: The event callback for the map zoomstart event.

ParticleLayer.prepareToDraw.zh: 准备画布的接口函数，首次绘制前调用一次
ParticleLayer.prepareToDraw.en: An optional interface function called only once before the first draw, useful for preparing your canvas operations.

ParticleLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 配置并请求重绘
ParticleLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer mask and requests a redraw.

ParticleLayer.requestMapToRender.zh: 要求map不触发任何事件下重绘canvas
ParticleLayer.requestMapToRender.en: Ask the map to redraw the layer canvas without firing any event.

ParticleLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并同步 options、图层顺序与渲染器
ParticleLayer.setZIndex.en: Set the layer z-index, syncing its options, map layer order and renderer.

ParticleLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出 layer 的 JSON 描述，含 type、id 与 options；粒子图层不支持反序列化
ParticleLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer as JSON with type, id and options, ParticleLayer itself is not deserializable.

Path.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，反序列化由子类实现
Path.fromJSON.en: Return the given geometry JSON as is, deserialization is implemented by subclasses.

Path.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下 geometry 的 2D 像素 extent
Path.get2DExtent.en: Get the 2D pixel extent of the geometry at the current zoom.

Path.getAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 的 altitude，返回数值或高度数组
Path.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude as a number or an array of numbers.

Path.getCoordinates.zh: 获取 geometry 的 coordinate，按类型返回坐标或嵌套数组
Path.getCoordinates.en: Get geometry coordinates, as a coordinate array or nested arrays by type.

Path.getGeometries.zh: 获取 geometry 集合内的子 geometry 数组，仅集合类子类实现
Path.getGeometries.en: Get child geometries of a geometry collection, implemented only by collection classes.

Path.getHoles.zh: 获取面状 geometry 的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
Path.getHoles.en: Get the hole coordinate rings of a polygon-like geometry, implemented by some subclasses.

Path.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取 geometry 所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Path.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among the geometry coordinates.

Path.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取 path 所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
Path.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among the path's coordinates.

Path.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取 path 按中心旋转时的角度偏移，仅部分子类实现
Path.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset used when the path rotates around its center, implemented by some subclasses.

Path.getShell.zh: 获取 path 外环的 coordinate 数组，仅 Polygon 等子类实现
Path.getShell.en: Get the shell coordinates of the path, implemented only by subclasses such as Polygon.

Path.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Path.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed and cached from the text content and size symbol.

Path.hasAltitude.zh: 判断 path 是否设置了非零的 altitude
Path.hasAltitude.en: Whether the path has a non-zero altitude set.

Path.hasHoles.zh: 是否为带孔洞的图形，由 Polygon 等子类实现
Path.hasHoles.en: Whether the path has holes inside, implemented by subclasses such as Polygon.

Path.isRotated.zh: 判断 path 是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Path.isRotated.en: Whether the path has both a rotation angle and a pivot set.

Path.onAdd.zh: path 加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
Path.onAdd.en: Callback invoked after the path is added to a layer, called internally by the framework.

Path.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
Path.onConfig.en: Callback after config updates the options; it syncs properties and repaints when needed.

Path.onHide.zh: path 隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
Path.onHide.en: Callback when the path is hidden; it closes any open menu and info window.

Path.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
Path.onPositionChanged.en: Clears the cache, repaints and fires the positionchange event when the position changes.

Path.onRemove.zh: path 从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Path.onRemove.en: Callback invoked when the path is removed from its layer, called internally by the framework.

Path.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Path.onShapeChanged.en: Clears the cache, repaints and fires the shapechange event when the shape changes.

Path.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
Path.onSymbolChanged.en: Refreshes the symbol, rebuilds the size symbol and fires the symbolchange event.

Path.setAltitude.zh: 设置 path 的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
Path.setAltitude.en: Set the path altitude and update the z value of its coordinates accordingly.

Path.setCoordinates.zh: 设置 path 的 coordinate 并更新其几何状态，由子类实现
Path.setCoordinates.en: Set the path coordinates and update its geometry state, implemented by each subclass.

Player.reverse.zh: 反转动画播放，源码中为空实现
Player.reverse.en: Reverse the animation playback; an empty implementation in the source.

PointExtent.add.zh: 与 coordinate、point 或 extent 相加，返回新的 extent
PointExtent.add.en: Add a coordinate, point or extent, returning a new extent.

PointExtent.contains.zh: 判断 extent 是否包含传入的 coordinate 或 extent
PointExtent.contains.en: Whether the extent contains the given coordinate, point or extent.

PointExtent.convertTo.zh: 按给定函数转换 extent 的角点，返回新 extent，out 可复用
PointExtent.convertTo.en: Convert the extent corners with a function, returning a new extent; out can be reused.

PointExtent.getMax.zh: 获取 extent 的最大点，可传入 out 复用对象
PointExtent.getMax.en: Get the maximum point of the extent; out can be passed to reuse an object.

PointExtent.getMin.zh: 获取 extent 的最小点，可传入 out 复用对象
PointExtent.getMin.en: Get the minimum point of the extent; out can be passed to reuse an object.

PointExtent.sub.zh: 减去 coordinate、point 或 extent，返回新的 extent
PointExtent.sub.en: Subtract a coordinate, point or extent, returning a new extent.

PointExtent.substract.zh: 减去 coordinate、point 或 extent，sub 的别名
PointExtent.substract.en: Subtract a coordinate, point or extent; alias for sub.

PointExtent.toBBOX.zh: 以数组返回 extent 的 xmin ymin xmax ymax
PointExtent.toBBOX.en: Return the extent as an array of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax.

PointLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层内 geometry 的描边高亮
PointLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancel the outline highlight of the geometries in the layer.

PointLayer.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名字获取已注册的 3D painter 类
PointLayer.get3DPainterClass.en: Get the registered 3D painter class by name

PointLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高程，点图层固定返回 0
PointLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the altitude of the layer, always 0 for PointLayer

PointLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层计算后样式并以 style 字段返回
PointLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get the layer's computed style, returned in the style field

PointLayer.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的事件映射，含空间参考变化事件
PointLayer.getEvents.en: Get the event map the layer listens to, including spatial reference change

PointLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
PointLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, implemented only by group layers

PointLayer.getPolygonOffset.zh: 获取多边形偏移值，点图层固定返回 0
PointLayer.getPolygonOffset.en: Get the polygon offset, PointLayer always returns 0

PointLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh: 获取多边形偏移数量，点图层固定返回 0
PointLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Get the polygon offset count, PointLayer always returns 0

PointLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例
PointLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer

PointLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
PointLayer.getRendererOption.en: Get the renderer name used by the layer for the map's renderer type

PointLayer.getTileSize.zh: 返回 painter 内部使用的默认 tile 尺寸 1x1
PointLayer.getTileSize.en: Get the default tile size 1x1 used internally by painters

PointLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.zh: 获取 GroupGLLayer 分配的 polygonOffset 总数
PointLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.en: Get the total polygonOffset allocated by GroupGLLayer

PointLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数
PointLayer.getURLModifier.en: Get the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls

PointLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有 geometry 隐藏
PointLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify all its geometries to hide

PointLayer.identify.zh: 查询给定 coordinate 处命中的 geometry 数组
PointLayer.identify.en: Identify the geometries at the given coordinate

PointLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 查询给定容器坐标点命中的 geometry，可设容差与数量
PointLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at a container point with optional tolerance and count

PointLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
PointLayer.onAdd.en: Callback after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses may override

PointLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: geometry 加入图层时按图层 style 设置其 symbol
PointLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Called when a geometry is added, applies the layer style to its symbol

PointLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
PointLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override

PointLayer.onConfig.zh: 配置项更新时把 bloom 开关同步给 renderer
PointLayer.onConfig.en: Called on option change, syncs the bloom switches to the renderer

PointLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 响应 geometry 变化事件，同步图层缓存与 renderer
PointLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Handle geometry change events and keep layer cache and renderer in sync

PointLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
PointLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook after the layer finishes loading, overridden by subclasses

PointLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
PointLayer.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from the map, subclasses may override

PointLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
PointLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override

PointLayer.outline.zh: 为指定 id 数组的 geometry 添加描边高亮
PointLayer.outline.en: Add outline highlight to the geometries with the given ids

PointLayer.outlineAll.zh: 为图层内全部 geometry 添加描边高亮

PointLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 遮罩并清空 mask 选项

PointLayer.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层 polygonOffset 及全局总数供 GroupGLLayer 统一管理
PointLayer.setPolygonOffset.en: Set the layer polygonOffset and the global total for GroupGLLayer management

PointLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数并返回图层
PointLayer.setURLModifier.en: Set the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls and return the layer

PointLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并同步 options、图层顺序与渲染器
PointLayer.setZIndex.en: Set the layer z-index, syncing its options, map layer order and renderer.

PointLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出图层的 JSON，含 type id options 与全部 geometry
PointLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer JSON with type, id, options and all geometries

PointLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 把 symbol 属性合并进样式数组第 idx 项并刷新图层样式
PointLayer.updateSymbol.en: Merge symbol properties into style item idx and refresh the layer style

Polygon.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做反序列化处理
Polygon.fromJSON.en: Return the given geometry JSON as is without any deserialization

Polygon.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
Polygon.get2DExtent.en: Get the 2D pixel extent of the geometry at the current zoom

Polygon.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
Polygon.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude as a number or an array of altitudes

Polygon.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现

Polygon.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Polygon.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among all coordinates of the geometry

Polygon.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude

Polygon.getOutline.zh: 按 extent 生成描边多边形，无 painter 时返回 null

Polygon.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
Polygon.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the rotation angle offset about the center, implemented only by Sector

Polygon.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Polygon.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol, cached

Polygon.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
Polygon.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude set

Polygon.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Polygon.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotation angle and a pivot set

Polygon.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
Polygon.onAdd.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is added onto a layer

Polygon.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
Polygon.onConfig.en: Callback after config updates options, syncing properties and repainting

Polygon.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
Polygon.onHide.en: Callback when the geometry is hidden, closing its menu and infoWindow

Polygon.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件

Polygon.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Polygon.onRemove.en: Callback invoked when the geometry is removed from its layer

Polygon.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Polygon.onShapeChanged.en: Clear caches, repaint and fire shapechange when the shape changes

Polygon.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件

Polygon.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry altitude and update the z value of its coordinates

PolygonLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层内 geometry 的描边高亮
PolygonLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancel the outline highlight of the geometries in the layer

PolygonLayer.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名字获取已注册的 3D painter 类
PolygonLayer.get3DPainterClass.en: Get a registered 3D painter class by name

PolygonLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层高程，PolygonLayer 固定返回 0
PolygonLayer.getAltitude.en: Get the layer altitude; returns 0 for PolygonLayer

PolygonLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层当前生效的样式，以 style 字段返回
PolygonLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get the layer's computed style, returned under the style field

PolygonLayer.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的事件映射，含空间参考变化事件
PolygonLayer.getEvents.en: Return the layer's event map, including spatialreferencechange

PolygonLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
PolygonLayer.getLayers.en: Get sub layers; implemented only by group layer types

PolygonLayer.getPolygonOffset.zh: 获取图层的基础 polygonOffset 值，默认 0
PolygonLayer.getPolygonOffset.en: Get the layer base polygon offset, which stays 0 unless GroupGLLayer sets it.

PolygonLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh: 获取多边形绘制所需的 polygonOffset 层数，有高度时为 0，无高度时为 2
PolygonLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Get the polygon offset count, 0 for polygons with altitude and 2 without.

PolygonLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取 layer 的 renderer 实例

PolygonLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
PolygonLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses, based on the map renderer type

PolygonLayer.getTileSize.zh: 返回 painter 内部使用的默认 tile 尺寸 1x1
PolygonLayer.getTileSize.en: Return the default 1x1 tile size used internally by painters

PolygonLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.zh: 获取 GroupGLLayer 分配的 polygonOffset 总数
PolygonLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.en: Get the total polygonOffset assigned by GroupGLLayer

PolygonLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数
PolygonLayer.getURLModifier.en: Get the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls

PolygonLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有 geometry 隐藏
PolygonLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify all its geometries to hide

PolygonLayer.identify.zh: 按地理 coordinate 拾取 geometry，返回命中的结果数组
PolygonLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries at the given coordinate and return the hits

PolygonLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按容器像素点拾取 geometry，支持容差、数量与过滤
PolygonLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at a container point, with tolerance, count and filter

PolygonLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
PolygonLayer.onAdd.en: Callback after the layer is bound to a map, overridable by subclasses

PolygonLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: geometry 加入图层时按图层 style 设置其 symbol
PolygonLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Called when a geometry is added, applying the layer style to its symbol

PolygonLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
PolygonLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, overridable by subclasses

PolygonLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，把 bloom 开关同步给 renderer
PolygonLayer.onConfig.en: Callback after options change, syncing bloom switches to the renderer

PolygonLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 响应几何体事件，按事件类型同步 renderer 与图层缓存
PolygonLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Respond to geometry events, syncing the renderer and layer cache by type

PolygonLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，子类可重写，默认空实现
PolygonLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook fired after the layer finishes loading, empty by default, overridable

PolygonLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
PolygonLayer.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from a map, overridable by subclasses

PolygonLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
PolygonLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created, overridable by subclasses

PolygonLayer.outline.zh: 为指定 id 数组的 geometry 添加描边高亮
PolygonLayer.outline.en: Add outline highlight to the geometries with the given ids

PolygonLayer.outlineAll.zh: 为图层内全部 geometry 添加描边高亮
PolygonLayer.outlineAll.en: Add outline highlight to all geometries in the layer

PolygonLayer.registerPainter.zh: 静态方法，按名字注册 3D painter 类供图层渲染时查找
PolygonLayer.registerPainter.en: Static method registering a 3D painter class by name for lookup

PolygonLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 遮罩并清空 mask 选项
PolygonLayer.removeMask.en: Remove the mask from the layer and clear the mask option.

PolygonLayer.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层 polygonOffset 及总数，供 GroupGLLayer 统一管理
PolygonLayer.setPolygonOffset.en: Set the layer polygonOffset and total count managed by GroupGLLayer

PolygonLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数并返回图层
PolygonLayer.setURLModifier.en: Set the modifier function for resource loading urls and return the layer

PolygonLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并同步 options、图层顺序与渲染器
PolygonLayer.setZIndex.en: Set the layer z-index, syncing its options, map layer order and renderer.

PolygonLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出图层的 JSON，含 type id options 与全部 geometry
PolygonLayer.toJSON.en: Exports the layer JSON with its type, id, options and all geometries

PolygonLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 把 symbol 属性合并进样式数组第 idx 项并刷新图层样式
PolygonLayer.updateSymbol.en: Merges the symbol into the style at index idx and reapplies the layer style

QuadBezierCurve.fromJSON.zh: 由 feature 坐标与 options 反序列化出 QuadBezierCurve，并还原其 properties
QuadBezierCurve.fromJSON.en: Deserializes a QuadBezierCurve from feature coordinates and options, restoring its properties

QuadBezierCurve.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下曲线的 2D 像素 extent，不在 map 上返回 null
QuadBezierCurve.get2DExtent.en: Returns the curve 2D pixel extent at current zoom, null when not on a map

QuadBezierCurve.getAltitude.zh: 获取曲线海拔，取 properties 或 coordinate 的 z 值，缺省为 0
QuadBezierCurve.getAltitude.en: Returns the curve altitude from properties or coordinate z, 0 when absent

QuadBezierCurve.getCoordinates.zh: 获取曲线的 coordinates，即构成曲线的 coordinate 列表
QuadBezierCurve.getCoordinates.en: Returns the curve coordinates, the coordinate list forming the curve

QuadBezierCurve.getGeometries.en: Returns child geometries of the collection; optional member not implemented by curves

QuadBezierCurve.getHoles.en: Returns hole rings of the geometry; optional member not implemented by curves

QuadBezierCurve.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取曲线所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
QuadBezierCurve.getMaxAltitude.en: Returns the maximum altitude among the curve coordinates

QuadBezierCurve.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取曲线所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
QuadBezierCurve.getMinAltitude.en: Returns the minimum altitude among the curve coordinates

QuadBezierCurve.getOutline.en: Returns an outline polygon of the curve extent, null without a painter
