QuadBezierCurve.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Returns the rotation offset angle; optional member not implemented by curves

QuadBezierCurve.getShell.zh: 获取几何图形外壳的 ring 坐标，可选成员，曲线不实现
QuadBezierCurve.getShell.en: Returns shell ring coordinates; optional member not implemented by curves

QuadBezierCurve.getTextDesc.zh: 获取由 symbol 的 textName 与 properties 生成的文本描述并缓存
QuadBezierCurve.getTextDesc.en: Returns the cached text description built from symbol textName and properties

QuadBezierCurve.hasAltitude.zh: 判断曲线是否设置了非零的 altitude
QuadBezierCurve.hasAltitude.en: Whether the curve has a non-zero altitude

QuadBezierCurve.hasHoles.zh: 判断几何图形是否带洞，可选成员，曲线不实现
QuadBezierCurve.hasHoles.en: Whether the geometry has holes; optional member not implemented by curves

QuadBezierCurve.isRotated.zh: 判断曲线是否同时设置了旋转角与旋转中心
QuadBezierCurve.isRotated.en: Whether the curve has been rotated with both an angle and a pivot

QuadBezierCurve.onAdd.zh: 曲线加入 layer 时的可选回调，QuadBezierCurve 未实现
QuadBezierCurve.onAdd.en: Optional lifecycle callback when added to a layer; not implemented by QuadBezierCurve

QuadBezierCurve.onConfig.zh: 配置更新时的回调，应用 properties 并在箭头等参数变化时重绘
QuadBezierCurve.onConfig.en: Config callback applying properties and repainting on arrow or smooth changes

QuadBezierCurve.onHide.zh: 曲线隐藏时的回调，关闭其菜单与 info window
QuadBezierCurve.onHide.en: Callback when the curve is hidden, closing its menu and info window

QuadBezierCurve.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 positionchange
QuadBezierCurve.onPositionChanged.en: Callback on position change, clearing caches, repainting and firing positionchange

QuadBezierCurve.onRemove.zh: 曲线从 layer 移除时的可选回调，QuadBezierCurve 未实现
QuadBezierCurve.onRemove.en: Optional lifecycle callback when removed from a layer; not implemented by QuadBezierCurve

QuadBezierCurve.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化后的回调，清缓存重绘并触发 shapechange
QuadBezierCurve.onShapeChanged.en: Callback after shape change, clearing caches, repainting and firing shapechange

QuadBezierCurve.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化后的回调，刷新 symbol 并触发 symbolchange
QuadBezierCurve.onSymbolChanged.en: Callback after symbol change, refreshing the symbol and firing symbolchange

QuadBezierCurve.setAltitude.zh: 设置曲线的 altitude，同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值并重绘
QuadBezierCurve.setAltitude.en: Sets the curve altitude, syncing coordinate z values and repainting

QuadBezierCurve.setCoordinates.zh: 设置二次贝塞尔曲线的 coordinate 数组，并按新坐标重新投影

Rectangle.animateShow.zh: 以动画方式显示矩形，内部即调用 show

Rectangle.fromJSON.zh: 由 coordinates、width、height 与 options 反序列化出 Rectangle
Rectangle.fromJSON.en: Creates a Rectangle from the coordinates, width, height and options in json

Rectangle.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
Rectangle.get2DExtent.en: Gets the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom

Rectangle.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
Rectangle.getAltitude.en: Gets the geometry altitude, as a number or an array of altitudes

Rectangle.getGeometries.zh: 获取集合内的子 geometry 数组，仅集合类子类实现
Rectangle.getGeometries.en: Gets child geometries of a collection; only collection subclasses implement it

Rectangle.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Rectangle.getMaxAltitude.en: Gets the maximum altitude among the geometry's coordinates

Rectangle.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
Rectangle.getMinAltitude.en: Gets the minimum altitude among the geometry's coordinates

Rectangle.getOutline.zh: 按 extent 生成描边多边形，无 painter 时返回 null
Rectangle.getOutline.en: Builds an outline polygon from the extent, null when no painter exists

Rectangle.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现

Rectangle.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Rectangle.getTextDesc.en: Gets the cached text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol

Rectangle.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
Rectangle.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

Rectangle.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心

Rectangle.onHide.en: Called when the geometry is hidden, closing the open menu and infoWindow

Rectangle.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
Rectangle.onPositionChanged.en: Clears cache, repaints and fires positionchange when the position changes

Rectangle.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Rectangle.onRemove.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is removed from its layer

Rectangle.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Rectangle.onShapeChanged.en: Clears cache, repaints and fires shapechange when the shape changes

Rectangle.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件

Rectangle.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
Rectangle.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and rewrites the z value of its coordinates

Reset.onConfig.zh: config 变更时若含 position 就重新计算控件位置

Reset.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时清除 DOM 与视图引用
Reset.onRemove.en: Deletes the DOM and stored view references when the control is removed

Reset.setView.zh: 设置点击控件时要恢复的地图视图
Reset.setView.en: Set the map view that the reset control restores when it is clicked.

Scale.onAdd.zh: 控件加入地图后的可选回调，Scale 未覆写该钩子
Scale.onAdd.en: Optional callback after the control is added to a map; Scale does not override it

Scale.onConfig.zh: config 变更时若含 position 就重新定位控件
Scale.onConfig.en: Repositions the control when the new config contains position

Scale.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时解绑地图事件，停止比例尺刷新

Sector.animateShow.zh: 扇形不做动画，直接调用 show 显示图形

Sector.fromJSON.zh: 由 coordinates、radius、起止角度与 options 反序列化出 Sector
Sector.fromJSON.en: Creates a Sector from coordinates, radius, start and end angles plus options in json

Sector.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
Sector.get2DExtent.en: Gets the geometry's 2D pixel extent at the current zoom

Sector.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
Sector.getAltitude.en: Gets the geometry altitude, as a number or an array of altitudes

Sector.getCoordinates.en: Gets the center coordinate of the sector

Sector.getGeometries.zh: 获取集合内的子 geometry 数组，仅集合类子类实现

Sector.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
Sector.getMaxAltitude.en: Gets the maximum altitude among the geometry's coordinates

Sector.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
Sector.getMinAltitude.en: Gets the minimum altitude among the geometry's coordinates

Sector.getOutline.zh: 按 extent 生成描边多边形，无 painter 时返回 null
Sector.getOutline.en: Builds an outline polygon from the extent, null when no painter exists

Sector.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Gets the fixed 90 degree offset angle used when rotating the sector's coordinates

Sector.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
Sector.getTextDesc.en: Gets the cached text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol

Sector.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
Sector.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude

Sector.hasHoles.zh: 扇形恒无孔洞，始终返回 false
Sector.hasHoles.en: Sector never has holes and always returns false

Sector.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
Sector.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotation angle and a pivot

Sector.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入 layer 后的回调，由框架内部调用
Sector.onAdd.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is added to a layer

Sector.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
Sector.onConfig.en: Callback after config updates options; syncs properties and repaints if needed

Sector.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
Sector.onHide.en: Called when the geometry is hidden, closing the open menu and infoWindow

Sector.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
Sector.onPositionChanged.en: Clears cache, repaints and fires positionchange when the position changes

Sector.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
Sector.onRemove.en: Callback invoked after the geometry is removed from its layer

Sector.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
Sector.onShapeChanged.en: Clears cache, repaints and fires shapechange when the shape changes

Sector.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
Sector.onSymbolChanged.en: Refreshes the symbol, rebuilds sizeSymbol and fires the symbol event

Sector.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
Sector.setAltitude.en: Sets the geometry altitude and rewrites the z value of its coordinates

Sector.setCoordinates.zh: 设置扇形的新中心坐标，并同步旋转轴心与投影坐标
Sector.setCoordinates.en: Set a new center coordinate for the sector, updating its rotate pivot and projected coordinate

SkylineAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将天际线分析添加到 layer，layer 未就绪时等其加载完成再创建 pass

SkylineAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用天际线分析并请求图层重绘
SkylineAnalysis.disable.en: Disable the skyline analysis and request a layer redraw

SkylineAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用天际线分析并请求图层重绘
SkylineAnalysis.enable.en: Enable the skyline analysis and request a layer redraw

SkylineAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 按传入 meshes 渲染分析结果并返回像素数据，未启用时返回 null
SkylineAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Render the analysis of the given meshes and return its pixel data, or null when disabled

SkylineAnalysis.exportSkylineMap.zh: 导出天际线分析图，options.save 为真时下载
SkylineAnalysis.exportSkylineMap.en: Export the skyline analysis image, downloading it when options.save is true.

SkylineAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，天际线分析为 skyline
SkylineAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Get the analysis type id, which is skyline for this analysis

SkylineAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader 的 HAS_SKYLINE 宏定义
SkylineAnalysis.getDefines.en: Return the shader define HAS_SKYLINE for skyline rendering

SkylineAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与天际线分析的 layer id 数组，未设置时为空数组
SkylineAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Get the array of layer ids excluded from the skyline analysis, empty when unset

SkylineAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 返回天际线分析当前是否启用
SkylineAnalysis.isEnable.en: Return whether the skyline analysis is currently enabled

SkylineAnalysis.remove.zh: 从 layer 移除分析并销毁地面 mesh 等资源
SkylineAnalysis.remove.en: Remove the analysis from its layer and dispose the ground mesh and other resources

SkylineAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染天际线分析并返回含 skylineMap 的 uniform
SkylineAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Render the skyline analysis and return uniforms containing skylineMap

SkylineAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与天际线分析的 layer id 数组
SkylineAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Set the array of layer ids excluded from the skyline analysis

SkylineAnalysis.update.zh: 更新分析参数并触发图层重绘
SkylineAnalysis.update.en: Update an analysis option and request a layer redraw

TextBox.endEdit.zh: 结束编辑，按编辑后的尺寸缩放并还原 function-type 宽高

TextBox.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 还原 TextBox 实例，恢复内容、坐标、宽高、属性与 symbol
TextBox.fromJSON.en: Restore a TextBox from JSON, recovering its content, coordinates, width, height, properties and symbol

TextBox.get2DExtent.en: Get the textbox's 2D pixel extent at current zoom, or null when it is not on a map

TextBox.getBoxStyle.en: Get the box style of the textbox, implemented by subclasses

TextBox.getCoordinates.zh: 获取文本框的坐标，即它的中心点
TextBox.getCoordinates.en: Get the coordinate of the textbox, which is its center

TextBox.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现
TextBox.getGeometries.en: Get the child geometries of a geometry collection, implemented only by collection subclasses

TextBox.getHoles.zh: 获取几何体的孔洞 coordinate 数组，仅面状几何子类实现
TextBox.getHoles.en: Get the geometry's hole coordinates, implemented only by areal geometry subclasses

TextBox.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取文本框所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
TextBox.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among the textbox's coordinates

TextBox.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取文本框所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
TextBox.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among the textbox's coordinates

TextBox.getOutline.zh: 获取文本框的方框轮廓 marker，尺寸取自 containerExtent
TextBox.getOutline.en: Get a square outline marker sized by the textbox's containerExtent

TextBox.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的固定角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
TextBox.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the fixed angle offset used when rotating around the center, implemented only by Sector

TextBox.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，仅面状几何子类实现

TextBox.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
TextBox.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed from the text content and size symbol, cached

TextBox.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude

TextBox.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心

TextBox.onAdd.zh: 几何体加入图层时的回调，重新计算并刷新文本框 symbol

TextBox.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘

TextBox.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow

TextBox.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件

TextBox.onRemove.zh: 几何体从图层移除时的回调，由框架内部调用

TextBox.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件

TextBox.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建尺寸缓存并触发事件

TextBox.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
TextBox.setAltitude.en: Set the geometry altitude and update the z value of its coordinates

TextBox.setBoxStyle.zh: 设置文本框背景盒子的样式，由子类实现
TextBox.setBoxStyle.en: Set the textbox background box style, implemented by subclasses

TextBox.setCoordinates.zh: 设置几何图形的中心点
TextBox.setCoordinates.en: Set a new center coordinate to the geometry

TextBox.setSymbol.zh: 设置 symbol，按前缀拆分为文本与边框两部分应用
TextBox.setSymbol.en: Set the symbol, splitting text prefixed props from box props

TextBox.setTextSymbol.zh: 设置标签的文本 symbol，由子类实现
TextBox.setTextSymbol.en: Set the text symbol of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextBox.startEdit.zh: 开始编辑，先把 function-type 宽高固定为 marker 尺寸
TextBox.startEdit.en: Start editing, first pinning the function-type width and height to the marker size.

TextBox.toJSON.zh: 导出文本框的 JSON 描述，不含 symbol 字段
TextBox.toJSON.en: Export the textbox JSON description without the symbol field

TextMarker.fromJSON.zh: 原样返回传入的 geometry JSON，不做任何反序列化处理
TextMarker.fromJSON.en: Static method returning the input geometry JSON as is, without deserialization

TextMarker.get2DExtent.zh: 获取当前 zoom 下几何体的 2D 像素 extent
TextMarker.get2DExtent.en: Get the geometry 2D pixel extent at the current zoom

TextMarker.getAltitude.zh: 获取几何体的海拔高度，返回数值或高度数组
TextMarker.getAltitude.en: Get the geometry altitude, a number or an array of altitudes

TextMarker.getBoxStyle.zh: 获取标签背景盒子的样式，由子类实现
TextMarker.getBoxStyle.en: Get the label background box style, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.getCoordinates.zh: 获取几何图形的中心点 coordinate
TextMarker.getCoordinates.en: Get the center coordinate of the geometry

TextMarker.getGeometries.zh: 获取几何体集合内的子几何体数组，仅集合类子类实现
TextMarker.getGeometries.en: Get child geometries of a collection, implemented by collection subclasses

TextMarker.getHoles.zh: 获取面状几何体的孔洞坐标数组，仅部分子类实现
TextMarker.getHoles.en: Get the hole coordinate arrays of a polygon, implemented by some subclasses

TextMarker.getMaxAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最大的 altitude
TextMarker.getMaxAltitude.en: Get the maximum altitude among the geometry coordinates

TextMarker.getMinAltitude.zh: 获取几何体所有 coordinate 中最小的 altitude
TextMarker.getMinAltitude.en: Get the minimum altitude among the geometry coordinates

TextMarker.getOutline.zh: 获取标记的方框轮廓 marker，尺寸取自 containerExtent
TextMarker.getOutline.en: Get a square outline marker whose size is taken from the container extent

TextMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.zh: 获取几何体按中心旋转时的角度偏移，目前仅 Sector 实现
TextMarker.getRotateOffsetAngle.en: Get the angle offset used when rotating around the center, only Sector implements it

TextMarker.getShell.zh: 获取几何体外环的 coordinate 数组，marker 类未实现该方法
TextMarker.getShell.en: Get the outer ring coordinate array of the geometry, not implemented by marker classes

TextMarker.getTextDesc.zh: 获取文本描述，由文本内容与 sizeSymbol 计算并缓存
TextMarker.getTextDesc.en: Get the text description computed from text content and sizeSymbol and cached

TextMarker.getTextStyle.zh: 获取标签的文本样式，由子类实现
TextMarker.getTextStyle.en: Get the text style of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.hasAltitude.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了非零的 altitude
TextMarker.hasAltitude.en: Whether the geometry has a non-zero altitude set

TextMarker.isRotated.zh: 判断几何体是否设置了旋转角与旋转中心
TextMarker.isRotated.en: Whether the geometry has both a rotation angle and a rotation pivot set

TextMarker.onAdd.zh: 加入地图时刷新标签文本与盒子的显示
TextMarker.onAdd.en: Refresh the label text and box display when added to the map

TextMarker.onConfig.zh: config 更新 options 后的回调，同步 properties 并按需重绘
TextMarker.onConfig.en: Callback after config updates options, syncing properties and repainting as needed

TextMarker.onHide.zh: 几何体隐藏时关闭已打开的菜单与 infoWindow
TextMarker.onHide.en: Close the opened menu and infoWindow when the geometry is hidden

TextMarker.onPositionChanged.zh: 位置变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 positionchange 事件
TextMarker.onPositionChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire the positionchange event when the position changes

TextMarker.onRemove.zh: 几何体从 layer 移除时的回调，由框架内部调用
TextMarker.onRemove.en: Callback when the geometry is removed from its layer, called by the framework

TextMarker.onShapeChanged.zh: 形状变化时清缓存、重绘并触发 shapechange 事件
TextMarker.onShapeChanged.en: Clear cache, repaint and fire the shapechange event when the shape changes

TextMarker.onSymbolChanged.zh: symbol 变化时刷新 symbol、重建 sizeSymbol 并触发事件
TextMarker.onSymbolChanged.en: Refresh symbol, rebuild sizeSymbol and fire the symbolchange event on change

TextMarker.setAltitude.zh: 设置几何体的 altitude，并同步改写 coordinate 的 z 值
TextMarker.setAltitude.en: Set the altitude of the geometry and update the z values of its coordinates

TextMarker.setBoxStyle.zh: 设置标签背景盒子的样式，由子类实现
TextMarker.setBoxStyle.en: Set the background box style of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.setBoxSymbol.zh: 设置标签背景盒子的 symbol，由子类实现
TextMarker.setBoxSymbol.en: Set the background box symbol of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.setCoordinates.zh: 设置几何体的中心 coordinate 并触发位置变化
TextMarker.setCoordinates.en: Set the center coordinate of the geometry and fire the positionchange event

TextMarker.setSymbol.zh: 把 symbol 按 text 前缀拆成文本与盒子两部分分别设置
TextMarker.setSymbol.en: Split the symbol into text and box parts by text prefix and apply each part

TextMarker.setTextStyle.zh: 设置标签的文本样式，由子类实现
TextMarker.setTextStyle.en: Set the text style of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.setTextSymbol.zh: 设置标签的文本 symbol，由子类实现
TextMarker.setTextSymbol.en: Set the text symbol of the label, implemented by subclasses

TextMarker.toJSON.zh: 导出 JSON 数据，结果中不含 symbol 字段
TextMarker.toJSON.en: Export the textmarker JSON data, dropping the symbol field.

TileLayer.createTileNode.zh: 创建一个瓦片节点，含瓦片范围、url 与父子关系
TileLayer.createTileNode.en: Create a tile node with its extent, url and parent-child relations

TileLayer.getEvents.zh: 获取图层监听的事件，如 spatial reference 变化
TileLayer.getEvents.en: Get the events the layer listens to, such as spatial reference change

TileLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
TileLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layer list, implemented only by group layers

TileLayer.getMaxZoom.en: Get the layer max zoom, capped by the map max zoom.

TileLayer.getMinZoom.en: Get the layer min zoom, raised to the map min zoom when it is higher.

TileLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的渲染器实例
TileLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer

TileLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回图层使用的 renderer 名
TileLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the renderer name the layer uses according to the map renderer type

TileLayer.getTileId.zh: 按瓦片坐标与 zoom 生成瓦片的唯一 id
TileLayer.getTileId.en: Build the unique tile id from the tile x, y, zoom and the layer id.

TileLayer.getTiles.zh: 获取指定 zoom 下渲染所需的主瓦片与父级瓦片网格
TileLayer.getTiles.en: Get the tile grids and parent tiles to render at the given zoom.

TileLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别图层上的图形，tile layer 未实现，返回空值
TileLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries at a coordinate; tile layers do not implement it and return nothing

TileLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别图层图形，tile layer 未实现该方法
TileLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries at a container point; tile layers do not implement it and return nothing

TileLayer.isParentTile.zh: 判断瓦片是否落在需保留的父级瓦片层级范围内
TileLayer.isParentTile.en: Check whether a tile falls in the parent tile zoom range kept for stacking

TileLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 加入地图时的回调，据 tms 选项初始化 tileSystem
TileLayer.onAdd.en: Callback when the layer is added to the map, it sets tileSystem from the tms option

TileLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
TileLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback called after the layer canvas is created, subclasses may override it

TileLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
TileLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on option change that triggers a redraw and an attribution update

TileLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
TileLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called when the layer finishes loading, overridden by subclasses, empty by default

TileLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
TileLayer.onRemove.en: Callback called when the layer is removed from the map, subclasses may override it

TileLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
TileLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback called after the layer renderer is created, subclasses may override it

TileLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层的 mask 遮罩并清空 mask 选项
TileLayer.removeMask.en: Remove the mask from the layer and clear the mask option.

TileLayer.setZIndex.zh: 设置图层的 zIndex，并同步 options、图层顺序与渲染器
TileLayer.setZIndex.en: Set the layer z-index, syncing its options, map layer order and renderer.

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.clear.zh: 清空图层 canvas，并清除瓦片缓存
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.clear.en: Clear the layer canvas and its tile caches, then mark it to redraw

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.clipCanvas.zh: 裁剪 canvas 绘制区域，当前直接调用父类实现
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.clipCanvas.en: Clip the canvas drawing area, currently calling the parent class implementation

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.drawTile.zh: 按瓦片位置、缩放与 bearing 把瓦片图像绘制到 canvas 上
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.drawTile.en: Draw a tile image onto the canvas by tile position, scale and bearing

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.isDrawable.zh: 是否为可绘制状态，有 pitch 时清空 canvas 并返回 false
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.isDrawable.en: Whether the renderer can draw; clears the canvas and returns false when pitched

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.needToRedraw.zh: 判断图层是否需要重绘，地图旋转缩放或需强制渲染时返回 true
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.needToRedraw.en: Get whether the layer needs to redraw; true when rotating, zooming or forcing render

TileLayerCanvasRenderer.onRemove.zh: 图层移除时的生命周期回调，清空 canvas 与瓦片缓存
TileLayerCanvasRenderer.onRemove.en: Lifecycle callback on renderer removal; clears the canvas and the tile caches

Toolbar.onAdd.zh: 控件添加到 map 后的可选回调，由子类实现
Toolbar.onAdd.en: Optional callback invoked after the control is added to a map; implemented by subclasses.

Toolbar.onConfig.zh: 配置中含 position 时重新计算并更新控件位置
Toolbar.onConfig.en: Recomputes and updates the control position when the config contains a position option.

Toolbar.onRemove.zh: 控件从 map 移除后的可选回调，由子类实现
Toolbar.onRemove.en: Optional callback invoked after the control is removed from a map; implemented by subclasses.

ToolTip.buildOn.zh: 创建 tooltip 的 DOM 容器，content 为函数时调用它生成内容
ToolTip.buildOn.en: Create the tooltip DOM element, calling content with the dom when it is a function

ToolTip.getEvents.zh: 返回组件需在地图上监听的事件映射表，子类可重写
ToolTip.getEvents.en: Return the event map the component listens to on the map, overridden by subclasses

ToolTip.getOwner.zh: 获取 UI 组件挂载的 owner，即 map 或 geometry
ToolTip.getOwner.en: Get the owner the UI component is added to, either a map or a geometry

ToolTip.getOwnerEvents.zh: 返回需绑定到 owner 上的事件映射表，子类可重写
ToolTip.getOwnerEvents.en: Return the event map to bind on the owner, overridden by subclasses

ToolTip.getPosition.zh: 获取 UI 相对地图容器的像素位置，含 getOffset 偏移
ToolTip.getPosition.en: Get the UI pixel position relative to the map container, including the getOffset shift

ToolTip.hideDom.zh: 隐藏提示框的 DOM 元素
ToolTip.hideDom.en: Hide the DOM element of the tooltip

ToolTip.isSupportZoomFilter.zh: 是否支持按 zoom 过滤 DOM 显示，基类返回 false
ToolTip.isSupportZoomFilter.en: Whether DOM display can be filtered by zoom, the base class returns false

ToolTip.onAdd.zh: UI 组件被添加时的回调钩子，由子类实现
ToolTip.onAdd.en: Optional callback hook invoked after the UI component is added, implemented by subclasses

ToolTip.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，刷新位置并在碰撞状态变化时重排
ToolTip.onConfig.en: Callback on option change that updates the position and re-sorts on collision changes

ToolTip.onDomRemove.zh: UI 的 DOM 节点被移除时的回调钩子，由子类实现
ToolTip.onDomRemove.en: Optional callback hook invoked when the UI dom node is removed, implemented by subclasses

ToolTip.onDomSizeChange.zh: DOM 尺寸变化时的回调，重设位置并重算碰撞
ToolTip.onDomSizeChange.en: Callback when the dom size changes, it resets the position and recomputes the collision

ToolTip.onEvent.zh: 地图缩放旋转倾斜时更新位置并隐藏提示框
ToolTip.onEvent.en: Update the position and hide the tooltip while the map zooms, rotates or pitches

ToolTip.onGeometryPositionChange.zh: owner geometry 位置变化时按新中心点刷新提示框位置
ToolTip.onGeometryPositionChange.en: Refreshes the tooltip at the owner geometry's new center when its position changes

ToolTip.onMouseMove.zh: 鼠标在图形上移动时按 showTimeout 延时显示提示框
ToolTip.onMouseMove.en: Shows the tooltip after the showTimeout delay when the mouse moves over the geometry

ToolTip.onMouseOut.zh: 鼠标移出时清除显示延时并移除 tooltip 的 DOM，解绑地图事件
ToolTip.onMouseOut.en: Clears the show timer, removes the tooltip DOM and unbinds map events on mouse out

ToolTip.onMoving.zh: 地图 moving 与 moveend 时更新提示框位置
ToolTip.onMoving.en: Updates the tooltip position while the map is moving and after moveend

ToolTip.onRemove.en: Clears pending timers and unbinds the mouse events on the owner geometry when the tooltip is removed.

ToolTip.onResize.zh: 地图容器尺寸变化时重设提示框的 DOM 位置
ToolTip.onResize.en: Resets the tooltip DOM position when the map container is resized

ToolTip.onZoomEnd.zh: 地图 zoom 结束时立即重设提示框的 DOM 位置
ToolTip.onZoomEnd.en: Resets the tooltip DOM position immediately when map zooming ends

UIComponent.buildOn.zh: 创建并返回 UI 的 DOM 节点，子类必须实现

UIComponent.getEvents.zh: 返回组件自身需监听的事件映射表，子类可重写

UIComponent.getOwner.zh: 获取 UI 组件挂载的 owner，即 map 或 geometry
UIComponent.getOwner.en: Get the owner the UI component is mounted on, a map or a geometry

UIComponent.getOwnerEvents.zh: 返回需绑定到 owner 上的事件映射表，子类可重写
UIComponent.getOwnerEvents.en: Returns the event map to be bound on the owner, subclasses may override it

UIComponent.getPosition.zh: 获取 UI 相对地图容器的像素位置，含 getOffset 偏移
UIComponent.getPosition.en: Get the UI pixel position in the map container, including the getOffset shift

UIComponent.isSupportZoomFilter.zh: 是否支持按 zoom 过滤 DOM 显示，基类返回 false
UIComponent.isSupportZoomFilter.en: Whether DOM display can be filtered by zoom, the base class returns false

UIComponent.onAdd.zh: UI 组件被添加时的回调钩子，由子类实现
UIComponent.onAdd.en: Callback hook invoked when the UI component is added, implemented by subclasses

UIComponent.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，刷新位置并在碰撞状态变化时重排
UIComponent.onConfig.en: Callback after options change, refreshes position and re-sorts on collision state change

UIComponent.onDomRemove.zh: UI 的 DOM 节点被移除时的回调钩子，由子类实现
UIComponent.onDomRemove.en: Callback hook invoked when the UI's DOM element is removed, implemented by subclasses

UIComponent.onDomSizeChange.zh: DOM 尺寸变化时的回调，重设位置并重算碰撞
UIComponent.onDomSizeChange.en: Callback when the DOM size changes, resets the position and recalculates collision

UIComponent.onEvent.zh: 地图缩放旋转倾斜过程中的回调，更新 UI 位置
UIComponent.onEvent.en: Callback during map zooming, rotating and pitching, updates the UI position

UIComponent.onGeometryPositionChange.zh: owner geometry 位置变化时的回调，按新中心点刷新 UI
UIComponent.onGeometryPositionChange.en: Callback when the owner geometry moves, refreshes the UI at its new center

UIComponent.onMoving.zh: 地图 moving 与 moveend 时的回调，更新 UI 位置
UIComponent.onMoving.en: Callback on map moving and moveend, updates the UI position

UIComponent.onRemove.zh: UI 组件被移除时的回调钩子，由子类实现
UIComponent.onRemove.en: Callback hook invoked when the UI component is removed, implemented by subclasses

UIComponent.onResize.zh: 地图容器尺寸变化时的回调，重设 UI 的 DOM 位置
UIComponent.onResize.en: Callback when the map container is resized, resets the UI's DOM position

UIComponent.onZoomEnd.zh: 地图 zoom 结束时的回调，立即重设 UI 的 DOM 位置
UIComponent.onZoomEnd.en: Callback when map zooming ends, resets the UI's DOM position immediately

UIMarker.buildOn.zh: 按 content 构建 marker 的 DOM，函数内容动态渲染，并绑定 DOM 事件
UIMarker.buildOn.en: Builds the marker's DOM from content, renders dynamically if a function, binds DOM events

UIMarker.getAltitude.zh: 获取 UIMarker 的海拔，优先取坐标的 z，否则取 options.altitude
UIMarker.getAltitude.en: Get the UIMarker altitude from the coordinate z, falling back to options.altitude

UIMarker.getCenter.zh: 获取 UIMarker 的中心坐标，与 getCoordinates 一致
UIMarker.getCenter.en: Get the UIMarker center coordinate, the same as getCoordinates

UIMarker.getEvents.zh: 返回组件自身需监听的事件映射表，基类返回空对象
UIMarker.getEvents.en: Returns the event map the component itself listens to, empty in the base class

UIMarker.getOwner.zh: 获取 marker 挂载的 owner，即所属的 map
UIMarker.getOwner.en: Gets the owner the marker is added to, which is the map

UIMarker.getOwnerEvents.zh: 返回需绑定到 owner 上的事件映射表，基类返回空对象
UIMarker.getOwnerEvents.en: Returns the event map to be bound on the owner, empty in the base class

UIMarker.getPosition.zh: 获取 marker 相对地图容器的像素位置，含 getOffset 偏移
UIMarker.getPosition.en: Gets the marker's pixel position in the map container, including the getOffset shift

UIMarker.isSupportZoomFilter.zh: 是否支持按 zoom 动态过滤 marker 的显示
UIMarker.isSupportZoomFilter.en: Whether the marker supports dynamic show or hide filtering by zoom level

UIMarker.isVisible.zh: 判断 marker 是否可见，取决于 visible 选项与 zoom 范围
UIMarker.isVisible.en: Whether the marker is visible, decided by the visible option and the zoom range

UIMarker.onAdd.zh: UIMarker 加入地图时调用，owner 不是地图会报错
UIMarker.onAdd.en: Called when the UIMarker is added to a map, throws if the owner is not a map

UIMarker.onConfig.zh: 配置变更后的回调，更新位置并在碰撞选项变化时重做碰撞检测
UIMarker.onConfig.en: Callback after config changes, updates position and re-runs collision when collision options change

UIMarker.onDomRemove.zh: DOM 被移除时解绑 marker 上注册的 DOM 事件
UIMarker.onDomRemove.en: Called when the DOM is removed, unbinds the DOM events registered on the marker

UIMarker.onDomSizeChange.zh: DOM 尺寸变化时的回调，可见时更新位置并重做碰撞检测
UIMarker.onDomSizeChange.en: Callback when the DOM size changes, updates position and collision when visible

UIMarker.onEvent.zh: 地图 zooming rotate pitch 时的回调，可见时更新 UI 位置
UIMarker.onEvent.en: Callback on map zooming rotate or pitch, updates the UI position when visible

UIMarker.onGeometryPositionChange.zh: owner geometry 位置变化时的回调，可见时按新中心重设位置
UIMarker.onGeometryPositionChange.en: Callback when the owner geometry position changes, repositions to the new center when visible

UIMarker.onMoving.zh: 地图 moving 或 moveend 时的回调，可见时更新 UI 位置

UIMarker.onRemove.zh: UI 组件从 owner 移除时的回调，供子类做清理

UIMarker.onZoomEnd.zh: 地图 zoomend 时的回调，可见时在当前帧重设位置
UIMarker.onZoomEnd.en: Callback on map zoomend, resets the UI position in the current frame when visible

UIMarker.onZoomFilter.zh: 缩放时按是否可见切换 marker 的 DOM 显示与隐藏
UIMarker.onZoomFilter.en: Called on zoom, toggles the marker DOM display by whether the marker is visible

UIMarker.setAltitude.zh: 设置 UIMarker 的海拔高度并更新位置
UIMarker.setAltitude.en: Set the UIMarker altitude and update its position

util._defaults.zh: 把 defaults 的属性描述符补到 obj 上，仅限 obj 中为 undefined 的键
util._defaults.en: Copies defaults property descriptors onto obj, only for keys that are undefined in obj

util.calCanvasSize.zh: 按 devicePixelRatio 换算 canvas 像素宽高与 css 宽高，结果对象复用
util.calCanvasSize.en: Converts canvas pixel and css width and height by devicePixelRatio, reusing the result object

util.getAbsoluteURL.zh: 把相对 URL 解析为绝对 URL，已是 http 或 https 的原样返回
util.getAbsoluteURL.en: Resolves a relative URL to an absolute URL, returns http or https URLs unchanged

util.getImageBitMap.zh: 取出 data 中的图像数据直接交给回调处理
util.getImageBitMap.en: Takes the image data out of data and passes it directly to the callback

util.getPointsResultPts.zh: 为每个点对象复用并重置 ptKey 上的 Point，空项以 null 占位
util.getPointsResultPts.en: Reuses and resets a Point on ptKey for each point object, null placeholder for empty items

util.getValueOrDefault.zh: 值为 undefined 时返回默认值，否则返回原值
util.getValueOrDefault.en: Returns the default when the value is undefined, otherwise returns the value itself

util.isCssUrl.zh: 判断字符串是否形如 css 的 url 写法，无引号返回 1 有引号返回 2
util.isCssUrl.en: Checks whether a string looks like a css url, returns 1 without quotes and 2 with quotes

util.isNoContentHttpCode.zh: 判断 HTTP 状态码是否表示无内容，涵盖 204、4xx 与 501
util.isNoContentHttpCode.en: Checks whether an HTTP status code means no content, covering 204, 4xx and 501

util.isSVG.zh: 判断 url 是否为 svg，.svg 结尾返回 1，data 前缀返回 2，否则返回 0
util.isSVG.en: Checks whether url is svg, returns 1 for a .svg suffix, 2 for a data prefix, else 0

util.log2.en: Base-2 logarithm that rounds near-integer results, polyfilling Math.log2.

util.mergeArray.zh: 把各入参数组的元素拼接成一个新数组返回
util.mergeArray.en: Concatenates the elements of all input arrays into a new array

util.pushIn.zh: 把后续各数组的元素依次追加进第一个数组，返回追加后的长度
util.pushIn.en: Appends the elements of the following arrays into the first array, returns the new length

UTMProjection.aliases.zh: 投影的别名数组，UTM 投影默认为空
UTMProjection.aliases.en: Alias array of the projection, empty by default for the UTM projection

UTMProjection.create.zh: 按 zone 与 south 参数创建 UTM 横轴墨卡托投影
UTMProjection.create.en: Create a UTM projection from the zone and south params, zone must be 1 to 60

UTMProjection.getCircum.zh: 获取球面投影的周长即球面 extent 宽高，结果会缓存
UTMProjection.getCircum.en: Returns the sphere circumference, the size of the sphere extent, cached after the first call.

UTMProjection.getSphereExtent.zh: 获取球面投影范围，由投影经纬度极值算出并缓存
UTMProjection.getSphereExtent.en: Returns the sphere extent computed from the projected lnglat limits, cached after the first call.

UTMProjection.is.zh: 判断投影的 code 或 aliases 是否与给定编码匹配
UTMProjection.is.en: Returns whether the projection code or one of its aliases matches the given code.

Vector3DLayer.cancelOutline.zh: 取消图层内 geometry 的描边高亮
Vector3DLayer.cancelOutline.en: Cancel the outline highlight of the geometries in the layer

Vector3DLayer.get3DPainterClass.zh: 按名字获取已注册的 3D painter 类
Vector3DLayer.get3DPainterClass.en: Get the registered 3D painter class by name

Vector3DLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取图层计算后样式并以 style 字段返回
Vector3DLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get the layer computed style and return it in the style field

Vector3DLayer.getEvents.zh: 返回图层监听的事件映射，含空间参考变化事件
Vector3DLayer.getEvents.en: Get the event map the layer listens to, including spatial reference change

Vector3DLayer.getPolygonOffset.zh:
获取图层的polygonOffset
用于GroupGLLayer全局管理polygonOffset
Vector3DLayer.getPolygonOffset.en: Get the layer polygonOffset used for global management by GroupGLLayer

Vector3DLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.zh:
获取图层的polygonOffsetCount
用于GroupGLLayer全局管理polygonOffset
Vector3DLayer.getPolygonOffsetCount.en: Get the polygonOffset count the layer needs, 0 for empty or altitude layers

Vector3DLayer.getTileSize.zh: 返回 painter 内部使用的默认 tile 尺寸 1x1
Vector3DLayer.getTileSize.en: Return the default tile size of 1x1 used internally by painters

Vector3DLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.zh: 获取 GroupGLLayer 分配的 polygonOffset 总数
Vector3DLayer.getTotalPolygonOffset.en: Get the total polygonOffset assigned by the GroupGLLayer

Vector3DLayer.getURLModifier.zh: 获取改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数
Vector3DLayer.getURLModifier.en: Get the modifier function that rewrites resource loading urls

Vector3DLayer.onConfig.zh: 配置项更新时的回调，把 bloom 开关同步给 renderer
Vector3DLayer.onConfig.en: Callback on options update, syncs the bloom switches to the renderer

Vector3DLayer.outline.zh: 为指定 id 数组的 geometry 添加描边高亮
Vector3DLayer.outline.en: Add outline highlight to the geometries with the given id array

Vector3DLayer.outlineAll.zh: 为图层内全部 geometry 添加描边高亮
Vector3DLayer.outlineAll.en: Add outline highlight to all geometries in the layer

Vector3DLayer.registerPainter.zh: 按名字注册 3D painter 类，供图层渲染时查找
Vector3DLayer.registerPainter.en: Register a 3D painter class by name for the layer to look up when rendering

Vector3DLayer.setPolygonOffset.zh: 设置图层 polygonOffset 及全局总数供 GroupGLLayer 统一管理
Vector3DLayer.setPolygonOffset.en: Set the layer polygonOffset and the global total for GroupGLLayer management

Vector3DLayer.setURLModifier.zh: 设置改写资源加载 url 的修饰函数并返回图层
Vector3DLayer.setURLModifier.en: Set the modifier function rewriting resource loading urls and return the layer

Vector3DLayer.updateSymbol.zh: 把 symbol 属性合并进样式数组第 idx 项并刷新图层样式
Vector3DLayer.updateSymbol.en: Merge symbol properties into the style at index idx and refresh the layer style

VectorLayer.getAltitude.zh: 获取图层的 altitude 值，未配置时为 0
VectorLayer.getAltitude.en: Gets the layer altitude value, 0 when it is not configured

VectorLayer.getCollectionPainterClass.zh: 获取该 layer 使用的 CollectionPainter 类
VectorLayer.getCollectionPainterClass.en: Get the CollectionPainter class used by the layer

VectorLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
VectorLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, implemented only by group layers

VectorLayer.getPainterClass.zh: 获取该 layer 使用的 Painter 类
VectorLayer.getPainterClass.en: Get the Painter class used by the layer

VectorLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层使用的 canvas renderer
VectorLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the canvas renderer used by the layer

VectorLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
VectorLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the layer's renderer name according to the map's renderer type

VectorLayer.hide.zh: 隐藏图层并通知图层内所有几何体隐藏
VectorLayer.hide.en: Hide the layer and notify all its geometries to hide

VectorLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 绑定到 map 后的回调，子类可重写
VectorLayer.onAdd.en: Callback after the layer is bound to a map, subclasses can override it

VectorLayer.onAddGeometry.zh: 添加 geometry 到 layer 时的回调，按 layer 样式为其设置样式
VectorLayer.onAddGeometry.en: Callback when a geometry is added, applies the layer style to it

VectorLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
VectorLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer's canvas is created, subclasses can override it

VectorLayer.onConfig.zh: 配置变更时清理几何的 altitude 缓存并按需重绘
VectorLayer.onConfig.en: Clear the geometry altitude cache and redraw as needed when config changes

VectorLayer.onGeometryEvent.zh: 处理图层内 geometry 事件，同步 layer 内的缓存与索引
VectorLayer.onGeometryEvent.en: Handle geometry events in the layer to update its caches and indexes

VectorLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
VectorLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called after the layer is loaded, empty by default and overridden by subclasses

VectorLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
VectorLayer.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from the map, subclasses can override it

VectorLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
VectorLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer's renderer is created, subclasses can override it

VectorLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层 mask 并触发重绘
VectorLayer.removeMask.en: Remove the layer mask and mark the layer for redraw

VectorTileLayer.cancelAllHighlight.zh: 取消本图层全部 features 高亮
VectorTileLayer.cancelAllHighlight.en: Cancel the highlight of all features in the layer

VectorTileLayer.cancelHighlight.zh: 取消指定 id 的 features 高亮
VectorTileLayer.cancelHighlight.en: Cancel the highlight of the features with the given ids

VectorTileLayer.clearData.zh: 清空 renderer 与图层缓存的瓦片数据
VectorTileLayer.clearData.en: Clear the tile data cached in the renderer and the layer

VectorTileLayer.compressStyleJSON.zh: 把样式数组压缩为 plugins 与 styles 结构，非数组或空数组原样返回
VectorTileLayer.compressStyleJSON.en: Compress a style array into plugins and styles, returning others as is

VectorTileLayer.createTileNode.zh: 创建一个瓦片节点，含瓦片范围、url 与父子关系
VectorTileLayer.createTileNode.en: Create a tile node with its extent, url and parent-child relations

VectorTileLayer.forceReload.zh: 令 worker 端瓦片缓存失效并强制重新加载图层
VectorTileLayer.forceReload.en: Expire the tiles cached in the worker and force reload the layer

VectorTileLayer.fromJSON.zh: 由 JSON 反序列化创建 VectorTileLayer，类型不匹配返回 null
VectorTileLayer.fromJSON.en: Create a VectorTileLayer from layer JSON, return null when the type mismatches

VectorTileLayer.getComputedStyle.zh: 获取当前生效样式的深拷贝，含 background 与 style
VectorTileLayer.getComputedStyle.en: Get a deep copy of the current effective style, with background and style

VectorTileLayer.getEvents.zh: 获取图层监听的事件，如 spatial reference 变化
VectorTileLayer.getEvents.en: Get the events the layer listens to, such as spatial reference change

VectorTileLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
VectorTileLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, implemented only by group layers

VectorTileLayer.getMaxZoom.en: Get the layer's max zoom to display

VectorTileLayer.getMinZoom.en: Get the layer's min zoom to display

VectorTileLayer.getPlugins.zh: 获取已注册的 VectorTileLayer 插件集合
VectorTileLayer.getPlugins.en: Get all VectorTileLayer plugins registered by their type

VectorTileLayer.getRenderedFeaturesAsync.zh: 以 Promise 分页异步返回已渲染的 features
VectorTileLayer.getRenderedFeaturesAsync.en: Get the rendered features asynchronously in pages to avoid blocking the UI

VectorTileLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的渲染器实例
VectorTileLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the renderer instance of the layer

VectorTileLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
VectorTileLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the layer's renderer name according to the map's renderer type

VectorTileLayer.getTileId.zh: 按瓦片坐标与 zoom 生成瓦片的唯一 id
VectorTileLayer.getTileId.en: Generate a unique tile id from the tile x, y and zoom

VectorTileLayer.getTiles.zh: 获取指定 zoom 下渲染所需的主瓦片与父级瓦片网格
VectorTileLayer.getTiles.en: Get the main tiles and parent tile grids needed to render at the given zoom

VectorTileLayer.highlight.zh: 按 id 或 filter 高亮 features，图层未就绪时先暂存
VectorTileLayer.highlight.en: Highlight features by id or filter, queued until the layer is ready

VectorTileLayer.identify.en: Identifies vector tile features at a coordinate, forwarding to the renderer
VectorTileLayer.identify.zh: 按坐标识别矢量瓦片要素，转发给渲染器

VectorTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identifies vector tile features at a container point, forwarding to the renderer
VectorTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按容器像素点识别矢量瓦片要素，转发给渲染器

VectorTileLayer.isDefaultRender.zh: 是否为未配置 style 时的默认渲染
VectorTileLayer.isDefaultRender.en: Whether the layer uses default rendering when no style is set

VectorTileLayer.isParentTile.zh: 判断瓦片是否落在需保留的父级瓦片层级范围内
VectorTileLayer.isParentTile.en: Check whether a tile is within the parent tile zoom range to be kept

VectorTileLayer.loadFrom.zh: 从 url 拉取 JSON 并创建 VectorTileLayer 实例
VectorTileLayer.loadFrom.en: Fetch layer JSON from a url and create a VectorTileLayer instance

VectorTileLayer.onAdd.zh: 图层加入地图时准备参数并校验 projection 与地图一致
VectorTileLayer.onAdd.en: Prepare options and verify the projection matches the map when the layer is added

VectorTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
VectorTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, may be overridden by subclasses

VectorTileLayer.onConfig.en: Callback after the vector tile layer options change; forwards to the renderer and redraws
VectorTileLayer.onConfig.zh: 矢量瓦片图层配置变更后的回调，转发给渲染器并清缓存重绘

VectorTileLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
VectorTileLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called after the layer finishes loading, overridden by subclasses, empty by default

VectorTileLayer.onRemove.zh: 图层从地图移除时的钩子，调用父类清理逻辑
VectorTileLayer.onRemove.en: Hook fired when the layer is removed from the map, calls the super class cleanup

VectorTileLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
VectorTileLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created, may be overridden by subclasses

VectorTileLayer.onWorkerReady.zh: worker 数据就绪后的回调钩子，子类可覆写处理结果
VectorTileLayer.onWorkerReady.en: Hook called after worker data is ready, subclasses may override to handle the result

VectorTileLayer.queryTerrainTiles.zh: 获取该瓦片对应的地形瓦片列表，无地形时返回 null
VectorTileLayer.queryTerrainTiles.en: Get the terrain tiles of a tile, returns null when there is no terrain

VectorTileLayer.queryTilePointTerrain.zh: 查询瓦片内某点在指定 resolution 下的地形高度
VectorTileLayer.queryTilePointTerrain.en: Query the terrain altitude of a point in a tile at the given resolution

VectorTileLayer.registerPlugin.zh: 按 type 注册 VectorTileLayer 插件
VectorTileLayer.registerPlugin.en: Register a VectorTileLayer plugin into the plugin map keyed by its type

VectorTileLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层上设置的 mask，图层在地图上时重绘图层
VectorTileLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer's mask and redraws the layer when it is on a map.

VectorTileLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为图层设置 z-index，并按 z-index 重排图层叠放顺序
VectorTileLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer's z-index, resorting the layer stack and redrawing the renderer.

VectorTileLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出图层的 profile json，可用于 fromJSON 重建实例
VectorTileLayer.toJSON.en: Export the layer profile json, which can rebuild the instance with fromJSON

ViewshedAnalysis.addTo.zh: 将分析添加到图层，图层就绪后创建分析 pass
ViewshedAnalysis.addTo.en: Add the analysis to a layer and create the analysis pass once the layer is ready

ViewshedAnalysis.disable.zh: 禁用分析并请求图层重绘
ViewshedAnalysis.disable.en: Disable the analysis and request a layer redraw

ViewshedAnalysis.enable.zh: 启用分析并请求图层重绘
ViewshedAnalysis.enable.en: Enable the analysis and request a layer redraw

ViewshedAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.zh: 渲染分析结果并读出 RGBA 像素数据，未启用时返回 null
ViewshedAnalysis.exportAnalysisMap.en: Render the analysis result and read back its RGBA pixels, null when disabled

ViewshedAnalysis.getAnalysisType.zh: 获取分析类型标识，如 cut 或 viewshed
ViewshedAnalysis.getAnalysisType.en: Get the analysis type id, such as cut or viewshed

ViewshedAnalysis.getDefines.zh: 返回 shader define，开启 HAS_VIEWSHED 宏
ViewshedAnalysis.getDefines.en: Return the shader defines that enable the HAS_VIEWSHED macro

ViewshedAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.zh: 获取不参与分析的 layer id 数组
ViewshedAnalysis.getExcludeLayers.en: Get the array of layer ids excluded from the analysis

ViewshedAnalysis.getVertexCoordinates.zh: 获取 viewshed 棱锥 4 个顶点的坐标
ViewshedAnalysis.getVertexCoordinates.en: Returns the coordinates of the viewshed pyramid's 4 apex vertices, or an empty array without a map.

ViewshedAnalysis.isEnable.zh: 返回分析当前是否启用
ViewshedAnalysis.isEnable.en: Return whether the analysis is currently enabled

ViewshedAnalysis.remove.zh: 从图层移除分析并销毁 pass、mesh 等资源
ViewshedAnalysis.remove.en: Remove the analysis from its layer and dispose the pass and mesh resources

ViewshedAnalysis.renderAnalysis.zh: 渲染 viewshed 分析，返回 viewshedMap 等 uniform
ViewshedAnalysis.renderAnalysis.en: Render the viewshed analysis and return uniforms such as viewshedMap

ViewshedAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.zh: 设置不参与分析的 layer id 数组
ViewshedAnalysis.setExcludeLayers.en: Set the array of layer ids excluded from the analysis

ViewshedAnalysis.update.zh: 更新可视域参数，eyePos 与 lookPoint 转为世界坐标
ViewshedAnalysis.update.en: Update viewshed options, converting eyePos and lookPoint to world coordinates

wgs84.measure.zh: WGS84 测量器的注册名，值为 EPSG:4326
wgs84.measure.en: The measurer registration name of the WGS84 measurer, its value is EPSG:4326.

wgs84.sphere.zh: WGS84 量测使用的球体，半径为 6378137
wgs84.sphere.en: The sphere used by the WGS84 measurer, with a radius of 6378137.

WMSTileLayer.createTileNode.zh: 创建一个瓦片节点，含瓦片范围、url 与父子关系
WMSTileLayer.createTileNode.en: Create a tile node with its extent, url and parent child relations

WMSTileLayer.getEvents.zh: 获取图层监听的事件，如 spatial reference 变化
WMSTileLayer.getEvents.en: Get the events the layer listens to, such as spatial reference change

WMSTileLayer.getLayers.zh: 获取子 layer 列表，仅分组类型 layer 实现
WMSTileLayer.getLayers.en: Get the child layers, implemented only by group type layers

WMSTileLayer.getMaxZoom.zh: 获取图层可显示的最大 zoom，受空间参考上限约束
WMSTileLayer.getMaxZoom.en: Get the layer's max display zoom, capped by its spatial reference

WMSTileLayer.getMinZoom.zh: 获取图层的最小 zoom，取 minZoom 与自身空间参考下限的较大者
WMSTileLayer.getMinZoom.en: Get the layer's min zoom, the greater of minZoom and its spatial reference's lower limit

WMSTileLayer.getRenderer.zh: 获取图层的瓦片 canvas renderer 实例
WMSTileLayer.getRenderer.en: Get the layer's tile canvas renderer instance

WMSTileLayer.getRendererOption.zh: 按 map 的 renderer 类型返回 layer 使用的 renderer 名
WMSTileLayer.getRendererOption.en: Return the layer's renderer name according to the map's renderer type

WMSTileLayer.getTileId.zh: 按瓦片坐标与 zoom 生成瓦片的唯一 id
WMSTileLayer.getTileId.en: Generate the unique tile id from tile coordinates and zoom

WMSTileLayer.getTiles.zh: 获取指定 zoom 下渲染所需的主瓦片与父级瓦片网格
WMSTileLayer.getTiles.en: Get the tile and parent tile grids needed for rendering at the given zoom

WMSTileLayer.getTileUrl.zh: 获取 tile 的 WMS 请求 url，拼接 wms 参数与 bbox
WMSTileLayer.getTileUrl.en: Get the WMS request url of a tile by appending wms params and bbox.

WMSTileLayer.identify.zh: 按 coordinate 识别 layer 上的 geometry，由子类实现
WMSTileLayer.identify.en: Identify geometries on the layer by coordinate, implemented by subclasses

WMSTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.zh: 按 container point 识别 geometry，由子类实现
WMSTileLayer.identifyAtPoint.en: Identify geometries by container point, implemented by subclasses

WMSTileLayer.isParentTile.zh: 判断瓦片是否落在需保留的父级瓦片层级范围内
WMSTileLayer.isParentTile.en: Check whether a tile zoom falls in the parent tile levels that should be kept

WMSTileLayer.onAdd.zh: layer 加入地图时的回调，按设备像素比与 wms 版本初始化请求参数
WMSTileLayer.onAdd.en: Callback when the layer is added, initializing wms params with device pixel ratio and crs key

WMSTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.zh: canvas 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
WMSTileLayer.onCanvasCreate.en: Callback after the layer canvas is created, overridable by subclasses

WMSTileLayer.onConfig.zh: options 变更后的回调，触发重绘与 attribution 更新
WMSTileLayer.onConfig.en: Callback after options change, triggering a redraw and attribution update

WMSTileLayer.onLoadEnd.zh: layer 加载完成后的钩子，由子类重写，默认空实现
WMSTileLayer.onLoadEnd.en: Hook called after the layer finishes loading, empty by default

WMSTileLayer.onRemove.zh: layer 从 map 移除时的回调，子类可重写
WMSTileLayer.onRemove.en: Callback when the layer is removed from the map, overridable by subclasses

WMSTileLayer.onRendererCreate.zh: renderer 创建完成后的回调，子类可重写
WMSTileLayer.onRendererCreate.en: Callback after the layer renderer is created, overridable by subclasses

WMSTileLayer.removeMask.zh: 移除图层上设置的 mask，图层在地图上时重绘图层
WMSTileLayer.removeMask.en: Removes the layer's mask and redraws the layer when it is on a map.

WMSTileLayer.setZIndex.zh: 为图层设置 z-index，并按 z-index 重排图层叠放顺序
WMSTileLayer.setZIndex.en: Sets the layer's z-index, resorting the layer stack and redrawing the renderer.

WMSTileLayer.toJSON.zh: 导出该 WMS 图层的 JSON 描述，可用于 fromJSON 重建实例
WMSTileLayer.toJSON.en:
Export the WMSTileLayer's json.
It can be used to reproduce the instance by [fromJSON]{@link Layer#fromJSON} method

Zoom.onAdd.zh: 控件添加到 map 后的可选回调，由子类实现
Zoom.onAdd.en: Optional callback after the control is added to a map, implemented by subclasses

Zoom.onConfig.zh: 配置中含 position 时重新计算并更新控件位置
Zoom.onConfig.en: Recalculate and update the control position when position is in the changed options

Zoom.onRemove.zh: 控件移除时解绑地图上的 zoom 相关事件监听
Zoom.onRemove.en: Callback when removed, unbinding the map's zoom event listeners
